nm.18.23	Numbers 18:23	But the Leuites shall doe the seruice of the Tabernacle of the Congregation, and they shal beare their iniquitie: it shall be a statute for euer throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they haue no inheritance.
nm.18.24	Numbers 18:24	But the tithes of the children of Israel which they offer as an heaue offering vnto the LORD, I haue giuen to the Leuites to inherite: therefore I haue said vnto them, Among the children of Israel they shall haue no inheritance.
nm.18.25	Numbers 18:25	¶ And the LORD spake vnto Moses, saying,
nm.18.26	Numbers 18:26	Thus speake vnto the Leuites, and say vnto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes, which I haue giuen you from them for your inheritance, then ye shal offer vp an heaue offering of it for the LORD, euen a tenth part of the tithe.
nm.18.27	Numbers 18:27	And this your heaue offering shall be reckoned vnto you, as though it were the corne of the threshing floore, and as the fulnesse of the wine presse.
nm.18.28	Numbers 18:28	Thus you also shal offer an heaue offering vnto the LORD of all your tithes which ye receiue of the children of Israel, and ye shall giue thereof the LORDs heaue offering to Aaron the Priest.
nm.18.29	Numbers 18:29	Out of all your gifts ye shall offer euery heaue offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, euen the hallowed part thereof, out of it.
nm.18.30	Numbers 18:30	Therefore thou shalt say vnto them, When yee haue heaued the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted vnto the Leuites, as the encrease of the threshing floore, and as the encrease of the wine presse.
nm.18.31	Numbers 18:31	And ye shall eate it in euery place, ye and your housholds: for it is your reward for your seruice, in the Tabernacle of the Congregation.
nm.18.32	Numbers 18:32	And yee shall beare no sinne by reason of it, when ye haue heaued from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
nm.19.1	Numbers 19:1	And the LORD spake vnto Moses, and vnto Aaron, saying,
nm.19.2	Numbers 19:2	This is the ordinance of the Law, which the LORD hath commaunded, saying, Speake vnto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and vpon which neuer came yoke.
nm.19.3	Numbers 19:3	And ye shall giue her vnto Eleazar the Priest, that hee may bring her forth without the campe, and one shall slay her before his face.
nm.19.4	Numbers 19:4	And Eleazar the Priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinckle of her blood directly before the Tabernacle of the Congregation seuen times.
nm.19.5	Numbers 19:5	And one shall burne the heifer in his sight: her skinne, and her flesh, and her blood, with her doung, shall he burne.
nm.19.6	Numbers 19:6	And the Priest shall take Cedarwood, and hysope, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
nm.19.7	Numbers 19:7	Then the Priest shall wash his clothes, and hee shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the campe, and the Priest shalbe vncleane vntill the euen.
nm.19.8	Numbers 19:8	And he that burneth her, shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be vncleane vntill the Euen.
nm.19.9	Numbers 19:9	And a man that is cleane, shall gather vp the ashes of the heifer, and lay them vp without the campe in a cleane place, and it shall bee kept for the Congregation of the children of Israel, for a water of separation: it is a purification for sinne.
nm.19.10	Numbers 19:10	And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer, shall wash his clothes, and be vncleane vntil the Euen: and it shall be vnto the children of Israel, and vnto the stranger that soiourneth among them, for a statute for euer.
nm.19.11	Numbers 19:11	¶ He that toucheth the dead body of any man, shall bee vncleane seuen dayes.
nm.19.12	Numbers 19:12	He shall purifie himselfe with it on the third day, and on the seuenth day he shall be cleane: but if he purifie not himselfe the third day, then the seuenth day he shall not be cleane.
nm.19.13	Numbers 19:13	Whosoeuer toucheth the dead bodie of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himselfe, defileth the Tabernacle of the LORD, and that soule shall be cut off from Israel, because the water of separation was not sprinckled vpon him: he shall be vncleane, his vncleannesse is yet vpon him.
nm.19.14	Numbers 19:14	This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent; all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shalbe vnclean seuen dayes.
nm.19.15	Numbers 19:15	And euery open vessel which hath no couering bound vpon it, is vncleane.
nm.19.16	Numbers 19:16	And whosoeuer toucheth one that is slaine with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a graue, shall be vncleane seuen dayes.
nm.19.17	Numbers 19:17	And for an vncleane person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sinne, and running water shall bee put thereto in a vessell:
nm.19.18	Numbers 19:18	And a cleane person shall take hysope, and dippe it in the water, and sprinckle it vpon the tent, and vpon all the vessels, and vpon the persons that were there, and vpon him that touched a bone, or one slaine, or one dead, or a graue.
nm.19.19	Numbers 19:19	And the cleane person shal sprinkle vpon the vncleane on the third day, and on the seuenth day: and on the seuenth day he shall purifie himselfe, and wash his clothes, and bathe himselfe in water, and shall be cleane at Euen.
nm.19.20	Numbers 19:20	But the man that shall bee vncleane, and shall not purifie himselfe, that soule shall bee cut off from among the Congregation: because he hath defiled the Sanctuary of the LORD, the water of separation hath not beene sprinkled vpon him, he is vncleane.
nm.19.21	Numbers 19:21	And it shall be a perpetuall statute vnto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation, shall wash his clothes: and he that toucheth the water of separation, shall be vncleane vntill Euen.
nm.19.22	Numbers 19:22	And whatsoeuer the vncleane person toucheth, shall be vncleane: and the soule that toucheth it, shall bee vncleane vntill Euen.
nm.20.1	Numbers 20:1	Then came the children of Israel, euen the whole Congregation, into the desert of Zin, in the first moneth: and the people abode in Kadesh, and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
nm.20.2	Numbers 20:2	And there was no water for the Congregation: and they gathered themselues together against Moses and against Aaron.
nm.20.3	Numbers 20:3	And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD.
nm.20.4	Numbers 20:4	And why haue yee brought vp the Congregation of the LORD into this wildernesse, that we and our cattell should die there?
nm.20.5	Numbers 20:5	And wherefore haue ye made vs to come vp out of Egypt, to bring vs in vnto this euil place? it is no place of seed, or of figges, or vines, or of pomegranates, neither is there any water to drinke.
nm.20.6	Numbers 20:6	And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly, vnto the doore of the Tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell vpon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared vnto them.
nm.20.7	Numbers 20:7	¶ And the LORD spake vnto Moses, saying,
nm.20.8	Numbers 20:8	Take the rodde, and gather thou the assembly together, thou and Aaron thy brother, and speake yee vnto the rocke before their eyes, and it shall giue foorth his water, and thou shalt bring foorth to them, water out of the rocke: so thou shalt giue the Congregation, and their beasts drinke.
nm.20.9	Numbers 20:9	And Moses tooke the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
nm.20.10	Numbers 20:10	And Moses and Aaron gathered the Congregation together before the rocke, and hee said vnto them, Heare now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rocke?
nm.20.11	Numbers 20:11	And Moses lift vp his hand, and with his rod he smote the rocke twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the Congregation dranke, and their beasts also.
nm.20.12	Numbers 20:12	¶ And the LORD spake vnto Moses and Aaron, Because ye beleeue me not, to sanctifie me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this Congregation into the land which I haue giuen them.
nm.20.13	Numbers 20:13	This is the water of Meribah, because the children of Israel stroue with the LORD; and he was sanctified in them.
nm.20.14	Numbers 20:14	¶ And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh, vnto the King of Edom; Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the trauaile that hath befallen vs:
nm.20.15	Numbers 20:15	How our fathers went downe into Egypt, and we haue dwelt in Egypt a long time: and the Egyptians vexed vs, and our fathers.
nm.20.16	Numbers 20:16	And when wee cryed vnto the LORD, he heard our voyce, and sent an Angel, and hath brought vs foorth out of Egypt: and behold, wee are in Kadesh, a citie in the vttermost of thy border.
nm.20.17	Numbers 20:17	Let vs passe, I pray thee, thorow thy countrey: we will not passe thorow the fields, or thorow the Uineyards, neither will we drinke of the water of the wells: wee will goe by the Kings high-way, we wil not turne to the right hand nor to the left, vntill wee haue passed thy borders.
nm.20.18	Numbers 20:18	And Edom said vnto him, Thou shalt not passe by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
nm.20.19	Numbers 20:19	And the children of Israel said vnto him, We will goe by the high-way: and if I and my cattell drinke of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will onely (without doing any thing else) go thorow on my feet.
nm.20.20	Numbers 20:20	And he said, Thou shalt not goe thorow. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
nm.20.21	Numbers 20:21	Thus Edom refused to giue Israel passage thorow his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
nm.20.22	Numbers 20:22	¶ And the children of Israel, euen the whole Congregation, iourneyed from Kadesh, and came vnto mount Hor.

nm.20.24	Numbers 20:24	Aaron shall bee gathered vnto his people: for hee shall not enter into the land which I haue giuen vnto the children of Israel, because yee rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

nm.30.1	Numbers 30:1	And Moses spake vnto the heads of the tribes, concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
nm.30.2	Numbers 30:2	If a man vowe a vow vnto the LORD, or sweare an othe to bind his soule with a bond: he shall not breake his word, hee shall doe according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
nm.30.3	Numbers 30:3	If a woman also vow a vow vnto the LORD, and binde her selfe by a bond, being in her fathers house in her youth;
nm.30.4	Numbers 30:4	And her father heare her vow, and her bond wherewith shee hath bound her soule, and her father shall holde his peace at her: then all her vowes shall stand, and euery bond wherewith shee hath bound her soule, shall stand.
nm.30.5	Numbers 30:5	But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vowes or of her bonds, wherewith she hath bound her soule, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgiue her, because her father disallowed her.
nm.30.6	Numbers 30:6	And if she had at all an husband when she vowed, or vttered ought out of her lips, wherewith shee bound her soule,
nm.30.7	Numbers 30:7	And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that hee heard it: then her vowes shall stand, and her bonds wherewith shee bound her soule, shall stand.
nm.30.8	Numbers 30:8	But if her husband disallowe her on the day that he heard it, then he shall make her vowe which she vowed, and that which she vttered with her lippes wherewith shee bound her soule, of none effect, and the LORD shall forgiue her.
nm.30.9	Numbers 30:9	But euery vow of a widow, and of her that is diuorced, wherewith they haue bound their soules, shall stand against her.
nm.30.10	Numbers 30:10	And if she vowed in her husbands house, or bound her soule by a bond with an oath;
nm.30.11	Numbers 30:11	And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vowes shall stand, and euery bond wherewith shee bound her soule, shall stand.
nm.30.12	Numbers 30:12	But if her husband hath vtterly made them voyd on the day hee heard them: then whatsoeuer proceeded out of her lips concerning her vowes, or concerning the bond of her soule, shall not stand: her husband hath made them voyd, and the LORD shal forgiue her.
nm.30.13	Numbers 30:13	Euery vow, and euery binding othe to afflict the soule, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it voyd.
nm.30.14	Numbers 30:14	But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her, from day to day, then he establisheth all her vowes, or all her bonds which are vpon her: hee confirmeth them, because hee held his peace at her, in the day that hee heard them.
nm.30.15	Numbers 30:15	But if hee shall any wayes make them voyd after that he hath heard them, then he shall beare her iniquitie.
nm.30.16	Numbers 30:16	These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses betweene a man and his wife, betweene the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth, in her fathers house.

nm.35.1	Numbers 35:1	And the LORD spake vnto Moses in the plaines of Moab by Iordane, neere Iericho, saying,
nm.35.2	Numbers 35:2	Command the children of Israel, that they giue vnto the Leuites of the inheritance of their possession, cities to dwell in: and yee shall giue also vnto the Leuites suburbs for the cities round about them.
nm.35.3	Numbers 35:3	And the cities shall they haue to dwell in, and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattell, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
nm.35.4	Numbers 35:4	And the suburbs of the cities, which yee shall giue vnto the Leuites, shall reach from the wall of the citie, and outward, a thousand cubites round about.
nm.35.5	Numbers 35:5	And ye shall measure from without the city on the Eastside two thousand cubites, and on the Southside two thousand cubites, and on the Westside two thousand cubites, & on the Northside two thousand cubites: and the citie shall be in the midst; this shalbe to them the suburbs of the cities.
nm.35.6	Numbers 35:6	And among the cities which yee shal giue vnto the Leuites, there shalbe sixe cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that hee may flee thither: And to them ye shall adde fourty and two cities.
nm.35.7	Numbers 35:7	So all the cities which ye shall giue to the Leuites, shall be fourty and eight cities: them shall yee giue with their suburbs.
nm.35.8	Numbers 35:8	And the cities which ye shal giue, shalbe of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that haue many ye shall giue many; but from them that haue few, ye shall giue few. Euery one shal giue of his cities vnto the Leuites, according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
nm.35.9	Numbers 35:9	¶ And the LORD spake vnto Moses, saying,
nm.35.10	Numbers 35:10	Speake vnto the children of Israel, and say vnto them, When ye bee come ouer Iordane, into the land of Canaan:
nm.35.11	Numbers 35:11	Then ye shall appoint you cities, to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither which killeth any person at vnawares.
nm.35.12	Numbers 35:12	And they shall be vnto you cities for refuge from the auenger, that the man-slayer die not, vntill he stand before the Congregation in iudgement.
nm.35.13	Numbers 35:13	And of these cities which ye shall giue, sixe cities shall ye haue for refuge.
nm.35.14	Numbers 35:14	Yee shall giue three cities on this side Iordane, and three cities shall yee giue in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
nm.35.15	Numbers 35:15	These sixe cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the soiourner among them: that euery one that killeth any person vnawares, may flee thither.
nm.35.16	Numbers 35:16	And if he smite him with an instrument of Iron, (so that he die,) hee is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
nm.35.17	Numbers 35:17	And if he smite him with throwing a stone, (wherewith hee may die) and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
nm.35.18	Numbers 35:18	Or if he smite him with an handweapon of wood, (wherewith he may die) and he die, hee is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
nm.35.19	Numbers 35:19	The reuenger of blood himselfe shall slay the murtherer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
nm.35.20	Numbers 35:20	But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurle at him by laying of waite that he die,
nm.35.21	Numbers 35:21	Or in enmitie smite him with his hand, that he die: hee that smote him shall surely be put to death, for hee is a murderer: the reuenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when hee meeteth him.
nm.35.22	Numbers 35:22	But if hee thrust him suddenly without enmitie, or haue cast vpon him any thing without laying of wait,
nm.35.23	Numbers 35:23	Or with any stone wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it vpon him, that he die, and was not his enemie, neither sought his harme:
nm.35.24	Numbers 35:24	Then the Congregation shall iudge betweene the slayer, and the reuenger of blood, according to these iudgements.
nm.35.25	Numbers 35:25	And the Congregation shall deliuer the slayer out of the hand of the reuenger of blood, and the Congregation shal restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it vnto the death of the high Priest, which was annoynted with the holy oyle.
nm.35.26	Numbers 35:26	But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the citie of his refuge, whither he was fled:
nm.35.27	Numbers 35:27	And the reuenger of blood finde him without the borders of the citie of his refuge, and the reuenger of blood kill the slayer, he shall not be guiltie of blood:
nm.35.28	Numbers 35:28	Because he should haue remained in the citie of his refuge, vntill the death of the high Priest: but after the death of the hie Priest, the slayer shal returne into the land of his possession.
nm.35.29	Numbers 35:29	So these things shall be for a statute of iudgment vnto you, thorowout your generations in al your dwellings.
nm.35.30	Numbers 35:30	Who so killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death, by the mouth of witnesses: but one witnesse shall not testifie against any person, to cause him to die.
nm.35.31	Numbers 35:31	Moreouer, yee shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guiltie of death, but he shalbe surely put to death.
nm.35.32	Numbers 35:32	And yee shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the citie of his refuge, that hee should come againe to dwell in the land, vntil the death of the Priest.
nm.35.33	Numbers 35:33	So ye shall not pollute the lande wherein ye are: for blood, it defileth the land: and the land cannot bee cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
nm.35.34	Numbers 35:34	Defile not therefore the lande which yee shall inhabite, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.

dt.1.1	Deuteronomy 1:1	These bee the woordes which Moses spake vnto all Israel, on this side Iordane in the wildernes, in the plaine ouer against the Red sea, betweene Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
dt.1.2	Deuteronomy 1:2	(There are eleuen daies iourney from Horeb, by the way of mount Seir, vnto Kadesh Barnea.)
dt.1.3	Deuteronomy 1:3	And it came to passe in the fourtieth yeere, in the eleuenth moneth, on the first day of the moneth, that Moses spake vnto the children of Israel, according vnto all that the LORD had giuen him in commandement vnto them:
dt.1.4	Deuteronomy 1:4	After hee had slaine Sihon the King of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the King of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth, in Edrei.
dt.1.5	Deuteronomy 1:5	On this side Iordane, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
dt.1.6	Deuteronomy 1:6	The LORD our God spake vnto vs in Horeb, saying, Ye haue dwelt long ynough in this mount:
dt.1.7	Deuteronomy 1:7	Turne you, and take your iourney, and goe to the mount of the Amorites, and vnto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plaine, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the South, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and vnto Lebanon, vnto the great riuer, the riuer Euphrates.
dt.1.8	Deuteronomy 1:8	Behold, I haue set the land before you: Goe in, and possesse the land, which the LORD sware vnto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Iacob, to giue vnto them, and to their seed after them.
dt.1.9	Deuteronomy 1:9	¶ And I spake vnto you at that time, saying, I am not able to beare you my selfe alone:
dt.1.10	Deuteronomy 1:10	The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and beholde, you are this day as the starres of heauen for multitude.
dt.1.11	Deuteronomy 1:11	(The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many moe as ye are, and blesse you as he hath promised you.)
dt.1.12	Deuteronomy 1:12	How can I my selfe alone beare your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
dt.1.13	Deuteronomy 1:13	Take ye wise men, and vnderstanding, and knowen among your tribes, and I will make them rulers ouer you.
dt.1.14	Deuteronomy 1:14	And ye answered me, and saide, The thing which thou hast spoken, is good for vs to doe.
dt.1.15	Deuteronomy 1:15	So I tooke the chiefe of your tribes, wise men, and knowen, and made them heads ouer you, captaines ouer thousands, and captaines ouer hundreds, and captaines ouer fifties, and captaines ouer tennes, and officers among your tribes.
dt.1.16	Deuteronomy 1:16	And I charged your Iudges at that time, saying, Heare the causes betweene your brethren, and iudge righteously betweene euery man and his brother, & the stranger that is with him.
dt.1.17	Deuteronomy 1:17	Ye shall not respect persons in iudgement, but you shall heare the small aswell as the great: you shall not bee afraid of the face of man, for the iudgment is Gods: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it vnto me, and I will heare it.
dt.1.18	Deuteronomy 1:18	And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should doe.
dt.1.19	Deuteronomy 1:19	¶ And when wee departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wildernes, which you saw by the way of the mountaine of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded vs: and wee came to Kadesh Barnea.
dt.1.20	Deuteronomy 1:20	And I said vnto you, Ye are come vnto the mountaine of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth giue vnto vs.
dt.1.21	Deuteronomy 1:21	Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: Goe vp, and possesse it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said vnto thee: Feare not, neither be discouraged.
dt.1.22	Deuteronomy 1:22	¶ And ye came neere vnto mee euery one of you, and said, We will send men before vs, and they shall search vs out the land, and bring vs word againe, by what way we must goe vp, and into what cities we shall come.
dt.1.23	Deuteronomy 1:23	And the saying pleased mee well: and I tooke twelue men of you, one of a tribe.
dt.1.24	Deuteronomy 1:24	And they turned and went vp into the mountaine, and came vnto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
dt.1.25	Deuteronomy 1:25	And they tooke of the fruit of the land in their handes, and brought it downe vnto vs, and brought vs worde againe, and said, It is a good lande which the LORD our God doeth giue vs.
dt.1.26	Deuteronomy 1:26	Notwithstanding, ye would not goe vp, but rebelled against the commandement of the LORD your God.
dt.1.27	Deuteronomy 1:27	And ye murmured in your tents and said, Because the LORD hated vs, he hath brought vs forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliuer vs into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy vs:
dt.1.28	Deuteronomy 1:28	Whither shall wee goe vp? our brethren haue discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller then we, the cities are great, and walled vp to heauen, and moreouer we haue seene the sonnes of the Anakims there.
dt.1.29	Deuteronomy 1:29	Then I said vnto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
dt.1.30	Deuteronomy 1:30	The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that hee did for you in Egypt before your eyes:
dt.1.31	Deuteronomy 1:31	And in the wildernes, where thou hast seene how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth beare his sonne, in all the way that ye went, vntil ye came into this place.
dt.1.32	Deuteronomy 1:32	Yet in this thing ye did not beleeue the LORD your God,
dt.1.33	Deuteronomy 1:33	Who went in the way before you to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should goe, and in a cloud by day.
dt.1.34	Deuteronomy 1:34	And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
dt.1.35	Deuteronomy 1:35	Surely there shall not one of these men of this euill generation see that good land, which I sware to giue vnto your fathers:
dt.1.36	Deuteronomy 1:36	Saue Caleb the sonne of Iephunneh, he shall see it, and to him will I giue the land that he hath troden vpon, and to his children, because hee hath wholly followed the LORD.
dt.1.37	Deuteronomy 1:37	Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not goe in thither.
dt.1.38	Deuteronomy 1:38	But Ioshua the sonne of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall goe in thither. Encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherite it.
dt.1.39	Deuteronomy 1:39	Moreouer, your litle ones, which ye said should be a pray, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge betweene good and euil, they shall goe in thither; and vnto them will I giue it, and they shall possesse it.
dt.1.40	Deuteronomy 1:40	But as for you, turne ye, and take your iourney into the wildernesse, by the way of the Red sea.
dt.1.41	Deuteronomy 1:41	Then ye answered, and said vnto mee, Wee haue sinned against the LORD, we will goe vp and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded vs. And when ye had girded on euery man his weapons of warre, yee were ready to goe vp into the hill.
dt.1.42	Deuteronomy 1:42	And the LORD said vnto me, Say vnto them, Goe not vp, neither fight, for I am not among you: least ye be smitten before your enemies.
dt.1.43	Deuteronomy 1:43	So I spake vnto you, and you would not heare, but rebelled against the commandement of the LORD, and went presumptuously vp into the hill.
dt.1.44	Deuteronomy 1:44	And the Amorites which dwelt in that mountaine, came out against you, and chased you, as Bees doe, and destroyed you in Seir, euen vnto Hormah.
dt.1.45	Deuteronomy 1:45	And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voyce, nor giue eare vnto you.
dt.1.46	Deuteronomy 1:46	So yee abode in Kadesh many dayes, according vnto the dayes that ye abode there.
dt.2.1	Deuteronomy 2:1	Then we turned, and tooke our iourney into the wildernesse, by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake vnto mee: and wee compassed mount Seir many dayes.
dt.2.2	Deuteronomy 2:2	And the LORD spake vnto me, saying,
dt.2.3	Deuteronomy 2:3	Yee haue compassed this mountaine long enough: turne you Northward.
dt.2.4	Deuteronomy 2:4	And commaund thou the people, saying, Ye are to passe through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir, and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed vnto your selues therefore.
dt.2.5	Deuteronomy 2:5	Meddle not with them, for I will not giue you of their land, no not so much as a foote breadth, because I haue giuen mount Seir vnto Esau for a possession.
dt.2.6	Deuteronomy 2:6	Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat, and yee shall also buy water of them for money, that yee may drinke.
dt.2.7	Deuteronomy 2:7	For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee, in all the workes of thy hand: hee knoweth thy walking thorow this great wildernesse: these fourtie yeres the LORD thy God hath bene with thee, thou hast lacked nothing.
dt.2.8	Deuteronomy 2:8	And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, thorow the way of the plaine from Elath, and from Ezion-Gaber, wee turned and passed by the way of the wildernesse of Moab.
dt.2.9	Deuteronomy 2:9	And the LORD said vnto mee, Distresse not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battell: for I wil not giue thee of their land for a possession, because I haue giuen Ar vnto the children of Lot for a possession.
dt.2.10	Deuteronomy 2:10	The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims:
dt.2.11	Deuteronomy 2:11	Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims, but the Moabites call them Emims.
dt.2.12	Deuteronomy 2:12	The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime, but the children of Esau succeeded them when they had destroyed them from before them, & dwelt in their stead, as Israel did vnto the land of his possession, which the LORD gaue vnto them.
dt.2.13	Deuteronomy 2:13	Now rise vp, said I, and get you ouer the brooke Zered: and we went ouer the brooke Zered.
dt.2.14	Deuteronomy 2:14	And the space in which we came from Kadesh Barnea, vntill we were come ouer the brooke Zered, was thirtie and eight yeeres; vntill all the generation of the men of warre were wasted out from among the hoste, as the LORD sware vnto them.
dt.2.15	Deuteronomy 2:15	For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the hoste, vntill they were consumed.
dt.2.16	Deuteronomy 2:16	¶ So it came to passe, when all the men of warre were consumed and dead from among the people,
dt.2.17	Deuteronomy 2:17	That the LORD spake vnto me, saying,
dt.2.18	Deuteronomy 2:18	Thou art to passe ouer thorow Ar, the coast of Moab, this day.
dt.2.19	Deuteronomy 2:19	And when thou commest nigh ouer against the children of Ammon, distresse them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not giue thee of the lande of the children of Ammon any possession, because I haue giuen it vnto the children of Lot for a possession:
dt.2.20	Deuteronomy 2:20	(That also was accounted a land of Giants: giants dwelt therein in old time, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims.
dt.2.21	Deuteronomy 2:21	A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims: but the LORD destroyed them before them, and they succeeded them & dwelt in their stead:)
dt.2.22	Deuteronomy 2:22	As he did to the children of Esau which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them, and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead euen vnto this day.
dt.2.23	Deuteronomy 2:23	And the Auims which dwelt in Hazerim, euen vnto Azzah, the Caphtorims which came foorth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.
dt.2.24	Deuteronomy 2:24	¶ Rise ye vp, take your iourney, and passe ouer the riuer Arnon: Behold, I haue giuen into thy hand Sihon the Amorite king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possesse it, and contend with him in battell.
dt.2.25	Deuteronomy 2:25	This day will I begin to put the dread of thee, and the feare of thee vpon the nations, that are vnder the whole heauen, who shall heare report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
dt.2.26	Deuteronomy 2:26	¶ And I sent messengers out of the wildernesse of Kedemoth, vnto Sihon king of Heshbon, with wordes of peace, saying,
dt.2.27	Deuteronomy 2:27	Let me passe through thy land: I will goe along by the high way, I will neither turne vnto the right hand, nor to the left.
dt.2.28	Deuteronomy 2:28	Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eate, and giue me water for money that I may drinke: Only I will passe through on my feet:
dt.2.29	Deuteronomy 2:29	As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did vnto me, vntill I shall passe ouer Iordan, into the land which the LORD our God giueth vs.
dt.2.30	Deuteronomy 2:30	But Sihon King of Heshbon would not let vs passe by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that hee might deliuer him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
dt.2.31	Deuteronomy 2:31	And the LORD said vnto mee, Behold, I haue begun to giue Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possesse, that thou mayest inherit his land.
dt.2.32	Deuteronomy 2:32	Then Sihon came out against vs, he & all his people to fight at Iahaz.
dt.2.33	Deuteronomy 2:33	And the LORD our God deliuered him before vs, and wee smote him, and his sonnes, and all his people.
dt.2.34	Deuteronomy 2:34	And we tooke all his cities at that time, and vtterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the litle ones of euery citie, we left none to remaine:
dt.2.35	Deuteronomy 2:35	Onely the cattell wee tooke for a pray vnto our selues, and the spoyle of the cities, which we tooke:
dt.2.36	Deuteronomy 2:36	From Aroer, which is by the brinke of the riuer of Arnon, and from the citie that is by the riuer euen vnto Gilead, there was not one citie too strong for vs: the LORD our God deliuered all vnto vs.
dt.2.37	Deuteronomy 2:37	Onely vnto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor vnto any place of the riuer Iabbok, nor vnto the cities in the mountaines, nor vnto whatsoeuer the LORD our God forbade vs.
dt.3.1	Deuteronomy 3:1	Then we turned, and went vp the way to Bashan: and Og the King of Bashan came out against vs, hee, and all his people to battell at Edrei.
dt.3.2	Deuteronomy 3:2	And the LORD said vnto mee, Feare him not: for I will deliuer him, and all his people, and his land into thy hand, and thou shalt doe vnto him as thou didst vnto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
dt.3.3	Deuteronomy 3:3	So the LORD our God deliuered into our hands Og also the King of Bashan, and all his people: and wee smote him vntill none was left to him remayning.
dt.3.4	Deuteronomy 3:4	And we tooke all his cities at that time, there was not a citie which wee tooke not from them; threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdome of Og in Bashan.
dt.3.5	Deuteronomy 3:5	All these cities were fenced with high walles, gates and barres, beside vnwalled townes a great many.
dt.3.6	Deuteronomy 3:6	And we vtterly destroyed them, as we did vnto Sihon King of Heshbon, vtterly destroying the men, women, and children of euery citie.
dt.3.7	Deuteronomy 3:7	But all the cattell, and the spoile of the cities, we tooke for a pray to our selues.
dt.3.8	Deuteronomy 3:8	And we tooke at that time out of the hand of the two Kings of the Amorites, the land that was on this side Iordan, from the riuer of Arnon, vnto mount Hermon:
dt.3.9	Deuteronomy 3:9	(Which Hermon the Sidonians call Syrion: and the Amorites call it Shenir.)
dt.3.10	Deuteronomy 3:10	All the cities of the plaine, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, vnto Salchah, and Edrei, cities of the kingdome of Og in Bashan.
dt.3.11	Deuteronomy 3:11	For onely Og King of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedsted was a bedsted of yron: is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? Nine cubites was the length thereof, and foure cubites the breadth of it, after the cubite of a man.
dt.3.12	Deuteronomy 3:12	And this land which we possessed at that time, from Aroer which is by the riuer Arnon, and halfe mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gaue I vnto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites.
dt.3.13	Deuteronomy 3:13	And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdome of Og, gaue I vnto the halfe tribe of Manasseh: All the region of Argob with all Bashan, which was called the land of Giants.
dt.3.14	Deuteronomy 3:14	Iair the sonne of Manasseh tooke all the countrey of Argob, vnto the coastes of Geshuri, and Maachathi; and called them after his owne name, Bashan Hauoth Iair, vnto this day.
dt.3.15	Deuteronomy 3:15	And I gaue Gilead vnto Machir.
dt.3.16	Deuteronomy 3:16	And vnto the Reubenites, and vnto the Gadites, I gaue from Gilead, euen vnto the riuer Arnon, halfe the valley, and the border, euen vnto the riuer Iabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon:
dt.3.17	Deuteronomy 3:17	The plaine also, and Iordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth, euen vnto the sea of the plaine, euen the salt sea, vnder Ashdoth Pisgah Eastward.
dt.3.18	Deuteronomy 3:18	¶ And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath giuen you this land to possesse it: ye shall passe ouer armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the warre.
dt.3.19	Deuteronomy 3:19	But your wiues, and your little ones, and your cattell (for I know that ye haue much cattel) shall abide in your cities, which I haue giuen you:
dt.3.20	Deuteronomy 3:20	Untill the LORD haue giuen rest vnto your brethren, as well as vnto you, and vntill they also possesse the land which the LORD your God hath giuen them beyond Iordan: and then shall ye returne euery man vnto his possession, which I haue giuen you.
dt.3.21	Deuteronomy 3:21	¶ And I commanded Ioshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes haue seene all that the LORD your God hath done vnto these two Kings: so shal the LORD doe vnto all the kingdomes whither thou passest.
dt.3.22	Deuteronomy 3:22	Ye shall not feare them: for the LORD your God, he shal fight for you.
dt.3.23	Deuteronomy 3:23	And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,
dt.3.24	Deuteronomy 3:24	O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy seruant thy greatnesse, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heauen, or in earth, that can do according to thy workes, and according to thy might?
dt.3.25	Deuteronomy 3:25	I pray thee let me goe ouer, and see the good land that is beyond Iordan, that goodly mountaine and Lebanon.
dt.3.26	Deuteronomy 3:26	But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not heare mee: and the LORD said vnto me, Let it suffice thee, speake no more vnto me of this matter.
dt.3.27	Deuteronomy 3:27	Get thee vp into the top of Pisgah, and lift vp thine eyes Westward, and Northward, and Southward, and Eastward, and beholde it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not goe ouer this Iordan.
dt.3.28	Deuteronomy 3:28	But charge Ioshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for hee shall goe ouer before this people, and he shall cause them to inherite the land which thou shalt see.
dt.3.29	Deuteronomy 3:29	So we abode in the valley, ouer against Beth-Peor.
dt.4.1	Deuteronomy 4:1	Nowe therefore hearken, O Israel, vnto the Statutes, and vnto the Iudgments which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may liue, and goe in and possesse the lande, which the LORD God of your fathers giueth you.
dt.4.2	Deuteronomy 4:2	Ye shall not adde vnto the word which I command you, neither shall you diminish ought from it, that ye may keepe the Commaundements of the LORD your God, which I command you.
dt.4.3	Deuteronomy 4:3	Your eyes haue seene what the LORD did because of Baal Peor: for all the men that followed Baal Peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
dt.4.4	Deuteronomy 4:4	But yee that did cleaue vnto the LORD your God, are aliue euery one of you this day.
dt.4.5	Deuteronomy 4:5	Behold, I haue taught you Statutes, and Iudgements, euen as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so, in the land whither ye goe to possesse it.
dt.4.6	Deuteronomy 4:6	Keepe therefore, and doe them; for this is your wisedome and your vnderstanding in the sight of the nations, which shall heare all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and vnderstanding people.
dt.4.7	Deuteronomy 4:7	For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh vnto them, as the LORD our God is in all things, that we call vpon him for?
dt.4.8	Deuteronomy 4:8	And what nation is there so great, that hath Statutes and Iudgements so righteous, as all this Law which I set before you this day?
dt.4.9	Deuteronomy 4:9	Onely take heed to thy selfe, and keepe thy soule diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes haue seene, and lest they depart from thy heart all the dayes of thy life: but teach them thy sonnes, & thy sonnes sonnes:
dt.4.10	Deuteronomy 4:10	Specially, the day that thou stoodst before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said vnto mee, Gather me the people together, and I will make them heare my wordes, that they may learne to feare mee all the dayes that they shall liue vpon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
dt.4.11	Deuteronomy 4:11	And ye came neere and stood vnder the mountaine, and the mountaine burnt with fire vnto the midst of heauen, with darkenes, cloudes, and thicke darkenesse.
dt.4.12	Deuteronomy 4:12	And the LORD spake vnto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voyce of the words, but saw no similitude, onely ye heard a voyce.
dt.4.13	Deuteronomy 4:13	And he declared vnto you his couenant, which he commanded you to performe, euen ten cōmandements, and he wrote them vpon two tables of stone.
dt.4.14	Deuteronomy 4:14	¶ And the LORD commanded me at that time, to teach you Statutes, and Iudgements, that yee might doe them in the land whither ye goe ouer to possesse it.
dt.4.15	Deuteronomy 4:15	Take ye therfore good heed vnto your selues, (for ye saw no maner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake vnto you in Horeb, out of the midst of the fire)
dt.4.16	Deuteronomy 4:16	Lest yee corrupt your selues, and make you a grauen image, the similitude of any figure, the likenes of male, or female,
dt.4.17	Deuteronomy 4:17	The likenesse of any beast that is on the earth, the likenes of any winged foule that flieth in the aire,
dt.4.18	Deuteronomy 4:18	The likenesse of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likenesse of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
dt.4.19	Deuteronomy 4:19	And lest thou lift vp thine eyes vnto heauen, and when thou seest the sun, and the moone, and the starres, euen all the hoste of heauen, shouldest be driuen to worship them, and serue them, which the LORD thy God hath diuided vnto all nations vnder the whole heauen.
dt.4.20	Deuteronomy 4:20	But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you foorth out of the yron fornace, euen out of Egypt, to bee vnto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
dt.4.21	Deuteronomy 4:21	Furthermore, the LORD was angry with mee for your sakes, and sware that I should not goe ouer Iordan, and that I should not goe in vnto that good land which the LORD thy God giueth thee for an inheritance.
dt.4.22	Deuteronomy 4:22	But I must die in this lande, I must not goe ouer Iordan: but ye shall goe ouer and possesse that good land.
dt.4.23	Deuteronomy 4:23	Take heed vnto your selues, lest ye forget the couenant of the LORD your God, which hee made with you, and make you a grauen image, or the likenes of any thing which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
dt.4.24	Deuteronomy 4:24	For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, euen a iealous God.
dt.4.25	Deuteronomy 4:25	¶ When thou shalt beget children, and childrens children, and shalt haue remained long in the land, and shal corrupt your selues, & make a grauen image, or the likenes of any thing, and shall doe euil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to prouoke him to anger:
dt.4.26	Deuteronomy 4:26	I call heauen and earth to witnesse against you this day, that ye shall soone vtterly perish from off the land whereunto you goe ouer Iordan, to possesse it: yee shall not prolong your dayes vpon it, but shall vtterly bee destroyed.
dt.4.27	Deuteronomy 4:27	And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
dt.4.28	Deuteronomy 4:28	And there ye shall serue gods, the worke of mens hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor heare, nor eate, nor smell.
dt.4.29	Deuteronomy 4:29	But if from thence thou shalt seeke the LORD thy God, thou shalt finde him, if thou seeke him with all thy heart, and with all thy soule.
dt.4.30	Deuteronomy 4:30	When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come vpon thee, euen in the latter dayes, if thou turne to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient vnto his voice:
dt.4.31	Deuteronomy 4:31	(For the LORD thy God is a mercifull God) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the couenant of thy fathers, which he sware vnto them.
dt.4.32	Deuteronomy 4:32	For aske now of the dayes that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man vpon earth, and aske from the one side of heauen vnto the other, whether there hath bene any such thing as this great thing is, or hath bene heard like it?
dt.4.33	Deuteronomy 4:33	Did euer people heare the voyce of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and liue?
dt.4.34	Deuteronomy 4:34	Or hath God assayed to goe and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signes, and by wonders, and by warre, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretehed out arme, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
dt.4.35	Deuteronomy 4:35	Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know, that the LORD hee is God; there is none else besides him.
dt.4.36	Deuteronomy 4:36	Out of heauen hee made thee to heare his voice, that he might instruct thee: and vpon earth hee shewed thee his great fire, and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
dt.4.37	Deuteronomy 4:37	And because he loued thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mightie power out of Egypt:
dt.4.38	Deuteronomy 4:38	To driue out nations from before thee, greater and mightier then thou art, to bring thee in, to giue thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
dt.4.39	Deuteronomy 4:39	Know therefore this day, & consider it in thine heart, that the LORD hee is God in heauen aboue, and vpon the earth beneath: there is none else.
dt.4.40	Deuteronomy 4:40	Thou shalt keepe therefore his Statutes, and his Commandements, which I command thee this day; that it may goe well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy dayes vpon the earth, which the LORD thy God giueth thee, for euer.
dt.4.41	Deuteronomy 4:41	¶ Then Moses seuered three cities on this side Iordan, toward the Sunne rising:
dt.4.42	Deuteronomy 4:42	That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour vnawares, and hated him not in times past, and that fleeing vnto one of these cities he might liue:
dt.4.43	Deuteronomy 4:43	Namely, Bezer in the wildernesse, in the plaine countrey of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
dt.4.44	Deuteronomy 4:44	¶ And this is the Law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
dt.4.45	Deuteronomy 4:45	These are the Testimonies, and the Statutes, and the Iudgements, which Moses spake vnto the children of Israel, after they came foorth out of Egypt;
dt.4.46	Deuteronomy 4:46	On this side Iordan in the valley ouer against Beth-Peor, in the land of Sihon King of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come foorth out of Egypt.
dt.4.47	Deuteronomy 4:47	And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Iordan toward the sun rising,
dt.4.48	Deuteronomy 4:48	From Aroer, which is by the banke of the riuer Arnon, euen vnto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
dt.4.49	Deuteronomy 4:49	And all the plaine of this side Iordan Eastward, euen vnto the sea, of the plaine vnder the springs of Pisgah.
dt.5.1	Deuteronomy 5:1	And Moses called all Israel, and sayd vnto them, Heare, O Israel, the Statutes and Iudgements which I speake in your eares this day, that ye may learne them, and keepe and doe them.
dt.5.2	Deuteronomy 5:2	The LORD our God made a couenant with vs in Horeb.
dt.5.3	Deuteronomy 5:3	The LORD made not this couenant with our fathers, but with vs: euen vs, who are all of vs here aliue this day.
dt.5.4	Deuteronomy 5:4	The LORD talked with you, face to face, in the mount, out of the midst of the fire,
dt.5.5	Deuteronomy 5:5	(I stood betweene the LORD and you, at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not vp into the mount,) saying,
dt.5.6	Deuteronomy 5:6	¶ I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the lande of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
dt.5.7	Deuteronomy 5:7	Thou shalt haue none other gods before me.
dt.5.8	Deuteronomy 5:8	Thou shalt not make thee any grauen image, or any likenesse of any thing that is in heauen aboue, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth.
dt.5.9	Deuteronomy 5:9	Thou shalt not bow downe thy selfe vnto them, nor serue them: for I the LORD thy God am a ielous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers vpon the children, vnto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
dt.5.10	Deuteronomy 5:10	And shewing mercy vnto thousands, of them that loue me, and keepe my commandements.
dt.5.11	Deuteronomy 5:11	Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vaine: for the LORD will not holde him guiltlesse that taketh his name in vaine.
dt.5.12	Deuteronomy 5:12	Keepe the Sabbath day to sanctifie it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
dt.5.13	Deuteronomy 5:13	Sixe dayes thou shalt labour, and doe all thy worke.
dt.5.14	Deuteronomy 5:14	But the seuenth day is the Sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not doe any worke, thou, nor thy sonne, nor thy daughter, nor thy man seruant, nor thy maid seruant, nor thine oxe, nor thine asse, nor any of thy cattel, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates, that thy man seruant and thy maid seruant may rest as well as thou.
dt.5.15	Deuteronomy 5:15	And remember that thou wast a seruant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence, through a mightie hand, and by a stretched out arme: Therefore the LORD thy God commaunded thee to keepe the Sabbath day.
dt.5.16	Deuteronomy 5:16	¶ Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee, that thy daies may be prolonged, and that it may goe well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giueth thee.
dt.5.17	Deuteronomy 5:17	Thou shalt not kill.
dt.5.18	Deuteronomy 5:18	Neither shalt thou commit adulterie.
dt.5.19	Deuteronomy 5:19	Neither shalt thou steale.
dt.5.20	Deuteronomy 5:20	Neither shalt thou beare false witnesse against thy neighbour.
dt.5.21	Deuteronomy 5:21	Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbours wife, neither shalt thou couet thy neighbours house, his field, or his man seruant, or his maide seruant, his oxe, or his asse, or any thing that is thy neighbours.
dt.5.22	Deuteronomy 5:22	¶ These wordes the LORD spake vnto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thicke darkenesse, with a great voice, and he added no more, and he wrote them in two Tables of stone, and deliuered them vnto me.
dt.5.23	Deuteronomy 5:23	And it came to passe when yee heard the voice out of the midst of the darkenes (for the mountaine did burne with fire) that ye came neere vnto mee, euen all the heads of your tribes, and your elders.
dt.5.24	Deuteronomy 5:24	And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed vs his glory, and his greatnesse, and we haue heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: wee haue seene this day that God doth talke with man, and he liueth.
dt.5.25	Deuteronomy 5:25	Now therefore why should wee die? for this great fire will consume vs. If we heare the voyce of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
dt.5.26	Deuteronomy 5:26	For who is there of all flesh that hath heard the voice of the liuing God, speaking out of the midst of the fire (as we haue) and liued?
dt.5.27	Deuteronomy 5:27	Goe thou neere, and heare all that the LORD our God shall say; and speake thou vnto vs all that the LORD our God shall speake vnto thee, and we will heare it, and doe it.
dt.5.28	Deuteronomy 5:28	And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake vnto me, and the LORD said vnto me, I haue heard the voice of the wordes of this people, which they haue spoken vnto thee: they haue well said, all that they haue spoken.
dt.5.29	Deuteronomy 5:29	O that there were such an heart in them, that they would feare me, and keepe my commandements alwayes, that it might bee well with them, and with their children for euer.
dt.5.30	Deuteronomy 5:30	Goe, say to them, Get you into your tents againe.
dt.5.31	Deuteronomy 5:31	But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speake vnto thee all the Commandements, and the Statutes, and the Iudgements, which thou shalt teach them, that they may doe them in the land which I giue them to possesse it.
dt.5.32	Deuteronomy 5:32	Ye shall obserue to doe therefore, as the LORD your God hath commanded you: you shall not turne aside to the right hand, or to the left.
dt.5.33	Deuteronomy 5:33	You shall walke in all the wayes which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may liue, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your dayes in the land which ye shall possesse.
dt.6.1	Deuteronomy 6:1	Now these are the Commaundements, the Statutes, & the Iudgements, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might doe them in the land whither ye goe to possesse it:

dt.6.3	Deuteronomy 6:3	¶ Heare therefore, O Israel, and obserue to do it, that it may be wel with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milke and hony.

dt.6.5	Deuteronomy 6:5	And thou shalt loue the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soule, and with all thy might.
dt.6.6	Deuteronomy 6:6	And these words which I command thee this day, shall bee in thine heart.
dt.6.7	Deuteronomy 6:7	And thou shalt teach them diligently vnto thy children, and shalt talke of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest downe, and when thou risest vp.
dt.6.8	Deuteronomy 6:8	And thou shalt binde them for a signe vpon thine hand, and they shalbe as frontlets betweene thine eyes.
dt.6.9	Deuteronomy 6:9	And thou shalt write them vpon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
dt.6.10	Deuteronomy 6:10	And it shall be when the LORD thy God shall haue brought thee into the land which hee sware vnto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Iacob to giue thee, great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
dt.6.11	Deuteronomy 6:11	And houses full of all good things which thou filledst not, and welles digged which thou diggedst not, vineyards and oliue trees which thou plantedst not, when thou shalt haue eaten and be full,
dt.6.12	Deuteronomy 6:12	Then beware lest thou forget the LORD which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
dt.6.13	Deuteronomy 6:13	Thou shalt feare the LORD thy God, and serue him, & shalt sweare by his Name.
dt.6.14	Deuteronomy 6:14	Yee shall not goe after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you:
dt.6.15	Deuteronomy 6:15	(For the LORD thy God is a ielous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God bee kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
dt.6.16	Deuteronomy 6:16	¶ Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as yee tempted him in Massah.
dt.6.17	Deuteronomy 6:17	You shall diligently keepe the Commandements of the LORD your God, and his Testimonies, and his Statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
dt.6.18	Deuteronomy 6:18	And thou shalt doe that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest goe in, and possesse the good land which the LORD sware vnto thy fathers:
dt.6.19	Deuteronomy 6:19	To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
dt.6.20	Deuteronomy 6:20	And when thy sonne asketh thee in time to come, saying, What meane the Testimonies, & the Statutes, and the Iudgements, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
dt.6.21	Deuteronomy 6:21	Then thou shalt say vnto thy sonne, We were Pharaohs bondmen in Egypt, and the LORD brought vs out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
dt.6.22	Deuteronomy 6:22	And the LORD shewed signes and wonders, great and sore vpon Egypt, vpon Pharaoh, and vpon all his houshold, before our eyes:
dt.6.23	Deuteronomy 6:23	And hee brought vs out from thence, that hee might bring vs in, to giue vs the land which hee sware vnto our fathers.
dt.6.24	Deuteronomy 6:24	And the LORD commanded vs to doe all these Statutes, to feare the LORD our God, for our good alwayes, that he might preserue vs aliue, as it is at this day.
dt.6.25	Deuteronomy 6:25	And it shall be our righteousnes, if we obserue to doe all these Commandements, before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded vs.
dt.7.1	Deuteronomy 7:1	When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possesse it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hiuites, and the Iebusites, seuen nations greater and mightier then thou:
dt.7.2	Deuteronomy 7:2	And when the LORD thy God shall deliuer them before thee, thou shalt smite them, and vtterly destroy them, thou shalt make no couenant with them, nor shew mercy vnto them.
dt.7.3	Deuteronomy 7:3	Neither shalt thou make marriages with them: thy daughter thou shalt not giue vnto his sonne, nor his daughter shalt thou take vnto thy sonne.
dt.7.4	Deuteronomy 7:4	For they will turne away thy sonne from following mee, that they may serue other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
dt.7.5	Deuteronomy 7:5	But thus shal ye deale with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and breake downe their images, and cut downe their groues, and burne their grauen images with fire.
dt.7.6	Deuteronomy 7:6	For thou art an holy people vnto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people vnto himselfe, aboue all people that are vpon the face of the earth.
dt.7.7	Deuteronomy 7:7	The LORD did not set his loue vpon you, nor choose you, because yee were moe in number then any people: (for ye were the fewest of all people,)
dt.7.8	Deuteronomy 7:8	But because the LORD loued you, and because hee would keepe the othe which hee had sworne vnto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
dt.7.9	Deuteronomy 7:9	Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithfull God, which keepeth Couenant and Mercy with them that loue him, and keepe his Commandements, to a thousand generations;

dt.7.12	Deuteronomy 7:12	¶ Wherefore it shal come to passe, if ye hearken to these iudgements, and keepe and do them: That the LORD thy God shall keepe vnto thee the Couenant and the Mercy which he sware vnto thy fathers.
dt.7.13	Deuteronomy 7:13	And hee will loue thee, and blesse thee, and multiply thee: Hee will also blesse the fruit of thy wombe, and the fruit of thy land, thy corne, and thy wine, and thine oile, the encrease of thy kine, and the flockes of thy sheepe, in the land which hee sware vnto thy fathers to giue thee.
dt.7.14	Deuteronomy 7:14	Thou shalt bee blessed aboue all people: there shall not bee male or female barren among you or among your cattell.
dt.7.15	Deuteronomy 7:15	And the LORD will take away from thee all sickenesse, and will put none of the euill diseases of Egypt (which thou knowest) vpon thee: but will lay them vpon all them that hate thee.
dt.7.16	Deuteronomy 7:16	And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliuer thee: thine eye shall haue no pitie vpon them, neither shalt thou serue their gods, for that will be a snare vnto thee.
dt.7.17	Deuteronomy 7:17	If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are moe then I, howe can I dispossesse them?

dt.7.23	Deuteronomy 7:23	But the LORD thy God shall deliuer them vnto thee, and shall destroy them with a mightie destruction, vntill they be destroyed.
dt.7.24	Deuteronomy 7:24	And he shall deliuer their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from vnder heauen: There shal no man be able to stand before thee, vntil thou haue destroyed them.

dt.7.26	Deuteronomy 7:26	Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou bee a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt vtterly detest it, and thou shalt vtterly abhorre it, for it is a cursed thing.
dt.8.1	Deuteronomy 8:1	All the commaundements which I commaund thee this day, shall yee obserue to doe, that yee may liue, and multiply, and goe in, and possesse the land which the LORD sware vnto your fathers.
dt.8.2	Deuteronomy 8:2	And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these fourtie yeeres in the wildernesse, to humble thee, and to proue thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keepe his commandements, or no.
dt.8.3	Deuteronomy 8:3	And he humbled thee, and suffred thee to hunger, and fed thee with Manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know: that he might make thee know, that man doth not liue by bread onely, but by euery word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man liue.
dt.8.4	Deuteronomy 8:4	Thy raiment waxed not old vpon thee, neither did thy foote swell these fourtie yeeres.

dt.8.9	Deuteronomy 8:9	A lande wherein thou shalt eate bread without scarcenes, thou shalt not lacke any thing in it: a lande whose stones are yron, and out of whose hils thou mayest digge brasse.
dt.8.10	Deuteronomy 8:10	When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt blesse the LORD thy God, for the good lande which hee hath giuen thee.

dt.8.12	Deuteronomy 8:12	Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
dt.8.13	Deuteronomy 8:13	And when thy heards and thy flocks multiply, and thy siluer and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied:
dt.8.14	Deuteronomy 8:14	Then thine heart bee lifted vp, and thou forget the LORD thy God (which brought thee foorth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage,
dt.8.15	Deuteronomy 8:15	Who led thee through that great and terrible wildernesse, wherein were fierie serpents, and scorpions, & drought, where there was no water, who brought thee foorth water out of the rocke of flint,
dt.8.16	Deuteronomy 8:16	Who fed thee in the wildernesse with Manna, which thy fathers knew not, that hee might humble thee, and that hee might prooue thee, to doe thee good at thy latter end:)
dt.8.17	Deuteronomy 8:17	And thou say in thine heart, My power, and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.

dt.9.29	Deuteronomy 9:29	Yet they are thy people, and thine inheritance which thou broughtest out by thy mightie power, and by thy stretched out arme.

dt.10.5	Deuteronomy 10:5	And I turned my selfe and came downe from the mount, and put the Tables in the Arke which I had made, and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
