mt.18.26	Matthew 18:26	The seruant therfore fell downe, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, haue patience with mee, and I will pay thee all.
mt.18.27	Matthew 18:27	Then the Lord of that seruant was moued with compassion, and loosed him, and forgaue him the debt.
mt.18.28	Matthew 18:28	But the same seruant went out, and found one of his fellow-seruants, which ought him an hundred pence: and hee layd handes on him, and tooke him by the throte, saying, Pay mee that thou owest.
mt.18.29	Matthew 18:29	And his fellow seruant fell downe at his feete, and besought him, saying, Haue patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
mt.18.30	Matthew 18:30	And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till hee should pay the debt.
mt.18.31	Matthew 18:31	So when his fellow-seruants saw what was done, they were very sorie, and came, and told vnto their lord all that was done.
mt.18.32	Matthew 18:32	Then his lord, after that hee had called him, said vnto him, O thou wicked seruant, I forgaue thee all that debt because thou desiredst me:
mt.18.33	Matthew 18:33	Shouldest not thou also haue had compassion on thy fellow-seruant, euen as I had pitie on thee?
mt.18.34	Matthew 18:34	And his lord was wroth, and deliuered him to the tormentors, till hee should pay all that was due vnto him.

mt.21.26	Matthew 21:26	But if we shall say, Of men, we feare the people, for all hold Iohn as a Prophet.
mt.21.27	Matthew 21:27	And they answered Iesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said vnto them, Neither tell I you by what authoritie I doe these things.
mt.21.28	Matthew 21:28	¶ But what thinke you? A certaine man had two sonnes, and he came to the first, and said, Sonne, goe worke to day in my vineyard.
mt.21.29	Matthew 21:29	He answered, & said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
mt.21.30	Matthew 21:30	And hee came to the second, and said likewise: and hee answered, and said, I goe sir, and went not.
mt.21.31	Matthew 21:31	Whether of them twaine did the will of his father? They say vnto him, The first. Iesus saith vnto them, Uerely I say vnto you, that the Publicanes and the harlots go into the kingdome of God before you.
mt.21.32	Matthew 21:32	For Iohn came vnto you in the way of righteousnesse, and ye beleeued him not: but the Publicanes and the harlots beleeued him. And ye when ye had seene it, repented not afterward, that ye might beleeue him.
mt.21.33	Matthew 21:33	¶ Heare another parable. There was a certaine house-holder, which planted a Uineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a wine-presse in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a farre countrey.
mt.21.34	Matthew 21:34	And when the time of the fruite drew neere, he sent his seruants to the husbandmen, that they might receiue the fruits of it.
mt.21.35	Matthew 21:35	And the husbandmen tooke his seruants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
mt.21.36	Matthew 21:36	Againe hee sent other seruants, moe then the first, and they did vnto them likewise.
mt.21.37	Matthew 21:37	But last of all, he sent vnto them his sonne, saying, They will reuerence my sonne.
mt.21.38	Matthew 21:38	But when the husbandmen saw the sonne, they said among themselues, This is the heire, come, let vs kill him, and let vs sease on his inheritance.
mt.21.39	Matthew 21:39	And they caught him, and cast him out of the Uineyard, and slew him.
mt.21.40	Matthew 21:40	When the Lord therefore of the Uineyard commeth, what will he doe vnto those husbandmen?
mt.21.41	Matthew 21:41	They say vnto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his Uineyard vnto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
mt.21.42	Matthew 21:42	Iesus saith vnto them, Did ye neuer reade in the Scriptures, The stone which the builders reiected, the same is become the head of the corner? This is the Lords doing, and it is marueilous in our eyes.
mt.21.43	Matthew 21:43	Therefore say I vnto you, the kingdome of God shall be taken from you, and giuen to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
mt.21.44	Matthew 21:44	And whosoeuer shall fall on this stone, shalbe broken: but on whom soeuer it shall fall, it will grinde him to powder.
mt.21.45	Matthew 21:45	And when the chiefe Priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceiued that he spake of them.
mt.21.46	Matthew 21:46	But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they tooke him for a Prophet.
mt.22.1	Matthew 22:1	And Iesus answered, and spake vnto them againe by parables, and said,
mt.22.2	Matthew 22:2	The Kingdome of heauen is like vnto a certaine King, which made a marriage for his sonne,
mt.22.3	Matthew 22:3	And sent forth his seruants to call them that were bidden to the wedding, and they would not come.
mt.22.4	Matthew 22:4	Againe, hee sent foorth other seruants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Beholde, I haue prepared my dinner; my oxen, and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come vnto the marriage.
mt.22.5	Matthew 22:5	But they made light of it, and went their wayes, one to his farme, another to his merchandize:
mt.22.6	Matthew 22:6	And the remnant tooke his seruants, and intreated them spitefully, and slew them.
mt.22.7	Matthew 22:7	But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth, and hee sent foorth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burnt vp their citie.
mt.22.8	Matthew 22:8	Then saith hee to his seruants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden, were not worthy.
mt.22.9	Matthew 22:9	Goe yee therefore into the high wayes, and as many as yee shall finde, bid to the marriage.
mt.22.10	Matthew 22:10	So those seruants went out into the high wayes, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good, and the wedding was furnished with ghests.
mt.22.11	Matthew 22:11	¶ And when the King came in to see the guests, hee sawe there a man, which had not on a wedding garment,
mt.22.12	Matthew 22:12	And hee sayth vnto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither, not hauing a wedding garment? And hee was speechlesse.
mt.22.13	Matthew 22:13	Then said the king to the seruants, Binde him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkenesse, there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
mt.22.14	Matthew 22:14	For many are called, but few are chosen.
mt.22.15	Matthew 22:15	¶ Then went the Pharises, and tooke counsell, how they might intangle him in his talke.
mt.22.16	Matthew 22:16	And they sent out vnto him their disciples, with the Herodians, saying, Master, wee know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in trueth, neither carest thou for any man; for thou regardest not the person of men.
mt.22.17	Matthew 22:17	Tell vs therefore, what thinkest thou? Is it lawfull to giue tribute vnto Cesar, or not?
mt.22.18	Matthew 22:18	But Iesus perceiued their wickednesse, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
mt.22.19	Matthew 22:19	Shew me the tribute money. And they brought vnto him a peny.
mt.22.20	Matthew 22:20	And he sayth vnto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
mt.22.21	Matthew 22:21	They say vnto him, Cesars. Then sayth he vnto them, Render therefore vnto Cesar, the things which are Cesars: and vnto God, the things that are Gods.
mt.22.22	Matthew 22:22	When they had heard these wordes, they marueiled, and left him, and went their way.
mt.22.23	Matthew 22:23	¶ The same day came to him the Sadduces, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
mt.22.24	Matthew 22:24	Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, hauing no children, his brother shall marrie his wife, and raise vp seed vnto his brother.
mt.22.25	Matthew 22:25	Now there were with vs seuen brethren, and the first when he had maried a wife, deceased, and hauing no issue, left his wife vnto his brother.
mt.22.26	Matthew 22:26	Likewise the second also, and the third, vnto the seuenth.
mt.22.27	Matthew 22:27	And last of al the woman died also.
mt.22.28	Matthew 22:28	Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife shall she be of the seuen? for they all had her.
mt.22.29	Matthew 22:29	Iesus answered, and said vnto them, Yee doe erre, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
mt.22.30	Matthew 22:30	For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are giuen in marriage, but are as the Angels of God in heauen.
mt.22.31	Matthew 22:31	But as touching the resurrection of the dead, haue ye not read that which was spoken vnto you by God, saying,
mt.22.32	Matthew 22:32	I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Iacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the liuing.
mt.22.33	Matthew 22:33	And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
mt.22.34	Matthew 22:34	¶ But when the Pharises had heard that he had put the Sadduces to silence, they were gathered together.
mt.22.35	Matthew 22:35	Then one of them, which was a Lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
mt.22.36	Matthew 22:36	Master, which is the great Commandement in the Law?
mt.22.37	Matthew 22:37	Iesus sayd vnto him, Thou shalt loue the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soule, and with all thy minde.
mt.22.38	Matthew 22:38	This is the first and great Commandement.
mt.22.39	Matthew 22:39	And the second is like vnto it, Thou shalt loue thy neighbour as thy selfe.
mt.22.40	Matthew 22:40	On these two Commandements hang all the Law and the Prophets.
mt.22.41	Matthew 22:41	¶ While the Pharises were gathered together, Iesus asked them,
mt.22.42	Matthew 22:42	Saying, What thinke yee of Christ? whose sonne is hee? They say vnto him, The sonne of Dauid.
mt.22.43	Matthew 22:43	He saith vnto them, How then doth Dauid in spirit call him Lord, saying,
mt.22.44	Matthew 22:44	The LORD said vnto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstoole?
mt.22.45	Matthew 22:45	If Dauid then call him Lord, how is he his sonne?
mt.22.46	Matthew 22:46	And no man was able to answere him a word, neither durst any man (from that day foorth) aske him any moe questions.
mt.23.1	Matthew 23:1	Then spake Iesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
mt.23.2	Matthew 23:2	Saying, The Scribes and the Pharises sit in Moses seate:
mt.23.3	Matthew 23:3	All therefore whatsoeuer they bid you obserue, that obserue and doe, but doe not ye after their workes: for they say, and doe not.
mt.23.4	Matthew 23:4	For they binde heauie burdens, and grieuous to be borne, and lay them on mens shoulders, but they themselues will not mooue them with one of their fingers.
mt.23.5	Matthew 23:5	But all their workes they doe, for to be seene of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
mt.23.6	Matthew 23:6	And loue the vppermost roomes at feasts, and the chiefe seats in the Synagogues,
mt.23.7	Matthew 23:7	And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
mt.23.8	Matthew 23:8	But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, euen Christ, and all ye are brethren.
mt.23.9	Matthew 23:9	And call no man your father vpon the earth: for one is your father which is in heauen.
mt.23.10	Matthew 23:10	Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, euen Christ.
mt.23.11	Matthew 23:11	But hee that is greatest among you, shall be your seruant.
mt.23.12	Matthew 23:12	And whosoeuer shall exalt himselfe, shall be abased: and he that shall humble himselfe, shall be exalted.
mt.23.13	Matthew 23:13	¶ But woe vnto you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for yee shut vp the kingdom of heauen against men: For yee neither goe in your selues, neither suffer ye them that are entring, to goe in.
mt.23.14	Matthew 23:14	Woe vnto you Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for yee deuoure widowes houses, and for a pretence make long prayer; therefore ye shall receiue the greater damnation.
mt.23.15	Matthew 23:15	Woe vnto you Scribes and Pharises, hypocrites; for yee compasse Sea and land to make one Proselyte, and when hee is made, yee make him two fold more the childe of hell then your selues.
mt.23.16	Matthew 23:16	Woe vnto you, yee blind guides, which say, Whosoeuer shall sweare by the Temple, it is nothing: but whosoeuer shal sweare by the gold of the Temple, he is a debter.
mt.23.17	Matthew 23:17	Ye fooles and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the Temple that sanctifieth the gold?
mt.23.18	Matthew 23:18	And whosoeuer shall sweare by the Altar, it is nothing: but whosoeuer sweareth by the gift that is vpon it, he is guiltie.
mt.23.19	Matthew 23:19	Ye fooles and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the Altar that sanctifieth the gift?
mt.23.20	Matthew 23:20	Who so therefore shall sweare by the Altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
mt.23.21	Matthew 23:21	And who so shall sweare by the Temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
mt.23.22	Matthew 23:22	And he that shall sweare by heauen, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
mt.23.23	Matthew 23:23	Woe vnto you Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for yee pay tithe of mint, and annise, and cummine, and haue omitted the weightier matters of the Law, iudgement, mercie and faith: these ought ye to haue done, and not to leaue the other vndone.
mt.23.24	Matthew 23:24	Ye blind guides, which straine at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
mt.23.25	Matthew 23:25	Woe vnto you Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; for yee make cleane the outside of the cup, and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excesse.
mt.23.26	Matthew 23:26	Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may bee cleane also.
mt.23.27	Matthew 23:27	Woe vnto you Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, for yee are like vnto whited sepulchres, which indeed appeare beautifull outward, but are within full of dead mens bones, and of all vncleannesse.
mt.23.28	Matthew 23:28	Euen so, yee also outwardly appeare righteous vnto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisie and iniquitie.
mt.23.29	Matthew 23:29	Woe vnto you Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because ye build the tombes of the Prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
mt.23.30	Matthew 23:30	And say, If wee had beene in the dayes of our fathers, wee would not haue bene partakers with them in the blood of the Prophets.
mt.23.31	Matthew 23:31	Wherefore ye bee witnesses vnto your selues, that yee are the children of them which killed the Prophets.
mt.23.32	Matthew 23:32	Fil ye vp then the measure of your fathers.
mt.23.33	Matthew 23:33	Yee serpents, yee generation of vipers, How can yee escape the damnation of hell?
mt.23.34	Matthew 23:34	¶ Wherefore behold, I send vnto you Prophets, and wisemen, and Scribes, and some of them yee shall kill and crucifie, and some of them shall yee scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from citie to citie:
mt.23.35	Matthew 23:35	That vpon you may come all the righteous blood shed vpon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel, vnto the blood of Zacharias, sonne of Barachias, whom yee slew betweene the temple and the altar.
mt.23.36	Matthew 23:36	Uerily I say vnto you, All these things shal come vpon this generation.
mt.23.37	Matthew 23:37	O Hierusalem, Hierusalem, thou that killest the Prophets, and stonest them which are sent vnto thee, how often would I haue gathered thy children together, euen as a hen gathereth her chickens vnder her wings, and yee would not?
mt.23.38	Matthew 23:38	Behold, your house is left vnto you desolate.
mt.23.39	Matthew 23:39	For I say vnto you, yee shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that commeth in the Name of the Lord.
mt.24.1	Matthew 24:1	And Iesus went out, and departed from the temple, and his Disciples came to him, for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
mt.24.2	Matthew 24:2	And Iesus said vnto them, See yee not all these things? Uerily I say vnto you, there shall not be left heere one stone vpon another, that shall not be throwen downe.
mt.24.3	Matthew 24:3	¶ And as he sate vpon the mount of Oliues, the Disciples came vnto him priuately, saying, Tell vs, when shall these things be? And what shall be the signe of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
mt.24.4	Matthew 24:4	And Iesus answered, and said vnto them, Take heed that no man deceiue you.
mt.24.5	Matthew 24:5	For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ: and shall deceiue many.
mt.24.6	Matthew 24:6	And yee shall heare of warres, and rumors of warres: See that yee be not troubled: for all these things must come to passe, but the end is not yet.
mt.24.7	Matthew 24:7	For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdome against kingdome, and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes in diuers places.
mt.24.8	Matthew 24:8	All these are the beginning of sorrowes.
mt.24.9	Matthew 24:9	Then shall they deliuer you vp to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and yee shall bee hated of all nations for my names sake.
mt.24.10	Matthew 24:10	And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
mt.24.11	Matthew 24:11	And many false Prophets shall rise, and shall deceiue many.
mt.24.12	Matthew 24:12	And because iniquitie shal abound, the loue of many shall waxe cold.
mt.24.13	Matthew 24:13	But he that shall endure vnto the end, the same shall be saued.
mt.24.14	Matthew 24:14	And this Gospell of the kingdome shall be preached in all the world, for a witnesse vnto al nations, and then shall the end come.
mt.24.15	Matthew 24:15	When yee therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the Prophet, stand in the holy place, (who so readeth, let him vnderstand.)
mt.24.16	Matthew 24:16	Then let them which be in Iudea, flee into the mountaines.
mt.24.17	Matthew 24:17	Let him which is on the house top, not come downe, to take any thing out of his house:
mt.24.18	Matthew 24:18	Neither let him which is in the field, returne backe to take his clothes.
mt.24.19	Matthew 24:19	And woe vnto them that are with child, and to them that giue sucke in those dayes.
mt.24.20	Matthew 24:20	But pray yee that your flight bee not in the winter, neither on the Sabbath day:
mt.24.21	Matthew 24:21	For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor euer shall be.
mt.24.22	Matthew 24:22	And except those dayes should be shortned, there should no flesh be saued: but for the elects sake, those dayes shall be shortned.
mt.24.23	Matthew 24:23	Then if any man shall say vnto you, Loe, heere is Christ, or there: beleeue it not.
mt.24.24	Matthew 24:24	For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shal shew great signes and wonders: insomuch that (if it were possible,) they shall deceiue the very elect.
mt.24.25	Matthew 24:25	Behold, I haue told you before.
mt.24.26	Matthew 24:26	Wherefore, if they shall say vnto you, Behold, he is in the desert, goe not foorth: Behold, he is in the secret chambers, beleeue it not.
mt.24.27	Matthew 24:27	For as the lightening commeth out of the East, and shineth euen vnto the West: so shall also the coming of the Sonne of man be.
mt.24.28	Matthew 24:28	For wheresoeuer the carkeise is, there will the Eagles bee gathered together.
mt.24.29	Matthew 24:29	¶ Immediately after the tribulation of those dayes, shall the Sunne be darkned, and the Moone shall not giue her light, and the starres shall fall from heauen, and the powers of the heauens shall be shaken.
mt.24.30	Matthew 24:30	And then shall appeare the signe of the Sonne of man in heauen: and then shall all the Tribes of the earth mourne, and they shall see the Sonne of man coming in the clouds of heauen, with power and great glory.
mt.24.31	Matthew 24:31	And hee shall send his Angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his Elect from the foure windes, from one end of heauen to the other.
mt.24.32	Matthew 24:32	Now learne a parable of the figtree: when his branch is yet tender, and putteth foorth leaues, yee know that Summer is nigh:
mt.24.33	Matthew 24:33	So likewise yee, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is neere, euen at the doores.
mt.24.34	Matthew 24:34	Uerely I say vnto you, this generation shall not passe, till all these things be fulfilled.
mt.24.35	Matthew 24:35	Heauen and earth shall passe away, but my wordes shall not passe away.
mt.24.36	Matthew 24:36	¶ But of that day and houre knoweth no man, no, not the Angels of heauen, but my Father onely.
mt.24.37	Matthew 24:37	But as the dayes of Noe were, so shall also the comming of the Sonne of man be.
mt.24.38	Matthew 24:38	For as in the dayes that were before the Flood, they were eating, and drinking, marrying, and giuing in mariage, vntill the day that Noe entred into the Arke,
mt.24.39	Matthew 24:39	And knew not vntill the Flood came, and tooke them all away: so shall also the comming of the Sonne of man be.
mt.24.40	Matthew 24:40	Then shall two be in the field, the one shalbe taken, and the other left.
mt.24.41	Matthew 24:41	Two women shall be grinding at the mill: the one shall be taken, and the other left.
mt.24.42	Matthew 24:42	¶ Watch therfore, for ye know not what houre your Lord doth come.
mt.24.43	Matthew 24:43	But know this, that if the good man of the house had knowen in what watch the thiefe would come, he would haue watched, and would not haue suffered his house to be broken vp.
mt.24.44	Matthew 24:44	Therefore be yee also ready: for in such an houre as you thinke not, the sonne of man commeth.
mt.24.45	Matthew 24:45	Who then is a faithfull and wise seruant, whom his Lord hath made ruler ouer his houshold, to giue them meat in due season?
mt.24.46	Matthew 24:46	Blessed is that seruant, whome his Lord when he commeth, shall finde so doing.
mt.24.47	Matthew 24:47	Uerely I say vnto you, that hee shal make him ruler ouer all his goods.
mt.24.48	Matthew 24:48	But and if that euill seruant shal say in his heart, My Lord delayeth his comming,

mt.24.50	Matthew 24:50	The Lord of that seruant shall come in a day when hee looketh not for him, and in an houre that hee is not ware of:
mt.24.51	Matthew 24:51	And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
mt.25.1	Matthew 25:1	Then shall the kingdome of heauen be likened vnto ten Uirgins, which tooke their lamps, & went forth to meet the bridegrome.

mt.25.3	Matthew 25:3	They that were foolish tooke their lampes, and tooke no oyle with them:
mt.25.4	Matthew 25:4	But the wise tooke oyle in their vessels with their lampes.
mt.25.5	Matthew 25:5	While the bridegrome taried, they all slumbred and slept.
mt.25.6	Matthew 25:6	And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegrome commeth, goe ye out to meet him.
mt.25.7	Matthew 25:7	Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lampes.

mt.25.13	Matthew 25:13	Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day, nor the houre, wherein the Sonne of man commeth.
mt.25.14	Matthew 25:14	¶ For the kingdome of heauen is as a man trauailing into a farre countrey, who called his owne seruants, and deliuered vnto them his goods:
mt.25.15	Matthew 25:15	And vnto one he gaue fiue talents, to another two, and to another one, to euery man according to his seuerall ability, & straightway tooke his iourney.
mt.25.16	Matthew 25:16	Then hee that had receiued the fiue talents, went and traded with the same, and made them other fiue talents.
mt.25.17	Matthew 25:17	And likewise he that had receiued two, he also gained other two.
mt.25.18	Matthew 25:18	But hee that had receiued one, went and digged in the earth, and hid his lordes money.
mt.25.19	Matthew 25:19	After a long time, the lord of those seruants commeth, and reckoneth with them.
mt.25.20	Matthew 25:20	And so hee that had receiued fiue talents, came and brought other fiue talents, saying, Lord, thou deliueredst vnto me fiue talents, behold, I haue gained besides them, fiue talents moe.
mt.25.21	Matthew 25:21	His lord said vnto him, Well done, thou good and faithfull seruant, thou hast been faithfull ouer a few things, I wil make thee ruler ouer many things: enter thou into the ioy of thy lord.
mt.25.22	Matthew 25:22	He also that had receiued two talents, came and said, Lord, thou deliueredst vnto me two talents: behold, I haue gained two other talents besides them.
mt.25.23	Matthew 25:23	His lord said vnto him, Well done, good and faithfull seruant, thou hast beene faithfull ouer a few things, I wil make thee ruler ouer many things: enter thou into the ioy of thy lord.
mt.25.24	Matthew 25:24	Then he which had receiued the one talent, came & said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sowen, & gathering where thou hast not strawed:
mt.25.25	Matthew 25:25	And I was afraid, and went and hidde thy talent in the earth: loe, there thou hast that is thine.
mt.25.26	Matthew 25:26	His lord answered, and said vnto him, Thou wicked and slouthfull seruant, thou knewest that I reape where I sowed not, and gather where I haue not strawed:
mt.25.27	Matthew 25:27	Thou oughtest therefore to haue put my money to the exchangers, and then at my comming I should haue receiued mine owne with vsurie.
mt.25.28	Matthew 25:28	Take therefore the talent from him, and giue it vnto him which hath ten talents.
mt.25.29	Matthew 25:29	For vnto euery one that hath shall be giuen, and he shall haue abundance: but from him that hath not, shal be taken away, euen that which he hath.
mt.25.30	Matthew 25:30	And cast yee the vnprofitable seruant into outer darkenesse, there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
mt.25.31	Matthew 25:31	¶ When the Sonne of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy Angels with him, then shall hee sit vpon the throne of his glory:
mt.25.32	Matthew 25:32	And before him shall be gathered all nations, and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepheard diuideth his sheepe from the goats.
mt.25.33	Matthew 25:33	And he shall set the sheepe on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
mt.25.34	Matthew 25:34	Then shall the King say vnto them on his right hand, Come ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdome prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
mt.25.35	Matthew 25:35	For I was an hungred, and yee gaue me meate: I was thirstie, and ye gaue me drinke: I was a stranger, and ye tooke me in:
mt.25.36	Matthew 25:36	Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sicke, and yee visited me: I was in prison, and ye came vnto me.
mt.25.37	Matthew 25:37	Then shal the righteous answere him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fedde thee? or thirstie, and gaue thee drinke?
mt.25.38	Matthew 25:38	When saw wee thee a stranger, and tooke thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
mt.25.39	Matthew 25:39	Or when saw we thee sicke, or in prison, and came vnto thee?
mt.25.40	Matthew 25:40	And the King shall answere, and say vnto them, Uerely I say vnto you, in as much as ye haue done it vnto one of the least of these my brethren, ye haue done it vnto me.
mt.25.41	Matthew 25:41	Then shall he say also vnto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into euerlasting fire, prepared for the deuill and his angels.
mt.25.42	Matthew 25:42	For I was an hungred, and yee gaue me no meat: I was thirstie, and ye gaue me no drinke:
mt.25.43	Matthew 25:43	I was a stranger, and yee tooke me not in: naked, and ye clothed mee not: sicke, and in prison, and yee visited me not.
mt.25.44	Matthew 25:44	Then shall they also answere him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sicke, or in prison, and did not minister vnto thee?
mt.25.45	Matthew 25:45	Then shall he answere them, saying, Uerely, I say vnto you, in as much as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
mt.25.46	Matthew 25:46	And these shall goe away into euerlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternall.
mt.26.1	Matthew 26:1	And it came to passe, when Iesus had finished al these sayings, hee said vnto his disciples,
mt.26.2	Matthew 26:2	Ye know that after two dayes is the feast of the Passeouer, and the Sonne of man is betrayed to be crucified.
mt.26.3	Matthew 26:3	Then assembled together the chiefe Priests, and the Scribes, and the Elders of the people, vnto the palace of the high Priest, who was called Caiaphas,
mt.26.4	Matthew 26:4	And consulted that they might take Iesus by subtiltie, and kill him.
mt.26.5	Matthew 26:5	But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there bee an vproare among the people.
mt.26.6	Matthew 26:6	¶ Now when Iesus was in Bethanie, in the house of Simon the leper,
mt.26.7	Matthew 26:7	There came vnto him a woman, hauing an alabaster boxe of very precious ointment, and powred it on his head, as he sate at meat.
mt.26.8	Matthew 26:8	But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
mt.26.9	Matthew 26:9	For this ointment might haue bin sold for much, and giuen to the poore.
mt.26.10	Matthew 26:10	When Iesus vnderstood it, he said vnto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good worke vpon me.
mt.26.11	Matthew 26:11	For ye haue the poore alwayes with you, but me ye haue not alwayes.
mt.26.12	Matthew 26:12	For in that she hath powred this ointment on my body, shee did it for my buriall.
mt.26.13	Matthew 26:13	Uerely I say vnto you, Wheresoeuer this Gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memoriall of her.
mt.26.14	Matthew 26:14	¶ Then one of the twelue, called Iudas Iscariot, went vnto the chiefe Priests,
mt.26.15	Matthew 26:15	And said vnto them, What will ye giue me, and I will deliuer him vnto you? and they couenanted with him for thirtie pieces of siluer.
mt.26.16	Matthew 26:16	And from that time he sought opportunitie to betray him.
mt.26.17	Matthew 26:17	¶ Now the first day of the feast of vnleauened bread, the disciples came to Iesus, saying vnto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the Passeouer?
mt.26.18	Matthew 26:18	And he said, Goe into the citie to such a man, and say vnto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand, I will keepe the Passeouer at thy house with my disciples.
mt.26.19	Matthew 26:19	And the disciples did, as Iesus had appointed them, and they made ready the Passeouer.
mt.26.20	Matthew 26:20	Now when the euen was come, he sate downe with the twelue.
mt.26.21	Matthew 26:21	And as they did eate, he said, Uerely I say vnto you, that one of you shal betray me.
mt.26.22	Matthew 26:22	And they were exceeding sorowfull, and began euery one of them to say vnto him, Lord, Is it I?
mt.26.23	Matthew 26:23	And he answered and said, Hee that dippeth his hand with mee in the dish, the same shall betray me.
mt.26.24	Matthew 26:24	The sonne of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe vnto that man by whom the sonne of man is betrayed: It had bin good for that man, if hee had not bene borne.
mt.26.25	Matthew 26:25	Then Iudas, which betrayed him, answered, and said, Master, Is it I? He said vnto him, Thou hast said.
mt.26.26	Matthew 26:26	¶ And as they were eating, Iesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gaue it to the Disciples, and said, Take, eate, this is my body.
mt.26.27	Matthew 26:27	And he tooke the cup, and gaue thankes, and gaue it to them, saying, Drinke ye all of it:
mt.26.28	Matthew 26:28	For this is my blood of the new Testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sinnes.
mt.26.29	Matthew 26:29	But I say vnto you, I will not drinke henceforth of this fruite of the vine, vntill that day when I drinke it new with you in my fathers kingdom.
mt.26.30	Matthew 26:30	And when they had sung an hymne, they went out into the mount of Oliues.
mt.26.31	Matthew 26:31	Then saith Iesus vnto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night, For it is written, I will smite the Shepheard, and the sheepe of the flocke shall be scattered abroad.
mt.26.32	Matthew 26:32	But after I am risen againe, I will goe before you into Galilee.
mt.26.33	Matthew 26:33	Peter answered, and said vnto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I neuer be offended.
mt.26.34	Matthew 26:34	Iesus said vnto him, Uerily I say vnto thee, that this might before the cocke crow, thou shalt denie me thrise.
mt.26.35	Matthew 26:35	Peter said vnto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not denie thee. Likewise also said all the Disciples.
mt.26.36	Matthew 26:36	¶ Then commeth Iesus with them vnto a place called Gethsemane, and saith vnto the Disciples, Sit yee heere, while I goe and pray yonder.
mt.26.37	Matthew 26:37	And hee tooke with him Peter, and the two sonnes of Zebedee, and beganne to be sorrowful, and very heauie.
mt.26.38	Matthew 26:38	Then saith he vnto them, My soule is exceeding sorrowfull, euen vnto death: tary ye heere, & watch with me.
mt.26.39	Matthew 26:39	And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my father, if it be possible, let this cup passe from me: neuerthelesse, not as I will, but as thou wilt.
mt.26.40	Matthew 26:40	And he commeth vnto the Disciples, and findeth them asleepe, and saith vnto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one houre?
mt.26.41	Matthew 26:41	Watch and pray, that yee enter not into temptation: The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weake.
mt.26.42	Matthew 26:42	He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my father, if this cup may not passe away from me, except I drinke it, thy will be done.
mt.26.43	Matthew 26:43	And he came and found them asleep againe: For their eies were heauie.
mt.26.44	Matthew 26:44	And he left them, and went away againe, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
mt.26.45	Matthew 26:45	Then commeth he to his Disciples, and saith vnto them, Sleepe on now, and take your rest, behold, the houre is at hand, and the sonne of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
mt.26.46	Matthew 26:46	Rise, let vs be going: behold, he is at hand that doeth betray me.
mt.26.47	Matthew 26:47	¶ And while yet spake, loe, Iudas one of the twelue came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staues from the chiefe Priests and Elders of the people.
mt.26.48	Matthew 26:48	Now he that betrayed him, gaue them a signe, saying, Whomsoeuer I shall kisse, that same is he, hold him fast.
mt.26.49	Matthew 26:49	And forthwith hee came to Iesus, and said, Haile master, and kissed him.
mt.26.50	Matthew 26:50	And Iesus said vnto him, Friend, Wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid handes on Iesus, and tooke him.
mt.26.51	Matthew 26:51	And behold, one of them which were with Iesus, stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and stroke a seruant of the high Priests, and smote off his eare.
mt.26.52	Matthew 26:52	Then said Iesus vnto him, Put vp againe thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword, shall perish with the sword.
mt.26.53	Matthew 26:53	Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my father, and he shall presently giue me more then twelue legions of Angels?
mt.26.54	Matthew 26:54	But how then shall the Scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
mt.26.55	Matthew 26:55	In that same houre said Iesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thiefe with swords and staues for to take mee? I sate daily with you teaching in the Temple, and ye laide no hold on me.
mt.26.56	Matthew 26:56	But all this was done, that the Scriptures of the Prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the Disciples forsooke him, and fled:
mt.26.57	Matthew 26:57	¶ And they that had laid hold on Iesus, led him away to Caiaphas the high Priest, where the Scribes and the Elders were assembled.
mt.26.58	Matthew 26:58	But Peter followed him afarre off, vnto the high Priests palace, and went in, and sate with the seruants to see the end.
mt.26.59	Matthew 26:59	Now the chiefe Priests and Elders, and all the councell, sought false witnesse against Iesus to put him to death,
mt.26.60	Matthew 26:60	But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
mt.26.61	Matthew 26:61	And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the Temple of God, and to build it in three dayes.
mt.26.62	Matthew 26:62	And the high Priest arose, and said vnto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it, which these witnesse against thee?
mt.26.63	Matthew 26:63	But Iesus held his peace. And the high Priest answered, and said vnto him, I adiure thee by the liuing God, that thou tell vs, whether thou bee the Christ the Sonne of God.
mt.26.64	Matthew 26:64	Iesus saith vnto him, Thou hast saide: Neuerthelesse I say vnto you, Hereafter shall yee see the Sonne of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heauen.
mt.26.65	Matthew 26:65	Then the high Priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemie: what further need haue wee of witnesses? Behold, now ye haue heard his blasphemie.
mt.26.66	Matthew 26:66	What thinke ye? They answered and said, He is guiltie of death.
mt.26.67	Matthew 26:67	Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him, and others smote him with the palmes of their hands,
mt.26.68	Matthew 26:68	Saying, Prophecie vnto vs, thou Christ, who is he that smote thee?
mt.26.69	Matthew 26:69	¶ Now Peter sate without in the palace: and a damosell came vnto him, saying, Thou also wast with Iesus of Galilee.
mt.26.70	Matthew 26:70	But hee denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou saiest.
mt.26.71	Matthew 26:71	And when he was gone out into the porch, another maide saw him, and saide vnto them that were there, This fellow was also with Iesus of Nazareth.
mt.26.72	Matthew 26:72	And againe hee denied with an oath, I doe not know the man.
mt.26.73	Matthew 26:73	And after a while came vnto him they that stood by, and saide to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them, for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
mt.26.74	Matthew 26:74	Then beganne hee to curse and to sweare, saying, I know not the man. And immediatly the cocke crew.
mt.26.75	Matthew 26:75	And Peter remembred the words of Iesus, which said vnto him, Before the cocke crow, thou shalt denie mee thrice. And hee went out, and wept bitterly.
mt.27.1	Matthew 27:1	When the morning was come, all the chiefe Priests and Elders of the people, tooke counsell against Iesus to put him to death.
mt.27.2	Matthew 27:2	And when they had bound him, they led him away, and deliuered him to Pontius Pilate the gouernour.
mt.27.3	Matthew 27:3	¶ Then Iudas, which had betraied him, when he saw that hee was condemned, repented himselfe, and brought againe the thirtie pieces of siluer to the chiefe Priests and Elders,
mt.27.4	Matthew 27:4	Saying, I haue sinned, in that I haue betraied the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to vs? see thou to that.
mt.27.5	Matthew 27:5	And hee cast downe the pieces of siluer in the Temple, and departed, and went and hanged himselfe.
mt.27.6	Matthew 27:6	And the chiefe Priests tooke the siluer pieces, and said, It is not lawfull for to put them into the treasurie, because it is the price of blood.
mt.27.7	Matthew 27:7	And they tooke counsell, and bought with them the potters field, to burie strangers in.
mt.27.8	Matthew 27:8	Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood vnto this day.

mt.27.11	Matthew 27:11	And Iesus stood before the gouernour, and the gouernour asked him, saying; Art thou the King of the Iewes? And Iesus sayd vnto him, Thou sayest.
mt.27.12	Matthew 27:12	And when hee was accused of the chiefe Priests and Elders, he answered nothing.
mt.27.13	Matthew 27:13	Then saith Pilate vnto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witnesse against thee?
mt.27.14	Matthew 27:14	And he answered him to neuer a word: insomuch that the Gouernour marueiled greatly.
mt.27.15	Matthew 27:15	Now at that feast the Gouernor was woont to release vnto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
mt.27.16	Matthew 27:16	And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

mt.27.18	Matthew 27:18	For hee knew that for enuie they had deliuered him.
mt.27.19	Matthew 27:19	¶ When he was set downe on the Iudgement seate, his wife sent vnto him, saying, Haue thou nothing to doe with that iust man: for I haue suffered many things this day in a dreame, because of him.
mt.27.20	Matthew 27:20	But the chiefe Priestes and Elders perswaded the multitude that they should aske Barabbas, & destroy Iesus.
mt.27.21	Matthew 27:21	The Gouernour answered, and said vnto them, Whether of the twaine will ye that I release vnto you? They said, Barabbas.
mt.27.22	Matthew 27:22	Pilate said vnto them, What shall I doe then with Iesus, which is called Christ? They all sayde vnto him, Let him be crucified.
mt.27.23	Matthew 27:23	And the Gouernour said, Why, what euil hath he done? But they cried out þ more, saying, Let him be crucified.
mt.27.24	Matthew 27:24	¶ When Pilate saw that he could preuaile nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, hee tooke water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this iust person: see yee to it.
mt.27.25	Matthew 27:25	Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on vs, and on our children.
mt.27.26	Matthew 27:26	¶ Then released hee Barabbas vnto them, and when he had scourged Iesus, he deliuered him to be crucified.
mt.27.27	Matthew 27:27	Then the souldiers of the Gouernour tooke Iesus into the common hall, and gathered vnto him the whole band of souldiers.
mt.27.28	Matthew 27:28	And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
mt.27.29	Matthew 27:29	¶ And when they had platted a crowne of thornes, they put it vpon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Haile king of the Iewes.
mt.27.30	Matthew 27:30	And they spit vpon him, and tooke the reed, and smote him on the head.
mt.27.31	Matthew 27:31	And after that they had mocked him, they tooke the robe off from him, and put his owne raiment on him, and led him away to crucifie him.
mt.27.32	Matthew 27:32	And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to beare his Crosse.
mt.27.33	Matthew 27:33	And when they were come vnto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

mt.27.35	Matthew 27:35	And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Prophet, They parted my garments among them, and vpon my vesture did they cast lots.
mt.27.36	Matthew 27:36	And sitting downe, they watched him there:
mt.27.37	Matthew 27:37	And set vp ouer his head, his accusation written, THIS IS IESVS THE KING OF THE IEWES.
mt.27.38	Matthew 27:38	Then were there two theeues crucified with him: one on the right hand, and another on the left.
mt.27.39	Matthew 27:39	¶ And they that passed by, reuiled him, wagging their heads,
mt.27.40	Matthew 27:40	And saying, Thou that destroyest the Temple, & buildest it in three dayes, saue thy selfe: If thou be the Sonne of God, come downe from the Crosse.

mt.27.43	Matthew 27:43	He trusted in God, let him deliuer him now if hee will haue him: for he said, I am the Sonne of God.

mt.27.47	Matthew 27:47	Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
mt.27.48	Matthew 27:48	And straightway one of them ran, and tooke a spunge, and filled it with vineger, and put it on a reede, and gaue him to drinke.
mt.27.49	Matthew 27:49	The rest said, Let bee, let vs see whether Elias will come to saue him.
mt.27.50	Matthew 27:50	¶ Iesus, when hee had cried againe with a loud voice, yeelded vp the ghost.

mt.27.52	Matthew 27:52	And the graues were opened, and many bodies of Saints which slept, arose,

mt.27.54	Matthew 27:54	Now when the Centurion, and they that were with him, watching Iesus, saw the earthquake, & those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truely this was the Son of God.
mt.27.55	Matthew 27:55	And many women were there (beholding afarre off) which followed Iesus from Galilee, ministring vnto him.
mt.27.56	Matthew 27:56	Among which was Mary Magdalene, & Mary the mother of Iames and Ioses, and the mother of Zebedees children.
mt.27.57	Matthew 27:57	When the Euen was come, there came a rich man of Arimathea, named Ioseph, who also himselfe was Iesus disciple:
mt.27.58	Matthew 27:58	He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Iesus: then Pilate commanded the body to be deliuered.
mt.27.59	Matthew 27:59	And when Ioseph had taken the body, hee wrapped it in a cleane linnen cloth,
mt.27.60	Matthew 27:60	And laide it in his owne newe tombe, which he had hewen out in the rocke: and he rolled a great stone to the doore of the sepulchre, and departed.
mt.27.61	Matthew 27:61	And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting ouer against the sepulchre.
mt.27.62	Matthew 27:62	¶ Now the next day that followed the day of the preparation, the chiefe Priests and Pharisees came together vnto Pilate,
mt.27.63	Matthew 27:63	Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiuer said, while he was yet aliue, After three daies I wil rise againe.
mt.27.64	Matthew 27:64	Command therfore that the sepulchre be made sure, vntill the third day, lest his disciples come by night, & steale him away, and say vnto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last errour shalbe worse then the first.
mt.27.65	Matthew 27:65	Pilate said vnto them, Yee haue a watch, goe your way, make it as sure as you can.
mt.27.66	Matthew 27:66	So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
mt.28.1	Matthew 28:1	In the ende of the Sabbath, as it began to dawne towards the first day of the weeke, came Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, to see the sepulchre.
