lk.12.1	Luke 12:1	In the meane time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one vpon another, he began to say vnto his disciples first of all, Beware yee of the leauen of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisie.
lk.12.2	Luke 12:2	For there is nothing couered, that shall not be reuealed, neither hid, that shall not be knowen.
lk.12.3	Luke 12:3	Therefore, whatsoeuer yee haue spoken in darkenesse, shall bee heard in the light: and that which yee haue spoken in the eare, in closets, shal be proclaimed vpon the house tops.
lk.12.4	Luke 12:4	And I say vnto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that, haue no more that they can doe.
lk.12.5	Luke 12:5	But I will forewarne you whom you shall feare: Feare him, which after he hath killed, hath power to cast into hell, yea, I say vnto you, Feare him.
lk.12.6	Luke 12:6	Are not fiue sparrowes solde for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
lk.12.7	Luke 12:7	But euen the very haires of your head are all numbred: Feare not therefore, ye are of more value then many sparrowes.
lk.12.8	Luke 12:8	Also I say vnto you, Whosoeuer shall confesse me before men, him shall the Sonne of man also confesse before the Angels of God.
lk.12.9	Luke 12:9	But he that denieth me before men, shalbe denied before the Angels of God.
lk.12.10	Luke 12:10	And whosoeuer shall speake a word against the Sonne of man, it shall be forgiuen him: but vnto him that blasphemeth against the holy Ghost, it shal not be forgiuen.
lk.12.11	Luke 12:11	And when they bring you vnto the Synagogues, and vnto Magistrates, & powers, take yee no thought how or what thing ye shall answere, or what ye shall say:
lk.12.12	Luke 12:12	For the holy Ghost shal teach you in the same houre, what ye ought to say.
lk.12.13	Luke 12:13	¶ And one of the company saide vnto him, Master, speake to my brother, that he diuide the inheritance with me.
lk.12.14	Luke 12:14	And he said vnto him, Man, who made mee a iudge, or a diuider ouer you?
lk.12.15	Luke 12:15	And he said vnto them, Take heed and beware of couetousnes: for a mans life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
lk.12.16	Luke 12:16	And he spake a parable vnto them, saying, The ground of a certaine rich man brought foorth plentifully.
lk.12.17	Luke 12:17	And he thought within himselfe, saying, What shall I doe, because I haue no roome where to bestow my fruits?
lk.12.18	Luke 12:18	And he said, This will I doe, I will pull downe my barnes, and build greater, and there will I bestow all my fruits, and my goods.
lk.12.19	Luke 12:19	And I will say to my soule, Soule, thou hast much goods layd vp for many yeeres, take thine ease, eate, drinke, and be merry.
lk.12.20	Luke 12:20	But God said vnto him, Thou foole, this night thy soule shal be required of thee: then whose shal those things be which thou hast prouided?
lk.12.21	Luke 12:21	So is he that laieth vp treasure for himselfe, and is not rich towards God.
lk.12.22	Luke 12:22	¶ And he said vnto his disciples, Therefore I say vnto you, Take no thought for your life what yee shall eate, neither for the body what yee shall put on.
lk.12.23	Luke 12:23	The life is more then meate, and the body is more then raiment.
lk.12.24	Luke 12:24	Consider the rauens, for they neither sow nor reape, which neither haue storehouse nor barne, and God feedeth them: How much more are yee better then the foules?
lk.12.25	Luke 12:25	And which of you with taking thought can adde to his stature one cubite?
lk.12.26	Luke 12:26	If yee then bee not able to doe that thing which is least, why take yee thought for the rest?
lk.12.27	Luke 12:27	Consider the Lillies how they growe, they toile not; they spinne not: and yet I say vnto you, that Solomon in all his glory, was not arayed like one of these.
lk.12.28	Luke 12:28	If then God so clothe the grasse, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the ouen: how much more will he clothe you, O ye of litle faith?
lk.12.29	Luke 12:29	And seeke not yee what yee shall eate, or what ye shall drinke, neither be ye of doubtfull minde.
lk.12.30	Luke 12:30	For all these things doe the nations of the world seeke after: and your father knoweth that yee haue neede of these things.
lk.12.31	Luke 12:31	¶ But rather seeke yee the kingdome of God, and all these things shall be added vnto you.
lk.12.32	Luke 12:32	Feare not, litle flocke, for it is your fathers good pleasure to giue you the kingdome.
lk.12.33	Luke 12:33	Sell that yee haue, and giue almes: prouide your selues bagges which waxe not old, a treasure in the heauens that faileth not, where no theefe approcheth, neither moth corrupteth.
lk.12.34	Luke 12:34	For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
lk.12.35	Luke 12:35	Let your loines be girded about, and your lights burning,
lk.12.36	Luke 12:36	And ye your selues like vnto men that waite for their Lord, when he will returne from the wedding, that when he commeth and knocketh, they may open vnto him immediately.
lk.12.37	Luke 12:37	Blessed are those seruants, whom the Lord when he commeth, shall find watching: Uerily, I say vnto you, That he shall girde himselfe, and make them to sit downe to meate, and will come foorth and serue them.
lk.12.38	Luke 12:38	And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those seruants.
lk.12.39	Luke 12:39	And this know, that if the good man of the house had knowen what houre the theefe would come, he would haue watched, and not haue suffred his house to be broken thorow.
lk.12.40	Luke 12:40	Be yee therefore ready also: for the sonne of man commeth at an houre when yee thinke not.
lk.12.41	Luke 12:41	¶ Then Peter said vnto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable vnto vs, or euen to all?
lk.12.42	Luke 12:42	And the Lord said, Who then is that faithfull and wise steward, whom his Lord shall make ruler ouer his houshold, to giue them their portion of meate in due season?
lk.12.43	Luke 12:43	Blessed is that seruant, whom his Lord when he commeth, shall find so doing.
lk.12.44	Luke 12:44	Of a trueth, I say vnto you, that hee will make him ruler ouer all that he hath.
lk.12.45	Luke 12:45	But and if that seruant say in his heart, My Lord delayeth his comming and shall beginne to beat the men seruants, and maidens, and to eate and drinke, and to be drunken:
lk.12.46	Luke 12:46	The Lord of that seruant will come in a day when hee looketh not for him, and at an houre when hee is not ware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the vnbeleeuers.
lk.12.47	Luke 12:47	And that seruant which knew his Lords will, and prepared not himselfe, neither did according to his will, shalbe beaten with many stripes.
lk.12.48	Luke 12:48	But hee that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall bee beaten with few stripes. For vnto whomsoeuer much is giuen, of him shal bee much required: and to whom men haue committed much, of him they will aske the more.
lk.12.49	Luke 12:49	¶ I am come to send fire on the earth, and what will I, if it be already kindled?
lk.12.50	Luke 12:50	But I haue a baptisme to be baptized with, and how am I straitned till it be accomplished?
lk.12.51	Luke 12:51	Suppose yee that I am come to giue peace on earth? I tell you, Nay, but rather diuision.
lk.12.52	Luke 12:52	For from henceforth there shalbe fiue in one house diuided, three against two, and two against three.
lk.12.53	Luke 12:53	The father shall bee diuided against the sonne, and the sonne against the father: the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother: the mother in lawe against her daughter in lawe, and the daughter in law against her mother in lawe.

lk.12.55	Luke 12:55	And when ye see the Southwind blow, ye say, There will be heat, and it commeth to passe.

lk.20.1	Luke 20:1	And it came to passe, that on one of those dayes, as he taught the people in the Temple, and preached the Gospel, the chiefe Priests and the Scribes came vpon him, with the Elders,
lk.20.2	Luke 20:2	And spake vnto him, saying, Tell vs, by what authoritie doest thou these things? or who is hee that gaue thee this authoritie?
lk.20.3	Luke 20:3	And hee answered, and said vnto them, I will also aske you one thing, and answere me.
lk.20.4	Luke 20:4	The Baptisme of Iohn, was it from heauen, or of men?
lk.20.5	Luke 20:5	And they reasoned with themselues, saying, If wee shall say, From heauen, he will say, Why then beleeued yee him not?
lk.20.6	Luke 20:6	But and if we say, Of men, all the people will stone vs: for they be perswaded that Iohn was a Prophet.
lk.20.7	Luke 20:7	And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
lk.20.8	Luke 20:8	And Iesus said vnto them, Neither tell I you by what authoritie I doe these things.
lk.20.9	Luke 20:9	Then began hee to speake to the people this parable: A certaine man planted a vineyard, and let it foorth to husbandmen, and went into a farre countrey for a long time.
lk.20.10	Luke 20:10	And at the season, hee sent a seruant to the husbandmen, that they should giue him of the fruit of the vineyard, but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away emptie.
lk.20.11	Luke 20:11	And againe hee sent another seruant, and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away emptie.
lk.20.12	Luke 20:12	And againe he sent the third, and they wounded him also, & cast him out.
lk.20.13	Luke 20:13	Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I doe? I will send my beloued sonne: it may be they will reuerence him when they see him.
lk.20.14	Luke 20:14	But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselues, saying, This is þ heire, come, let vs kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
lk.20.15	Luke 20:15	So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard doe vnto them?
lk.20.16	Luke 20:16	Hee shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall giue the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
lk.20.17	Luke 20:17	And hee beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders reiected, the same is become the head of the corner?
lk.20.18	Luke 20:18	Whosoeuer shall fall vpon that stone, shalbe broken: but on whomsoeuer it shall fall, it will grinde him to powder.
lk.20.19	Luke 20:19	¶ And the chiefe Priests and the Scribes the same houre sought to lay hands on him, and they feared the people: for they perceiued that he had spoken this parable against them.
lk.20.20	Luke 20:20	And they watched him, and sent foorth spies, which should faine themselues iust men, that they might take holde of his words, that so they might deliuer him vnto the power and authoritie of the gouernour.
lk.20.21	Luke 20:21	And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truely.
lk.20.22	Luke 20:22	Is it lawfull for vs to giue tribute vnto Cesar, or no?
lk.20.23	Luke 20:23	But he perceiued their craftines, and said vnto them, Why tempt ye me?
lk.20.24	Luke 20:24	Shew me a peny: whose image and superscription hath it? They answered, and said, Cesars.
lk.20.25	Luke 20:25	And he said vnto them, Render therefore vnto Cesar the things which be Cesars, and vnto God the things which be Gods.
lk.20.26	Luke 20:26	And they could not take holde of his wordes before the people, and they marueiled at his answere, and helde their peace.
lk.20.27	Luke 20:27	¶ Then came to him certaine of the Sadduces (which denie that there is any resurrection) and they asked him,
lk.20.28	Luke 20:28	Saying, Master, Moses wrote vnto vs, If any mans brother die, hauing a wife, and hee die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise vp seede vnto his brother.
lk.20.29	Luke 20:29	There were therefore seuen brethren, and the first tooke a wife, and died without children.
lk.20.30	Luke 20:30	And the second tooke her to wife, and he died childlesse.
lk.20.31	Luke 20:31	And the third tooke her, and in like maner the seuen also. And they left no children, and died.
lk.20.32	Luke 20:32	Last of all the woman died also.
lk.20.33	Luke 20:33	Therefore in the resurrection, whose wife of them is she? for seuen had her to wife.
lk.20.34	Luke 20:34	And Iesus answering, said vnto them, The children of this world, marrie, and are giuen in marriage:
lk.20.35	Luke 20:35	But they which shall be accompted worthy to obtaine that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marrie, nor are giuen in marriage.
lk.20.36	Luke 20:36	Neither can they die any more; for they are equall vnto the Angels, and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
lk.20.37	Luke 20:37	Now that the dead are raised, euen Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isahac, and the God of Iacob.
lk.20.38	Luke 20:38	For he is not a God of the dead, but of the liuing for all liue vnto him.
lk.20.39	Luke 20:39	¶ Then certaine of the Scribes answering, said, Master, Thou hast well said.
lk.20.40	Luke 20:40	And after that, they durst not aske him any question at all.
lk.20.41	Luke 20:41	And he said vnto them, How say they that Christ is Dauids sonne?
lk.20.42	Luke 20:42	And Dauid himselfe saith in the booke of Psalmes, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
lk.20.43	Luke 20:43	Till I make thine enemies thy footestoole.
lk.20.44	Luke 20:44	Dauid therefore calleth him, Lord, how is he then his sonne?

lk.20.46	Luke 20:46	Beware of the Scribes, which desire to walke in long robes, and loue greetings in the markets, and the highest seates in the Synagogues, and the chiefe roumes at feasts:
lk.20.47	Luke 20:47	Which deuoure widowes houses and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receiue greater damnation.
lk.21.1	Luke 21:1	And he looked vp, and saw the rich men casting their giftes into the treasurie.

lk.21.12	Luke 21:12	But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, deliuering you vp to the Synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before Kings and rulers for my Names sake.
lk.21.13	Luke 21:13	And it shall turne to you for a testimony.

lk.21.27	Luke 21:27	And then shall they see the sonne of man comming in a cloud with power and great glory.

lk.21.33	Luke 21:33	Heauen and earth shall passe away, but my words shall not passe away.

lk.23.51	Luke 23:51	(The same had not consented to the counsell and deede of them) he was of Arimathea, a city of the Iewes (who also himselfe waited for the kingdome of God.)

lk.24.28	Luke 24:28	And they drew nigh vnto the village, whither they went, and hee made as though hee would haue gone further.
lk.24.29	Luke 24:29	But they constrained him, saying, Abide with vs, for it is towards euening, and the day is farre spent: And he went in, to tarrie with them.

jn.1.1	John 1:1	In the beginning was the Word, & the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
jn.1.2	John 1:2	The same was in the beginning with God.
jn.1.3	John 1:3	All things were made by him, and without him was not any thing made that was made.
jn.1.4	John 1:4	In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
jn.1.5	John 1:5	And the light shineth in darknesse, and the darknesse comprehended it not.
jn.1.6	John 1:6	¶ There was a man sent from God, whose name was Iohn.
jn.1.7	John 1:7	The same came for a witnesse, to beare witnesse of the light, that all men through him might beleeue.
jn.1.8	John 1:8	Hee was not that light, but was sent to beare witnesse of that light.
jn.1.9	John 1:9	That was the true light, which lighteth euery man that commeth into the world.
jn.1.10	John 1:10	Hee was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
jn.1.11	John 1:11	Hee came vnto his owne, and his owne receiued him not.
jn.1.12	John 1:12	But as many as receiued him, to them gaue hee power to become the sonnes of God, euen to them that beleeue on his Name:
jn.1.13	John 1:13	Which were borne, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
jn.1.14	John 1:14	And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among vs (& we beheld his glory, the glory as of the onely begotten of the Father) full of grace and trueth.
jn.1.15	John 1:15	¶ Iohn bare witnesse of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that commeth after me, is preferred before me, for he was before me.
jn.1.16	John 1:16	And of his fulnesse haue all wee receiued, and grace for grace.
jn.1.17	John 1:17	For the Law was giuen by Moses, but grace and trueth came by Iesus Christ.
jn.1.18	John 1:18	No man hath seene God at any time: the onely begotten Sonne, which is in the bosome of the Father, he hath declared him.
jn.1.19	John 1:19	¶ And this is the record of Iohn, when the Iewes sent Priests and Leuites from Hierusalem, to aske him, Who art thou?
jn.1.20	John 1:20	And he confessed, and denied not: but confessed, I am not the Christ.
jn.1.21	John 1:21	And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that Prophet? And hee answered, No.

jn.1.23	John 1:23	He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wildernesse: Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the Prophet Esaias.
jn.1.24	John 1:24	And they which were sent, were of the Pharises.

jn.1.26	John 1:26	Iohn answered them, saying, I baptize with water, but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not,
jn.1.27	John 1:27	He it is, who comming after me, is preferred before me, whose shoes latchet I am not worthy to vnloose.
jn.1.28	John 1:28	These things were done in Bethabara beyond Iordane, where Iohn was baptizing.

jn.1.30	John 1:30	This is he of whom I said, After me commeth a man, which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

jn.1.35	John 1:35	¶ Againe the next day after, Iohn stood, and two of his disciples.

jn.1.51	John 1:51	And hee saith vnto him, Uerily, verily I say vnto you, heereafter yee shall see heauen open, and the Angels of God ascending, and descending vpon the sonne of man.

jn.3.1	John 3:1	There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of þ Iewes:
jn.3.2	John 3:2	The same came to Iesus by night, and said vnto him, Rabbi, wee know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can doe these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
jn.3.3	John 3:3	Iesus answered, and said vnto him, Uerily, verily I say vnto thee, except a man be borne againe, he cannot see the kingdome of God.

jn.3.5	John 3:5	Iesus answered, Uerily, verily I say vnto thee, except a man be borne of water and of the spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdome of God.
jn.3.6	John 3:6	That which is borne of the flesh, is flesh, and that which is borne of the spirit, is spirit.
jn.3.7	John 3:7	Marueile not that I saide vnto thee, Ye must be borne againe.
jn.3.8	John 3:8	The winde bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tel whence it commeth, and whither it goeth: So is euery one that is borne of the Spirit.
jn.3.9	John 3:9	Nicodemus answered, and said vnto him, How can these things be?

jn.3.11	John 3:11	Uerely, verely I say vnto thee, We speake that we doe know, and testifie that wee haue seene; and yee receiue not our witnesse.
jn.3.12	John 3:12	If I haue tolde you earthly things, and ye beleeue not: how shall ye beleeue if I tell you of heauenly things?
jn.3.13	John 3:13	And no man hath ascended vp to heauen, but hee that came downe from heauen, euen the Sonne of man which is in heauen.
jn.3.14	John 3:14	¶ And as Moses lifted vp the serpent in the wildernesse: euen so must the Sonne of man be lifted vp:
jn.3.15	John 3:15	That whosoeuer beleeueth in him, should not perish, but haue eternall life.
jn.3.16	John 3:16	¶ For God so loued þ world, that he gaue his only begotten Sonne: that whosoeuer beleeueth in him, should not perish, but haue euerlasting life.
jn.3.17	John 3:17	For God sent not his Sonne into the world to condemne the world: but that the world through him might be saued.
jn.3.18	John 3:18	¶ He that beleeueth on him, is not condemned: but hee that beleeueth not, is condemned already, because hee hath not beleeued in the Name of the onely begotten Sonne of God.
jn.3.19	John 3:19	And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loued darknesse rather then light, because their deedes were euill.
jn.3.20	John 3:20	For euery one that doeth euill, hateth the light, neither commeth to the light, lest his deeds should be reproued.
jn.3.21	John 3:21	But hee that doeth trueth, commeth to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
jn.3.22	John 3:22	¶ After these things, came Iesus and his disciples into the land of Iudea, and there hee taried with them, and baptized.
jn.3.23	John 3:23	¶ And Iohn also was baptizing in Aenon, neere to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
jn.3.24	John 3:24	For Iohn was not yet cast into prison.
jn.3.25	John 3:25	¶ Then there arose a question between some of Iohns disciples and the Iewes, about purifying.
jn.3.26	John 3:26	And they came vnto Iohn, and said vnto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Iordane, to whom thou barest witnesse, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
jn.3.27	John 3:27	Iohn answered, and said, A man can receiue nothing, except it be giuen him from heauen.
jn.3.28	John 3:28	Ye your selues beare me witnesse, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
jn.3.29	John 3:29	He that hath the bride, is the bridegrome: but the friend of the bridegrome, which standeth and heareth him, reioyceth greatly because of the bridegromes voice: This my ioy therefore is fulfilled.
jn.3.30	John 3:30	Hee must increase, but I must decrease.
jn.3.31	John 3:31	Hee that commeth from aboue, is aboue all: hee that is of the earth, is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: hee that cōmeth from heauen is aboue all:
jn.3.32	John 3:32	And what hee hath seene and heard, that he testifieth, and no man receiueth his testimony:
jn.3.33	John 3:33	He that hath receiued his testimonie, hath set to his seale, that God is true.
jn.3.34	John 3:34	For he whom God hath sent, speaketh the words of God: For God giueth not the Spirit by measure vnto him.
jn.3.35	John 3:35	The Father loueth the Sonne, and hath giuen al things into his hand.
jn.3.36	John 3:36	He that beleeueth on the Sonne, hath euerlasting life: and he that beleeueth not the Sonne, shall not see life: but the wrath of God abideth on him.
jn.4.1	John 4:1	When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Iesus made and baptized moe disciples then Iohn,
jn.4.2	John 4:2	(Though Iesus himselfe baptized not, but his disciples:)
jn.4.3	John 4:3	He left Iudea, and departed againe into Galile.
jn.4.4	John 4:4	And hee must needs goe thorow Samaria.
jn.4.5	John 4:5	Then commeth he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, neere to the parcell of ground that Iacob gaue to his sonne Ioseph.
jn.4.6	John 4:6	Now Iacobs Well was there. Iesus therefore being wearied with his iourney, sate thus on the Well: and it was about the sixth houre.
jn.4.7	John 4:7	There commeth a woman of Samaria to draw water: Iesus sayth vnto her, Giue me to drinke.
jn.4.8	John 4:8	For his disciples were gone away vnto the city to buy meate.
jn.4.9	John 4:9	Then saith the woman of Samaria vnto him, How is it that thou, being a Iewe, askest drinke of me, which am a woman of Samaria? For the Iewes haue no dealings with the Samaritanes.
jn.4.10	John 4:10	Iesus answered, and said vnto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that sayth to thee, Giue me to drinke; thou wouldest haue asked of him, and hee would haue giuen thee liuing water.
jn.4.11	John 4:11	The woman saith vnto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to drawe with, and the Well is deepe: from whence then hast thou that liuing water?
jn.4.12	John 4:12	Art thou greater then our father Iacob, which gaue vs the Well, and dranke thereof himselfe, and his children, and his cattell?
jn.4.13	John 4:13	Iesus answered, and said vnto her, Whosoeuer drinketh of this water, shall thirst againe:
jn.4.14	John 4:14	But whosoeuer drinketh of the water that I shal giue him, shall neuer thirst: but the water that I shall giue him, shalbe in him a well of water springing vp into euerlasting life.
jn.4.15	John 4:15	The woman saith vnto him, Sir, giue me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
jn.4.16	John 4:16	Iesus saith vnto her, Goe, call thy husband, and come hither.
jn.4.17	John 4:17	The woman answered, and said, I haue no husband. Iesus said vnto her, Thou hast well said, I haue no husband:
jn.4.18	John 4:18	For thou hast had fiue husbands, and he whom thou now hast, is not thy husband: In that saidest thou truely.
jn.4.19	John 4:19	The woman saith vnto him, Sir, I perceiue that thou art a Prophet.
jn.4.20	John 4:20	Our fathers worshipped in this mountaine, and ye say, that in Hierusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
jn.4.21	John 4:21	Iesus saith vnto her, Woman, beleeue me, the houre commeth when ye shall neither in this mountaine, nor yet at Hierusalem, worship the Father.
jn.4.22	John 4:22	Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for saluation is of the Iewes.
jn.4.23	John 4:23	But the houre commeth, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit, and in trueth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
jn.4.24	John 4:24	God is a Spirit, and they that worship him, must worship him in spirit, and in trueth.
jn.4.25	John 4:25	The woman saith vnto him, I know that Messias commeth, which is called Christ: when he is come, hee will tell vs all things.
jn.4.26	John 4:26	Iesus sayth vnto her, I that speake vnto thee, am hee.
jn.4.27	John 4:27	¶ And vpon this came his disciples, and marueiled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou, or, Why talkest thou with her?
jn.4.28	John 4:28	The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and sayth to the men,
jn.4.29	John 4:29	Come, see a man, which tolde me all things that euer I did: Is not this the Christ?
jn.4.30	John 4:30	Then they went out of the citie, and came vnto him.
jn.4.31	John 4:31	¶ In the meane while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eate.
jn.4.32	John 4:32	But hee said vnto them, I haue meate to eate that ye know not of.
jn.4.33	John 4:33	Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eate?
jn.4.34	John 4:34	Iesus saith vnto them, My meat is, to doe the will of him that sent mee, and to finish his worke.
jn.4.35	John 4:35	Say not ye, There are yet foure moneths, and then commeth haruest? Behold, I say vnto you, Lift vp your eyes, and looke on the fields: for they are white already to haruest.
jn.4.36	John 4:36	And hee that reapeth receiueth wages, and gathereth fruite vnto life eternall: that both he that soweth, and he that reapeth, may reioyce together.
jn.4.37	John 4:37	And herein is that saying true: One soweth, and another reapeth.
jn.4.38	John 4:38	I sent you to reape that, whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and yee are entred into their labours.
jn.4.39	John 4:39	¶ And many of the Samaritanes of that citie beleeued on him, for the saying of the woman, which testified, Hee told me all that euer I did.
jn.4.40	John 4:40	So when the Samaritanes were come vnto him, they besought him that he would tarie with them, and he abode there two dayes.
jn.4.41	John 4:41	And many moe beleeued, because of his owne word:
jn.4.42	John 4:42	And said vnto the woman, Now we beleeue, not because of thy saying, for we haue heard him our selues, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Sauiour of the world.
jn.4.43	John 4:43	¶ Now after two dayes he departed thence, and went into Galilee:
jn.4.44	John 4:44	For Iesus himselfe testified, that a Prophet hath no honour in his owne countrey.
jn.4.45	John 4:45	Then when hee was come into Galilee, the Galileans receiued him, hauing seene all the things that hee did at Hierusalem at the Feast: for they also went vnto the Feast.
jn.4.46	John 4:46	So Iesus came againe into Cana of Galilee, where hee made the water wine. And there was a certaine noble man, whose sonne was sicke at Capernaum.
jn.4.47	John 4:47	When he heard that Iesus was come out of Iudea into Galilee, hee went vnto him, and besought him that he would come downe, and heale his sonne: for he was at the point of death.
jn.4.48	John 4:48	Then said Iesus vnto him, Except ye see signes and wonders, yee will not beleeue.
jn.4.49	John 4:49	The noble man saith vnto him, Syr, come downe ere my child die.
jn.4.50	John 4:50	Iesus saith vnto him, Go thy way, thy sonne liueth. And the man beleeued the word that Iesus had spoken vnto him, and he went his way.
jn.4.51	John 4:51	And as he was now going down, his seruants met him, and told him, saying, Thy sonne liueth.
jn.4.52	John 4:52	Then inquired hee of them the houre when he began to amend: and they said vnto him, Yesterday at the seuenth houre the feuer left him.
jn.4.53	John 4:53	So the father knewe that it was at the same houre, in the which Iesus said vnto him, Thy sonne liueth, and himselfe beleeued, and his whole house.
jn.4.54	John 4:54	This is againe the second miracle that Iesus did, when hee was come out of Iudea into Galilee.
jn.5.1	John 5:1	After this there was a feast of the Iewes, and Iesus went vp to Hierusalem.
jn.5.2	John 5:2	Now there is at Hierusalem by the sheepe market, a poole, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, hauing fiue porches.
jn.5.3	John 5:3	In these lay a great multitude of impotent folke, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the mouing of the water.
jn.5.4	John 5:4	For an Angel went downe at a certaine season into the poole, and troubled the water: whosoeuer then first after the troubling of the water stepped in, was made whole of whatsoeuer disease he had.
jn.5.5	John 5:5	And a certaine man was there, which had an infirmitie thirtie and eight yeeres.
jn.5.6	John 5:6	When Iesus saw him lie, & knew that hee had beene now a long time in that case, he sayth vnto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
jn.5.7	John 5:7	The impotent man answered him, Sir, I haue no man when the water is troubled, to put mee into the poole: but while I am comming, another steppeth downe before me.
jn.5.8	John 5:8	Iesus sayth vnto him, Rise, take vp thy bed, and walke.
jn.5.9	John 5:9	And immediatly the man was made whole, and tooke vp his bed, and walked: And on the same day was the Sabbath.
jn.5.10	John 5:10	¶ The Iewes therefore said vnto him that was cured, It is the Sabbath day, it is not lawfull for thee to cary thy bed.
jn.5.11	John 5:11	He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said vnto me, Take vp thy bed, and walke.
jn.5.12	John 5:12	Then asked they him, What man is that which said vnto thee, Take vp thy bed, and walke?
jn.5.13	John 5:13	And he that was healed, wist not who it was: for Iesus had conueyed himselfe away, a multitude being in that place.
jn.5.14	John 5:14	Afterward Iesus findeth him in the Temple, & said vnto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sinne no more, lest a worse thing come vnto thee.
jn.5.15	John 5:15	The man departed, and tolde the Iewes that it was Iesus which had made him whole.
jn.5.16	John 5:16	And therefore did the Iewes persecute Iesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the Sabbath day.
jn.5.17	John 5:17	¶ But Iesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, & I worke.
jn.5.18	John 5:18	Therefore the Iewes sought the more to kill him, not onely because hee had broken the Sabbath, but said also, that God was his father, making himselfe equall with God.
jn.5.19	John 5:19	Then answered Iesus, and saide vnto them, Uerily, verily I say vnto you, The sonne can doe nothing of himselfe, but what he seeth the Father doe: for what things soeuer he doeth, these also doth the sonne likewise.
jn.5.20	John 5:20	For the father loueth the sonne, and sheweth him all things that himselfe doth: & he will shew him greater works then these, that ye may marueile.
jn.5.21	John 5:21	For as the Father raiseth vp the dead, and quickeneth them: euen so the Sonne quickeneth whom he will.
jn.5.22	John 5:22	For the Father iudgeth no man: but hath committed all iudgement vnto the Sonne:
jn.5.23	John 5:23	That all men should honour the Son, euen as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not þ Sonne, honoreth not þ Father which hath sent him.
jn.5.24	John 5:24	Uerily, verily I say vnto you, Hee that heareth my word, & beleeueth on him that sent mee, hath euerlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation: but is passed from death vnto life.
jn.5.25	John 5:25	Uerily, verily I say vnto you, The houre is comming, & now is, when the dead shall heare the voice of the Sonne of God: and they that heare, shall liue.
jn.5.26	John 5:26	For as the Father hath life in himselfe: so hath he giuen to the Sonne to haue life in himselfe:
jn.5.27	John 5:27	And hath giuen him authority to execute iudgement also, because he is the Sonne of man.
jn.5.28	John 5:28	Marueile not at this: for the houre is comming, in the which all that are in the graues shall heare his voice,
jn.5.29	John 5:29	And shall come foorth, they that haue done good, vnto the resurrection of life, and they that haue done euill, vnto the resurrection of damnation.
jn.5.30	John 5:30	I can of mine owne selfe doe nothing: as I heare, I iudge: and my iudgement is iust, because I seeke not mine owne will, but the will of the Father, which hath sent me.
jn.5.31	John 5:31	If I beare witnesse of my selfe, my witnesse is not true.
jn.5.32	John 5:32	¶ There is another that beareth witnesse of me, & I know that the witnesse which he witnesseth of me, is true.
jn.5.33	John 5:33	Ye sent vnto Iohn, and he bare witnesse vnto the trueth.
jn.5.34	John 5:34	But I receiue not testimonie from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saued.
jn.5.35	John 5:35	He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to reioyce in his light.
jn.5.36	John 5:36	¶ But I haue greater witnesse then that of Iohn: for the workes which the Father hath giuen me to finish, the same workes that I doe, beare witnesse of mee, that the Father hath sent me.
jn.5.37	John 5:37	And the Father himselfe which hath sent me, hath borne witnesse of me. Ye haue neither heard his voyce at any time, nor seene his shape.
jn.5.38	John 5:38	And ye haue not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye beleeue not.
jn.5.39	John 5:39	¶ Search the Scriptures, for in them ye thinke ye haue eternall life, and they are they which testifie of me.
jn.5.40	John 5:40	And ye will not come to me, that ye might haue life.
jn.5.41	John 5:41	I receiue not honour from men.
jn.5.42	John 5:42	But I know you, that ye haue not the loue of God in you.
jn.5.43	John 5:43	I am come in my Fathers name, and ye receiue me not: if another shall come in his owne Name, him ye will receiue.
jn.5.44	John 5:44	How can ye beleeue, which receiue honour one of another, & seeke not the honour that commeth from God onely?
jn.5.45	John 5:45	Doe not thinke that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, euen Moses, in whom ye trust?
jn.5.46	John 5:46	For had ye beleeued Moses, ye would haue beleeued me: for he wrote of me.
jn.5.47	John 5:47	But if ye beleeue not his writings, how shall ye beleeue my words?
jn.6.1	John 6:1	After these things Iesus went ouer the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias:
jn.6.2	John 6:2	And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which hee did on them that were diseased.
jn.6.3	John 6:3	And Iesus went vp into a mountaine, and there hee sate with his disciples.
jn.6.4	John 6:4	And the Passeouer, a feast of the Iewes, was nigh.
jn.6.5	John 6:5	¶ When Iesus then lift vp his eyes, and saw a great company come vnto him, he saith vnto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eate?
jn.6.6	John 6:6	(And this he said to proue him: for he himselfe knew what he would doe)
jn.6.7	John 6:7	Philip answered him, Two hundred peny-worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that euery one of them may take a litle.
jn.6.8	John 6:8	One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peters brother, saith vnto him,
jn.6.9	John 6:9	There is a lad here, which hath fiue barley loaues, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
jn.6.10	John 6:10	And Iesus said, Make the men sit downe. Now there was much grasse in the place. So the men sate downe, in number about fiue thousand.
jn.6.11	John 6:11	And Iesus tooke the loaues, and when he had giuen thankes, hee distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set downe, and likewise of the fishes, as much as they would.
jn.6.12	John 6:12	When they were filled, he said vnto his disciples, Gather vp the fragments that remaine, that nothing be lost.
jn.6.13	John 6:13	Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelue baskets with the fragments of the fiue barley loaues, which remained ouer and aboue, vnto them that had eaten.
jn.6.14	John 6:14	Then those men, when they had seene the miracle that Iesus did, said, This is of a trueth that Prophet that should come into the world.
jn.6.15	John 6:15	¶ When Iesus therefore perceiued that they would come and take him by force, to make him a King, hee departed againe into a mountaine, himselfe alone.
jn.6.16	John 6:16	And when euen was now come, his disciples went downe vnto the sea,
jn.6.17	John 6:17	And entred into a ship, and went ouer the sea towards Capernaum: and it was now darke, and Iesus was not come to them.
jn.6.18	John 6:18	And the sea arose, by reason of a great winde that blew.
jn.6.19	John 6:19	So when they had rowed about fiue and twentie, or thirtie furlongs, they see Iesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh vnto the ship: and they were afraid.
jn.6.20	John 6:20	But he saith vnto them, It is I, be not afraid.
jn.6.21	John 6:21	Then they willingly receiued him into the ship, and immediatly the ship was at the land whither they went.
jn.6.22	John 6:22	¶ The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea, saw that there was none other boat there, saue that one whereinto his disciples were entred, and that Iesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone:
jn.6.23	John 6:23	Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias, nigh vnto the place where they did eate bread, after that the Lord had giuen thankes:
jn.6.24	John 6:24	When the people therefore saw that Iesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also tooke shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Iesus.
jn.6.25	John 6:25	And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they saide vnto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
jn.6.26	John 6:26	Iesus answered them, and said, Uerely, verely I say vnto you, Ye seeke me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because yee did eate of the loaues, and were filled.
jn.6.27	John 6:27	Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth vnto euerlasting life, which the Sonne of man shall giue vnto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
jn.6.28	John 6:28	Then said they vnto him, What shall we doe, that we might worke the workes of God?
jn.6.29	John 6:29	Iesus answered, and said vnto them, This is the worke of God, that ye beleeue on him whom he hath sent.
jn.6.30	John 6:30	They said therefore vnto him, What signe shewest thou then, that we may see, and beleeue thee? What doest thou worke?
jn.6.31	John 6:31	Our fathers did eate Manna in the desert, as it is written, He gaue them bread from heauen to eate.
jn.6.32	John 6:32	Then Iesus said vnto them, Uerely, verely I say vnto you, Moses gaue you not that bread from heauen, but my Father giueth you the true bread from heauen.
jn.6.33	John 6:33	For the bread of God is hee which commeth downe from heauen, and giueth life vnto the world.
jn.6.34	John 6:34	Then said they vnto him, Lord, euermore giue vs this bread.
jn.6.35	John 6:35	And Iesus said vnto them, I am the bread of life: hee that commeth to me, shall neuer hunger: and he that beleeueth on me, shall neuer thirst.
jn.6.36	John 6:36	But I said vnto you, that ye also haue seene me, and beleeue not.
jn.6.37	John 6:37	All that the Father giueth mee, shall come to mee; and him that commeth to me, I will in no wise cast out.
jn.6.38	John 6:38	For I came downe from heauen, not to doe mine owne will, but the will of him that sent me.
jn.6.39	John 6:39	And this is the Fathers wil which hath sent me, that of all which he hath giuen mee, I should lose nothing, but should raise it vp againe at the last day.
jn.6.40	John 6:40	And this is the will of him that sent me, that euery one which seeth the Sonne, and beleeueth on him, may haue euerlasting life: and I will raise him vp at the last day.
jn.6.41	John 6:41	The Iewes then murmured at him, because hee said, I am the bread which came downe from heauen.
jn.6.42	John 6:42	And they said, Is not this Iesus the sonne of Ioseph, whose father and mother we know? How is it then that hee sayth, I came downe from heauen?
jn.6.43	John 6:43	Iesus therefore answered, and said vnto them, Murmure not among your selues.
jn.6.44	John 6:44	No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me, draw him: and I will raise him vp at the last day.
jn.6.45	John 6:45	It is written in the Prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Euery man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, commeth vnto me,
jn.6.46	John 6:46	Not that any man hath seene the Father; saue hee which is of God, hee hath seene the Father.
jn.6.47	John 6:47	Uerely, verely I say vnto you, Hee that beleeueth on me, hath euerlasting life.
jn.6.48	John 6:48	I am that bread of life.
jn.6.49	John 6:49	Your fathers did eate Manna in the wildernesse, and are dead.
jn.6.50	John 6:50	This is the bread which commeth downe from heauen, that a man may eate thereof, and not die.
jn.6.51	John 6:51	I am the liuing bread, which came downe from heauen. If any man eate of this bread, he shall liue for euer: and the bread that I will giue, is my flesh, which I will giue for the life of the world.
jn.6.52	John 6:52	The Iewes therefore stroue amongst themselues, saying, How can this man giue vs his flesh to eate?
jn.6.53	John 6:53	Then Iesus sayd vnto them, Uerely, verely I say vnto you, Except yee eate the flesh of the sonne of man, and drinke his blood, yee haue no life in you.
jn.6.54	John 6:54	Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternall life, and I will raise him vp at the last day.
jn.6.55	John 6:55	For my flesh is meate indeed, and my blood is drinke indeed.
jn.6.56	John 6:56	He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
jn.6.57	John 6:57	As the liuing Father hath sent me, and I liue by the Father: so, he that eateth me, euen he shall liue by me.
jn.6.58	John 6:58	This is that bread which came downe from heauen: not as your fathers did eate Manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread, shall liue for euer.
jn.6.59	John 6:59	These things said hee in the Synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
jn.6.60	John 6:60	Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying, who can heare it?
jn.6.61	John 6:61	When Iesus knew in himselfe, that his disciples murmured at it, hee said vnto them, Doeth this offend you?
jn.6.62	John 6:62	What and if yee shall see the sonne of man ascend vp where hee was before?
jn.6.63	John 6:63	It is the Spirit that quickeneth, the flesh profiteth nothing: the wordes that I speake vnto you, they are Spirit, and they are life.
jn.6.64	John 6:64	But there are some of you that beleeue not. For Iesus knew from the beginning, who they were that beleeued not, and who should betray him.
jn.6.65	John 6:65	And he said, Therefore said I vnto you, that no man can come vnto me, except it were giuen vnto him of my Father.
jn.6.66	John 6:66	¶ From that time many of his disciples went backe, and walked no more with him.
jn.6.67	John 6:67	Then said Iesus vnto the twelue, Will ye also goe away?
jn.6.68	John 6:68	Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we goe? Thou hast the words of eternall life.
jn.6.69	John 6:69	And we beleeue and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Sonne of the liuing God.
jn.6.70	John 6:70	Iesus answered them, Haue not I chosen you twelue, and one of you is a deuill?
jn.6.71	John 6:71	He spake of Iudas Iscariot the sonne of Simon: for hee it was that should betray him, being one of the twelue.
jn.7.1	John 7:1	After these things, Iesus walked in Galilee: for hee would not walk in Iurie, because the Iewes sought to kill him.
jn.7.2	John 7:2	Now the Iewes feast of Tabernacles was at hand.
jn.7.3	John 7:3	His brethren therefore saide vnto him, Depart hence, and go into Iudea, that thy Disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
jn.7.4	John 7:4	For there is no man that doth any thing in secret, and hee himselfe seeketh to be knowen openly: If thou doe these things, shew thy selfe to þ world.
jn.7.5	John 7:5	For neither did his brethren beleeue in him.
jn.7.6	John 7:6	Then Iesus said vnto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
jn.7.7	John 7:7	The world cannot hate you, but me it hateth, because I testifie of it, that the workes thereof are euill.
jn.7.8	John 7:8	Goe ye vp vnto this feast: I goe not vp yet vnto this feast, for my time is not yet full come.
jn.7.9	John 7:9	When he had said these words vnto them, he abode still in Galilee.
jn.7.10	John 7:10	¶ But when his brethren were gone vp, then went he also vp vnto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
jn.7.11	John 7:11	Then the Iewes sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
jn.7.12	John 7:12	And there was much murmuring among the people, concerning him: For some said, Hee is a good man: Others said, Nay, but he deceiueth the people.
jn.7.13	John 7:13	Howbeit, no man spake openly of him, for feare of the Iewes.
jn.7.14	John 7:14	¶ Now about the middest of the feast, Iesus went vp into the Temple, and taught.
jn.7.15	John 7:15	And the Iewes marueiled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, hauing neuer learned?
jn.7.16	John 7:16	Iesus answered them, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
jn.7.17	John 7:17	If any man will doe his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speake of my selfe.
jn.7.18	John 7:18	He that speaketh of himselfe, seeketh his owne glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no vnrighteousnesse is in him.
jn.7.19	John 7:19	Did not Moses giue you the Law, and yet none of you keepeth the Law? Why goe ye about to kill me?
jn.7.20	John 7:20	The people answered, and sayd, Thou hast a deuill: Who goeth about to kill thee?
jn.7.21	John 7:21	Iesus answered, and saide vnto them, I haue done one worke, and yee all marueile.
jn.7.22	John 7:22	Moses therefore gaue vnto you Circumcision (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers) and yee on the Sabbath day circumcise a man.
jn.7.23	John 7:23	If a man on the Sabbath day receiue circumcision, that the Lawe of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I haue made a man euery whit whole on the Sabbath day?
jn.7.24	John 7:24	Iudge not according to the appearance, but iudge righteous iudgement.
jn.7.25	John 7:25	Then said some of them of Hierusalem, Is not this hee, whome they seeke to kill?
jn.7.26	John 7:26	But loe, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing vnto him: Doe the rulers know indeede that this is the very Christ?
jn.7.27	John 7:27	Howbeit wee know this man whence he is: but when Christ commeth, no man knoweth whence he is.
jn.7.28	John 7:28	Then cried Iesus in the Temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am, and I am not come of my selfe, but he that sent me, is true, whom ye know not.
jn.7.29	John 7:29	But I know him, for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
jn.7.30	John 7:30	Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his houre was not yet come.
jn.7.31	John 7:31	And many of the people beleeued on him, & said, When Christ commeth, will hee doe moe miracles then these which this man hath done?
jn.7.32	John 7:32	¶ The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him: And the Pharisees and the chiefe Priests sent officers to take him.
jn.7.33	John 7:33	Then said Iesus vnto them, Yet a litle while am I with you, and then I goe vnto him that sent me.
jn.7.34	John 7:34	Ye shall seeke me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither yee cannot come.
jn.7.35	John 7:35	Then saide the Iewes among themselues, Whither will hee goe, that we shall not find him? will he goe vnto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
jn.7.36	John 7:36	What maner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seeke me, and shall not find me? and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
jn.7.37	John 7:37	In the last day, that great day of the feast, Iesus stood, and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come vnto me, and drinke.
jn.7.38	John 7:38	He that beleeueth on me, as the Scripture hath saide, out of his belly shall flow riuers of liuing water.
jn.7.39	John 7:39	(But this spake he of the Spirit which they that beleeue on him, should receiue. For the holy Ghost was not yet giuen, because that Iesus was not yet glorified.)
jn.7.40	John 7:40	¶ Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, saide, Of a trueth this is the Prophet.
jn.7.41	John 7:41	Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
jn.7.42	John 7:42	Hath not the Scripture saide, that Christ commeth of the seede of Dauid, and out of the towne of Bethlehem, where Dauid was?
jn.7.43	John 7:43	So there was diuision among the people because of him.
jn.7.44	John 7:44	And some of them would haue taken him, but no man layed hands on him.
jn.7.45	John 7:45	¶ Then came the officers to the chiefe Priests and Pharises, and they said vnto them, Why haue ye not brought him?
jn.7.46	John 7:46	The officers answered, Neuer man spake like this man.
jn.7.47	John 7:47	Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceiued?
jn.7.48	John 7:48	Haue any of the rulers, or of the Pharises beleeued on him?
jn.7.49	John 7:49	But this people who knoweth not the Law, are cursed.
jn.7.50	John 7:50	Nicodemus saith vnto them, (He that came to Iesus by night, being one of them,)
jn.7.51	John 7:51	Doth our Law iudge any man before it heare him, & know what he doth?
jn.7.52	John 7:52	They answered, and said vnto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and looke: for out of Galilee ariseth no Prophet.
jn.7.53	John 7:53	And euery man went vnto his owne house.
jn.8.1	John 8:1	Iesus went vnto þ Mount of Oliues:
jn.8.2	John 8:2	And earely in the morning hee came againe into the Temple, and all the people came vnto him, and he sate downe, and taught them.
jn.8.3	John 8:3	And the Scribes and Pharisees brought vnto him a woman taken in adultery, and when they had set her in the mids,
jn.8.4	John 8:4	They say vnto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
jn.8.5	John 8:5	Now Moses in the Law commanded vs, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
jn.8.6	John 8:6	This they said, tempting him, that they might haue to accuse him. But Iesus stouped downe, and with his finger wrote on the ground as though he heard them not.
jn.8.7	John 8:7	So when they continued asking him, hee lift vp himselfe, and saide vnto them, Hee that is without sinne among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
jn.8.8	John 8:8	And againe, hee stouped downe, and wrote on the ground.
jn.8.9	John 8:9	And they which heard it, being conuicted by their owne conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, euen vnto the last: and Iesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
jn.8.10	John 8:10	When Iesus had lift vp himselfe, and saw none but the woman, hee said vnto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? Hath no man condemned thee?
jn.8.11	John 8:11	She saide, No man, Lord. And Iesus saide vnto her, Neither doe I condemne thee: Goe, and sinne no more.
jn.8.12	John 8:12	¶ Then spake Iesus againe vnto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth mee, shall not walke in darkenesse, but shall haue the light of life.
jn.8.13	John 8:13	The Pharisees therefore said vnto him, Thou bearest record of thy selfe, thy record is not true.
jn.8.14	John 8:14	Iesus answered, and said vnto them, Though I beare record of my selfe, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I goe: but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I goe.
jn.8.15	John 8:15	Yee iudge after the flesh, I iudge no man.
jn.8.16	John 8:16	And yet if I iudge, my iudgement is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
jn.8.17	John 8:17	It is also written in your Law, that the testimonie of two men is true.
jn.8.18	John 8:18	I am one that beare witnesse of my selfe, and the Father that sent mee, beareth witnesse of me.
jn.8.19	John 8:19	Then said they vnto him, Where is thy Father? Iesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had knowen mee, yee should haue knowen my Father also.
jn.8.20	John 8:20	These words spake Iesus in the treasury, as hee taught in the Temple: and no man layd hands on him, for his houre was not yet come.
jn.8.21	John 8:21	Then saide Iesus againe vnto them, I goe my way, and ye shall seeke me, & shall die in your sinnes: Whither I goe, ye cannot come.
jn.8.22	John 8:22	Then said the Iewes, Will hee kill himselfe? because he saith, Whither I goe, ye cannot come.
jn.8.23	John 8:23	And hee said vnto them, Yee are from beneath, I am from aboue: Yee are of this world, I am not of this world.
jn.8.24	John 8:24	I said therefore vnto you, that ye shall die in your sinnes. For if yee beleeue not that I am hee, yee shall die in your sinnes.
jn.8.25	John 8:25	Then said they vnto him, Who art thou? And Iesus saith vnto them, Euen the same that I saide vnto you from the beginning.
jn.8.26	John 8:26	I haue many things to say, and to iudge of you: But hee that sent mee is true, and I speake to the world, those things which I haue heard of him.
jn.8.27	John 8:27	They vnderstood not that hee spake to them of the Father.
jn.8.28	John 8:28	Then saide Iesus vnto them, When yee haue lift vp the Sonne of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I doe nothing of my selfe: but as my Father hath taught mee, I speake these things.
jn.8.29	John 8:29	And he that sent me, is with me: the Father hath not left mee alone: for I doe alwayes those things that please him.
jn.8.30	John 8:30	As hee spake those words, many beleeued on him.
jn.8.31	John 8:31	Then said Iesus to those Iewes which beleeued on him, If ye continue in my word, then are yee my disciples indeed.
jn.8.32	John 8:32	And ye shall know the Trueth, and the Trueth shall make you free.
jn.8.33	John 8:33	¶ They answered him, We be Abraham seed, and were neuer in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Yee shall be made free?
jn.8.34	John 8:34	Iesus answered them, Uerily, verily I say vnto you, Whosoeuer committeth sinne, is the seruant of sinne.
jn.8.35	John 8:35	And the seruant abideth not in the house for euer: but the Sonne abideth euer.
jn.8.36	John 8:36	If the Sonne therfore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
jn.8.37	John 8:37	I know that yee are Abrahams seed, but ye seeke to kill mee, because my word hath no place in you.
jn.8.38	John 8:38	I speake that which I haue seene with my Father: and ye do that which ye haue seene with your father.
jn.8.39	John 8:39	They answered, and said vnto him, Abraham is our father. Iesus sayth vnto them, If yee were Abrahams children, ye would doe the works of Abraham.
jn.8.40	John 8:40	But now yee seeke to kill me, a man that hath tolde you the trueth, which I haue heard of God: this did not Abraham.
jn.8.41	John 8:41	Ye doe the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not borne of fornication, wee haue one Father, euen God.
jn.8.42	John 8:42	Iesus said vnto them, If God were your Father, yee would loue me, for I proceeded foorth, and came from God: neither came I of my selfe, but he sent me.
jn.8.43	John 8:43	Why doe yee not vnderstand my speech? euen because yee cannot heare my word.
jn.8.44	John 8:44	Ye are of your father the deuill, and the lusts of your father ye will doe: hee was a murtherer from the beginning, and abode not in the trueth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his owne: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
jn.8.45	John 8:45	And because I tell you the truth, ye beleeue me not.
jn.8.46	John 8:46	Which of you conuinceth mee of sinne? And if I say the trueth, why doe ye not beleeue me?
jn.8.47	John 8:47	He that is of God, heareth Gods words: ye therefore heare them not, because ye are not of God.
jn.8.48	John 8:48	Then answered the Iewes, and said vnto him, Say wee not well that thou art a Samaritane, & hast a deuill?
jn.8.49	John 8:49	Iesus answered, I haue not a deuill: but I honour my Father, and ye doe dishonour me.
jn.8.50	John 8:50	And I seeke not mine owne glory, there is one that seeketh & iudgeth.
jn.8.51	John 8:51	Uerely, verely I say vnto you, If a man keepe my saying, hee shall neuer see death.
jn.8.52	John 8:52	Then said the Iewes vnto him, Now we know that thou hast a deuill. Abraham is dead, and the Prophets: and thou sayest, If a man keepe my saying, he shall neuer taste of death.
jn.8.53	John 8:53	Art thou greater then our father Abraham, which is dead? and the Prophets are dead: whom makest thou thy selfe?
jn.8.54	John 8:54	Iesus answered, If I honour myselfe, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me, of whom ye say, that he is your God:
jn.8.55	John 8:55	Yet ye haue not knowen him, but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shalbe a lyar like vnto you: but I know him, and keepe his saying.
jn.8.56	John 8:56	Your father Abraham reioyced to see my day: and he saw it, & was glad.
jn.8.57	John 8:57	Then said the Iewes vnto him, Thou art not yet fiftie yeeres olde, and hast thou seene Abraham?
jn.8.58	John 8:58	Iesus said vnto them, Uerely, verely I say vnto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
jn.8.59	John 8:59	Then tooke they vp stones to cast at him: but Iesus hidde himselfe, and went out of the Temple, going thorow the midst of them, and so passed by.
jn.9.1	John 9:1	And as Iesus passed by, he saw a man which was blinde from his birth.
jn.9.2	John 9:2	And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sinne, this man, or his parents, that he was borne blinde?
jn.9.3	John 9:3	Iesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the workes of God should be made manifest in him.
jn.9.4	John 9:4	I must worke the workes of him that sent me, while it is day: the night commeth when no man can worke.
jn.9.5	John 9:5	As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
jn.9.6	John 9:6	When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spettle, and he anointed the eyes of the blinde man with the clay,
jn.9.7	John 9:7	And said vnto him, Goe wash in the poole of Siloam (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therfore, and washed, and came seeing.
jn.9.8	John 9:8	¶ The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seene him, that he was blinde, said, Is not this he that sate and begged?
jn.9.9	John 9:9	Some said, This is hee: others said, Hee is like him: but hee sayd, I am hee.
jn.9.10	John 9:10	Therefore said they vnto him, How were thine eyes opened?
jn.9.11	John 9:11	He answered and said, A man that is called Iesus, made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said vnto me, Goe to the poole of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I receiued sight.
jn.9.12	John 9:12	Then said they vnto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
jn.9.13	John 9:13	¶ They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
jn.9.14	John 9:14	And it was the Sabbath day when Iesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
jn.9.15	John 9:15	Then againe the Pharisees also asked him how he had receiued his sight. He said vnto them, Hee put clay vpon mine eyes, and I washed, and doe see.
jn.9.16	John 9:16	Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because hee keepeth not the Sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner, doe such miracles? and there was a diuision among them.
jn.9.17	John 9:17	They say vnto the blind man againe, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, Hee is a Prophet.
jn.9.18	John 9:18	But the Iewes did not beleeue concerning him, that hee had bin blind, and receiued his sight, vntill they called the parents of him that had receiued his sight.
jn.9.19	John 9:19	And they asked them, saying, Is this your sonne, who ye say was borne blind? how then doth he now see?
jn.9.20	John 9:20	His parents answered them, and said, We know that this is our sonne, and that he was borne blind:
jn.9.21	John 9:21	But by what meanes he now seeth, we know not, or who hath opened his eyes we know not: hee is of age, aske him, he shall speake for himselfe.
jn.9.22	John 9:22	These words spake his parents, because they feared the Iewes: for the Iewes had agreed already, that if any man did confesse that he was Christ, he should be put out of the Synagogue.
jn.9.23	John 9:23	Therefore said his parents, He is of age, aske him.
jn.9.24	John 9:24	Then againe called they the man that was blind, and said vnto him, Giue God the praise, we know that this man is a sinner.
jn.9.25	John 9:25	He answered, and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: One thing I know, that whereas I was blind, now I see.
jn.9.26	John 9:26	Then saide they to him againe, What did he to thee? How opened hee thine eyes?
jn.9.27	John 9:27	He answered them, I haue told you already, and ye did not heare: wherfore would you heare it againe? Will ye also be his disciples?
jn.9.28	John 9:28	Then they reuiled him, and said, Thou art his disciple, but we are Moses disciples.
jn.9.29	John 9:29	Wee know that God spake vnto Moses: as for this fellow, we knowe not from whence he is.
jn.9.30	John 9:30	The man answered, and said vnto them, Why herein is a marueilous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
jn.9.31	John 9:31	Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man bee a worshipper of God, and doth his will, him he heareth.
jn.9.32	John 9:32	Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was borne blinde:
jn.9.33	John 9:33	If this man were not of God, he could doe nothing.
jn.9.34	John 9:34	They answered, and saide vnto him, Thou wast altogether borne in sinnes, and doest thou teach vs? And they cast him out.
jn.9.35	John 9:35	Iesus heard that they had cast him out; and when hee had found him, he said vnto him, Doest thou beleeue on the Sonne of God?
jn.9.36	John 9:36	He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might beleeue on him?
jn.9.37	John 9:37	And Iesus said vnto him, Thou hast both seene him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
jn.9.38	John 9:38	And he said, Lord, I beleeue: and he worshipped him.
jn.9.39	John 9:39	¶ And Iesus said, For iudgment I am come into this world, that they which see not, might see, and that they which see, might be made blind.

jn.9.41	John 9:41	Iesus saide vnto them, If yee were blind, ye should haue no sinne: but now ye say, We see, therfore your sinne remaineth.
jn.10.1	John 10:1	Uerily, verily I say vnto you, He that entreth not by þ doore into the sheepefold, but climeth vp some other way, the same is a theefe, and a robber.
jn.10.2	John 10:2	But hee that entreth in by the doore, is the shepherd of the sheepe.
jn.10.3	John 10:3	To him the porter openeth, and the sheepe heare his voyce, and he calleth his owne sheepe by name, and leadeth them out.
jn.10.4	John 10:4	And when he putteth foorth his owne sheepe, he goeth before them, and the sheepe follow him: for they know his voyce.
jn.10.5	John 10:5	And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him, for they know not the voyce of strangers.
jn.10.6	John 10:6	This parable spake Iesus vnto them: but they vnderstood not what things they were which he spake vnto them.
jn.10.7	John 10:7	Then said Iesus vnto them againe, Uerily, verily I say vnto you, I am the doore of the sheepe.
jn.10.8	John 10:8	All that euer came before me, are theeues and robbers: but the sheepe did not heare them.
jn.10.9	John 10:9	I am the doore by me if any man enter in, he shall be saued, and shall goe in and out, and find pasture.
jn.10.10	John 10:10	The theefe commeth not, but for to steale and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might haue life, and that they might haue it more abundantly.
jn.10.11	John 10:11	I am the good shepheard: the good shepheard giueth his life for the sheepe.
jn.10.12	John 10:12	But hee that is an hireling and not the shepheard, whose owne the sheepe are not, seeth the woolfe coming, and leaueth the sheep, and fleeth: and the woolfe catcheth them, and scattereth the sheepe.
jn.10.13	John 10:13	The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, & careth not for the sheepe.
jn.10.14	John 10:14	I am the good shepheard, and know my sheepe, and am knowen of mine.
jn.10.15	John 10:15	As the father knoweth me, euen so know I the father: & I lay downe my life for the sheepe.
jn.10.16	John 10:16	And other sheepe I haue, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall heare my voyce; and there shall be one fold, and one shepheard.
jn.10.17	John 10:17	Therefore doth my father loue me, because I lay downe my life that I might take it againe.
jn.10.18	John 10:18	No man taketh it from me, but I lay it downe of my selfe: I haue power to lay it downe, and I haue power to take it againe. This commandement haue I receiued of my father.
jn.10.19	John 10:19	¶ There was a diuision therefore againe among the Iewes for these sayings.
jn.10.20	John 10:20	And many of them said, He hath a deuill, and is mad, why heare ye him?
jn.10.21	John 10:21	Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a deuill. Can a deuill open the eyes of the blind?
jn.10.22	John 10:22	¶ And it was at Hierusalem the feast of the dedication, & it was winter.
jn.10.23	John 10:23	And Iesus walked in the temple in Solomons porch.
jn.10.24	John 10:24	Then came the Iewes round about him, and said vnto him, How long doest thou make vs to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell vs plainely.
jn.10.25	John 10:25	Iesus answered them, I told you, and ye beleeued not: the workes that I doe in my Fathers name, they beare witnesse of me.
jn.10.26	John 10:26	But ye beleeue not, because ye are not of my sheepe, as I said vnto you.
jn.10.27	John 10:27	My sheepe heare my voyce, and I know them, and they follow me.
jn.10.28	John 10:28	And I giue vnto them eternall life, and they shall neuer perish, neither shall any man plucke them out of my hand.
jn.10.29	John 10:29	My father which gaue them me, is greater then all: and no man is able to plucke them out of my fathers hand.
jn.10.30	John 10:30	I and my father are one.
jn.10.31	John 10:31	Then the Iewes tooke vp stones againe to stone him.
jn.10.32	John 10:32	Iesus answered them, Many good workes haue I shewed you from my Father; for which of those workes doe ye stone me?
jn.10.33	John 10:33	The Iewes answered him, saying, For a good worke we stone thee not, but for blasphemy, and because that thou, being a man, makest thy selfe God.
jn.10.34	John 10:34	Iesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, ye are gods?
jn.10.35	John 10:35	If hee called them gods, vnto whom the word of God came, and the Scripture cannot be broken:
jn.10.36	John 10:36	Say ye of him, whom the father hath sanctified and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Sonne of God?
jn.10.37	John 10:37	If I doe not the workes of my Father, beleeue me not.

jn.11.1	John 11:1	Now a certaine man was sicke, named Lazarus of Bethanie, the towne of Mary, and her sister Martha.

jn.15.1	John 15:1	I am the true vine, and my Father is þ husbandman.

jn.18.1	John 18:1	When Iesus had spoken these wordes, hee went foorth with his disciples ouer the Brooke Cedron, where was a garden, into the which hee entred and his disciples.

jn.18.3	John 18:3	Iudas then hauing receiued a band of men, and officers from the chiefe Priests and Pharisees, commeth thither with lanternes and torches, and weapons.

jn.18.13	John 18:13	And led him away to Annas first, (for he was father in law to Caiaphas) which was the high Priest that same yeere.
jn.18.14	John 18:14	Now Caiaphas was he which gaue counsell to the Iewes, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
jn.18.15	John 18:15	¶ And Simon Peter followed Iesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was knowen vnto the high Priest, and went in with Iesus into the palace of the high Priest.
jn.18.16	John 18:16	But Peter stood at the doore without. Then went out that other disciple, which was knowen vnto the high Priest, and spake vnto her that kept the doore, and brought in Peter.

jn.18.18	John 18:18	And the seruants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coales, (for it was colde) and they warmed themselues: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himselfe.
jn.18.19	John 18:19	¶ The high Priest then asked Iesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
jn.18.20	John 18:20	Iesus answered him, I spake openly to the world, I euer taught in the Synagogue, and in the Temple, whither the Iewes alwayes resort, and in secret haue I said nothing:
jn.18.21	John 18:21	Why askest thou me? Aske them which heard me, what I haue said vnto them: behold, they know what I said.

jn.18.23	John 18:23	Iesus answered him, If I haue spoken euill, beare witnesse of the euill: but if well, why smitest thou me?
jn.18.24	John 18:24	Now Annas had sent him bound vnto Caiaphas the high Priest.
jn.18.25	John 18:25	And Simon Peter stood and warmed himselfe: They said therefore vnto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? Hee denied it, and said, I am not.
jn.18.26	John 18:26	One of the seruants of the high Priests (being his kinsman whose eare Peter cut off) saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
jn.18.27	John 18:27	Peter then denied againe, and immediatly the cocke crew.
jn.18.28	John 18:28	¶ Then led they Iesus from Caiaphas vnto the hall of Iudgement: And it was earely, and they themselues went not into the Iudgement hall, lest they should be defiled: but that they might eat the Passeouer.
jn.18.29	John 18:29	Pilate then went out vnto them, and said, What accusation bring you against this man?
jn.18.30	John 18:30	They answered, & said vnto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not haue deliuered him vp vnto thee.
jn.18.31	John 18:31	Then saide Pilate vnto them, Take ye him, and iudge him according to your law. The Iewes therefore said vnto him, It is not lawfull for vs to put any man to death:
jn.18.32	John 18:32	That the saying of Iesus might be fulfilled, which hee spake, signifying what death he should die.
jn.18.33	John 18:33	Then Pilate entred into the Iudgement hall againe, and called Iesus, and saide vnto him, Art thou the King of the Iewes?
jn.18.34	John 18:34	Iesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thy selfe? or did others tell it thee of me?
jn.18.35	John 18:35	Pilate answered, Am I a Iew? Thine owne nation, and the chiefe Priests haue deliuered thee vnto mee: What hast thou done?
jn.18.36	John 18:36	Iesus answered, My kingdome is not of this world: if my kingdome were of this world, then would my seruants fight, that I should not be deliuered to the Iewes: but now is my kingdome not from hence.
jn.18.37	John 18:37	Pilate therefore saide vnto him, Art thou a King then? Iesus answered, Thou saiest that I am a King. To this end was I borne, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should beare witnesse vnto the trueth: euery one that is of the trueth heareth my voice.

jn.18.40	John 18:40	Then cried they all againe, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

jn.19.23	John 19:23	¶ Then the souldiers, when they had crucified Iesus, tooke his garments, (and made foure parts, to euery souldier a part) and also his coat: Now the coate was without seame, wouen from the top thorowout.

jn.19.25	John 19:25	¶ Now there stood by the crosse of Iesus, his mother, and his mothers sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

jn.19.31	John 19:31	The Iewes therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remaine vpon the Crosse on the Sabbath day (for that Sabbath day was an high day) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
jn.19.32	John 19:32	Then came the souldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other, which was crucified with him.
jn.19.33	John 19:33	But when they came to Iesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs.
