jm.2.5	James 2:5	Hearken, my beloued brethren, Hath not God chosen the poore of this world, rich in faith, and heires of the kingdome, which hee hath promised to them that loue him?
jm.2.6	James 2:6	But yee haue despised the poore. Doe not rich men oppresse you, and draw you before the Iudgement seats?
jm.2.7	James 2:7	Doe not they blaspheme that worthy Name, by the which ye are called?
jm.2.8	James 2:8	If ye fulfil the royall Law, according to the Scripture, Thou shalt loue thy neighbour as thy selfe, ye doe well.
jm.2.9	James 2:9	But if ye haue respect to persons, ye commit sinne, and are conuinced of the Law, as transgressours.
jm.2.10	James 2:10	For whosoeuer shall keepe the whole Law, & yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
jm.2.11	James 2:11	For he that said, Doe not commit adultery; sayd also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressour of the Law.
jm.2.12	James 2:12	So speake ye, and so doe, as they that shall bee iudged by the Law of libertie.
jm.2.13	James 2:13	For he shall haue iudgement without mercie, that hath shewed no mercy, & mercie reioyceth against iudgement.
jm.2.14	James 2:14	What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say hee hath faith, and haue not workes? can faith saue him?
jm.2.15	James 2:15	If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of dayly foode,
jm.2.16	James 2:16	And one of you say vnto them, Depart in peace, be you warmed & filled: notwithstanding ye giue them not those things which are needfull to the body: what doth it profit?
jm.2.17	James 2:17	Euen so faith, if it hath not works, is dead being alone.
jm.2.18	James 2:18	Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I haue workes: shew mee thy faith without thy workes, and I will shew thee my faith by my workes.
jm.2.19	James 2:19	Thou beleeuest that there is one God, thou doest well: the deuils also beleeue, and tremble.
jm.2.20	James 2:20	But wilt thou knowe, O vaine man, that faith without workes is dead?
jm.2.21	James 2:21	Was not Abraham our father iustified by works, when hee had offered Isaac his sonne vpon the altar?
jm.2.22	James 2:22	Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
jm.2.23	James 2:23	And the Scripture was fullfiled which saith, Abraham beleeued God, and it was imputed vnto him for righteousnes: and he was called the friend of God.
jm.2.24	James 2:24	Ye see then, how that by workes a man is iustified, and not by faith only.
jm.2.25	James 2:25	Likewise also, was not Rahab the harlot iustified by works, when she had receiued the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
jm.2.26	James 2:26	For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without workes is dead also.
jm.3.1	James 3:1	My brethren, bee not many masters, knowing that we shall receiue the greater condemnation.
jm.3.2	James 3:2	For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
jm.3.3	James 3:3	Behold, we put bittes in the horses mouthes, that they may obey vs, and we turne about their whole body.
jm.3.4	James 3:4	Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driuen of fierce windes, yet are they turned about with a very small helme, whithersoeuer the gouernour listeth.
jm.3.5	James 3:5	Euen so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things: behold, how great a matter a litle fire kindleth.
jm.3.6	James 3:6	And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquitie: so is the tongue amongst our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature, and it is set on fire of hell.
jm.3.7	James 3:7	For euery kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind.
jm.3.8	James 3:8	But the tongue can no man tame, it is an vnruly euill, ful of deadly poyson.
jm.3.9	James 3:9	Therewith blesse wee God, euen the Father: and therewith curse wee men, which are made after the similitude of God.
jm.3.10	James 3:10	Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing: my brethren, these things ought not so to be.
jm.3.11	James 3:11	Doeth a fountaine send foorth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
jm.3.12	James 3:12	Can þ figtree, my brethren, beare oliue berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountaine both yeeld salt water & fresh.
jm.3.13	James 3:13	Who is a wise man and indued with knowledge amongst you? let him shew out of a good conuersation his workes with meekenes of wisedome.
jm.3.14	James 3:14	But if ye haue bitter enuying and strife in your hearts glory not, and lie not against the trueth.
jm.3.15	James 3:15	This wisedome descendeth not from aboue, but is earthly, sensuall, deuilish.
jm.3.16	James 3:16	For where enuying and strife is, there is confusion, and euery euill worke.
jm.3.17	James 3:17	But the wisedome that is from aboue, is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easie to be intreated, full of mercy, and good fruits, without partialitie, and without hypocrisie.
jm.3.18	James 3:18	And the fruit of righteousnesse is sowen in peace, of them that make peace.
jm.4.1	James 4:1	From whence come warres and fightings among you? come they not hence, euen of your lusts, that warre in your members?
jm.4.2	James 4:2	Ye lust, and haue not: yee kill, and desire to haue, and cannot obtaine: yee fight and warre, yet yee haue not, because ye aske not.
jm.4.3	James 4:3	Ye aske and receiue not, because ye aske amisse, that yee may consume it vpon your lusts.
jm.4.4	James 4:4	Ye adulterers, and adulteresses, know yee not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoeuer therefore will be a friend of the world, is the enemy of God.
jm.4.5	James 4:5	Doe ye thinke that the Scripture saith in vaine, the spirit that dwelleth in vs lusteth to enuy?
jm.4.6	James 4:6	But he giueth more grace, wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proude, but giueth grace vnto the humble.
jm.4.7	James 4:7	Submit your selues therefore to God: resist the deuill, and hee will flee from you.
jm.4.8	James 4:8	Draw nigh to God, and hee will draw nigh to you: cleanse your hands ye sinners, and purifie your hearts yee double minded.
jm.4.9	James 4:9	Bee afflicted, and mourne, and weepe: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your ioy to heauinesse.
jm.4.10	James 4:10	Humble your selues in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you vp.
jm.4.11	James 4:11	Speake not euill one of another (brethren:) he that speaketh euill of his brother, and iudgeth his brother, speaketh euill of the Law, and iudgeth the Law: but if thou iudge the Law, thou art not a doer of the Law, but a iudge.
jm.4.12	James 4:12	There is one Lawgiuer, who is able to saue, and to destroy: who art thou that iudgest another?
jm.4.13	James 4:13	Goe to now ye that say, To day or to morrow wee will goe into such a city and continue there a yere, and buy, and sell, and get gaine:
jm.4.14	James 4:14	Whereas yee know not what shalbe on the morow: for what is your life? It is euen a vapour that appeareth for a litle time, and then vanisheth away.
jm.4.15	James 4:15	For that yee ought to say, if the Lord will, we shall liue, and doe this, or that.
jm.4.16	James 4:16	But now yee reioyce in your boastings: all such reioycing is euill.
jm.4.17	James 4:17	Therefore to him that knoweth to doe good, and doth it not, to him it is sinne.
jm.5.1	James 5:1	Goe to now, yee rich men, weepe and howle for your miseries that shall come vpon you.
jm.5.2	James 5:2	Your riches are corrupted, and your garments motheaten:
jm.5.3	James 5:3	Your gold and siluer is cankered, and the rust of them shall bee a witnesse against you, and shall eate your flesh as it were fire: ye haue heaped treasure together for the last dayes.
jm.5.4	James 5:4	Beholde, the hire of the labourers which haue reaped downe your fieldes, which is of you kept backe by fraud, cryeth: and the cryes of them which haue reaped, are entred into the eares of the Lord of Sabaoth.
jm.5.5	James 5:5	Yee haue liued in pleasure on the earth, and bene wanton: ye haue nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter:
jm.5.6	James 5:6	Yee haue condemned, and killed the iust, and he doth not resist you.
jm.5.7	James 5:7	Be patient therefore, brethren, vnto the comming of the Lord: behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, vntill hee receiue the early and latter raine.
jm.5.8	James 5:8	Be yee also patient; stablish your hearts: for the comming of the Lorde draweth nigh.
jm.5.9	James 5:9	Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the Iudge standeth before the doore.
jm.5.10	James 5:10	Take, my brethren, the Prophets, who haue spoken in the Name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
jm.5.11	James 5:11	Beholde, wee count them happie which endure. Ye haue heard of the patience of Iob, and haue seene the end of the Lord: that the Lord is very pitifull and of tender mercie.
jm.5.12	James 5:12	But aboue all things, my brethren, sweare not, neither by heauen, neither by the earth, neither by any other othe: but let your yea, be yea, and your nay, nay: lest yee fall into condemnation.
jm.5.13	James 5:13	Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing Psalmes.
jm.5.14	James 5:14	Is any sicke among you? let him call for the Elders of the Church, and let them pray ouer him, anointing him with oyle in the Name of the Lord:
jm.5.15	James 5:15	And the prayer of Faith shall saue the sicke, and the Lord shall raise him vp: and if hee haue committed sinnes, they shall be forgiuen him.
jm.5.16	James 5:16	Confesse your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that yee may bee healed: the effectuall feruent prayer of a righteous man auaileth much.
jm.5.17	James 5:17	Elias was a man subiect to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not raine: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three yeeres and sixe monethes.
jm.5.18	James 5:18	And hee prayed againe, and the heauen gaue raine, and the earth brought foorth her fruit.
jm.5.19	James 5:19	Brethren, if any of you doe erre from the trueth, and one conuert him,
jm.5.20	James 5:20	Let him know, that hee which conuerteth the sinner from the errour of his way, shall saue a soule from death, and shall hide a multitude of sinnes.
1pe.1.1	1 Peter 1:1	Peter an Apostle of Iesus Christ, to the strangers scattred thorowout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
1pe.1.2	1 Peter 1:2	Elect, according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit vnto obedience, and sprinkling of the blood of Iesus Christ: Grace vnto you and peace be multiplied.
1pe.1.3	1 Peter 1:3	Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Iesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy, hath begotten vs againe vnto a liuely hope, by the resurrection of Iesus Christ from the dead,
1pe.1.4	1 Peter 1:4	To an inheritance incorruptible, and vndefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserued in heauen for you,
1pe.1.5	1 Peter 1:5	Who are kept by the power of God through faith vnto saluation, ready to be reuealed in the last time.
1pe.1.6	1 Peter 1:6	Wherin ye greatly reioyce, though now for a season (if neede bee) yee are in heauinesse through manifolde temptations:
1pe.1.7	1 Peter 1:7	That the triall of your faith, being much more precious then of golde that perisheth, though it bee tryed with fire, might be found vnto praise, and honor, and glory, at the appearing of Iesus Christ:
1pe.1.8	1 Peter 1:8	Whom hauing not seene, yee loue, in whom though now ye see him not, yet beleeuing, ye reioyce with ioy vnspeakeable, and full of glory,
1pe.1.9	1 Peter 1:9	Receiuing the ende of your faith, euen the saluation of your soules:
1pe.1.10	1 Peter 1:10	Of which saluation the Prophets haue inquired, and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come vnto you,
1pe.1.11	1 Peter 1:11	Searching what, or what maner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signifie, when it testified beforehand the suffrings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
1pe.1.12	1 Peter 1:12	Unto whome it was reuealed, that not vnto themselues, but vnto vs, they did minister the things which are now reported vnto you, by them that haue preached the Gospel vnto you, with the holy Ghost sent downe from heauen, which things the Angels desire to looke into.
1pe.1.13	1 Peter 1:13	Wherefore gird vp the loynes of your minde, bee sober, and hope to the end, for the grace that is to bee brought vnto you at the reuelation of Iesus Christ:
1pe.1.14	1 Peter 1:14	As obedient children, not fashioning your selues according to the former lusts, in your ignorance:
1pe.1.15	1 Peter 1:15	But as hee which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all maner of conuersation;
1pe.1.16	1 Peter 1:16	Because it is written, Be ye holy, for I am holy.
1pe.1.17	1 Peter 1:17	And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons iudgeth according to euery mans worke, passe the time of your soiourning here in feare:
1pe.1.18	1 Peter 1:18	For as much as ye know that yee were not redeemed with corruptible things, as siluer and golde, from your vaine conuersation receiued by tradition from your fathers;
1pe.1.19	1 Peter 1:19	But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a Lambe without blemish and without spot,
1pe.1.20	1 Peter 1:20	Who verily was foreordeined before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you.
1pe.1.21	1 Peter 1:21	Who by him do beleeue in God that raised him vp from the dead, and gaue him glorie, that your faith and hope might be in God.
1pe.1.22	1 Peter 1:22	Seeing yee haue purified your soules in obeying the truth through the Spirit, vnto vnfained loue of the brethren: see that ye loue one another with a pure heart feruently,
1pe.1.23	1 Peter 1:23	Being borne againe, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God which liueth and abideth for euer.
1pe.1.24	1 Peter 1:24	For all flesh is as grasse, and all the glory of man as the flowre of grasse: the grasse withereth, and the flowre thereof falleth away.
1pe.1.25	1 Peter 1:25	But the word of the Lord endureth for euer: & this is the word which by the Gospel is preached vnto you.
1pe.2.1	1 Peter 2:1	Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and enuies, and euill speakings,
1pe.2.2	1 Peter 2:2	As new borne babes desire the sincere milke of the word, that ye may grow thereby,
1pe.2.3	1 Peter 2:3	If so bee yee haue tasted that the Lord is gracious.
1pe.2.4	1 Peter 2:4	To whom comming as vnto a liuing Stone, disallowed in deed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
1pe.2.5	1 Peter 2:5	Ye also as liuely stones, are built vp a spirituall house, an holy Priesthood to offer vp spirituall sacrifice, acceptable to God by Iesus Christ.
1pe.2.6	1 Peter 2:6	Wherefore it is conteined in the Scripture, Beholde, I lay in Sion a chiefe corner stone, elect, precious, and he that beleeueth on him, shall not be confounded.
1pe.2.7	1 Peter 2:7	Unto you therfore which beleeue hee is precious; but vnto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
1pe.2.8	1 Peter 2:8	And a Stone of stumbling, and a Rocke of offence, euen to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient, whereunto also they were appointed.
1pe.2.9	1 Peter 2:9	But yee are a chosen generation, a royall Priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people, that yee should shewe forth the praises of him, who hath called you out of darknes into his marueilous light:
1pe.2.10	1 Peter 2:10	Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obteined mercie, but now haue obteined mercy.
1pe.2.11	1 Peter 2:11	Dearely beloued, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrimes, abstaine from fleshly lusts, which warre against the soule,
1pe.2.12	1 Peter 2:12	Hauing your conuersation honest among the Gentiles, that whereas they speake against you as euill doers, they may by your good works which they shall behold, glorifie God in the day of visitation.
1pe.2.13	1 Peter 2:13	Submit your selues to euery ordinance of man for the Lordes sake, whether it be to the King, as supreme,
1pe.2.14	1 Peter 2:14	Or vnto gouernours, as vnto them that are sent by him, for the punishment of euil doers, and for the praise of them that doe well.
1pe.2.15	1 Peter 2:15	For so is the will of God, that with well doing yee may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
1pe.2.16	1 Peter 2:16	As free, and not vsing your libertie for a cloake of maliciousnesse, but as the seruants of God.
1pe.2.17	1 Peter 2:17	Honour all men. Loue the brotherhood. Feare God. Honour the King.
1pe.2.18	1 Peter 2:18	Seruants, be subiect to your masters with al feare, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
1pe.2.19	1 Peter 2:19	For this is thanke-worthie, if a man for conscience toward God endure griefe, suffering wrongfully.
1pe.2.20	1 Peter 2:20	For what glory is it, if when yee be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently: but if when yee doe well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
1pe.2.21	1 Peter 2:21	For euen hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for vs, leauing vs an example, that yee should follow his steps.
1pe.2.22	1 Peter 2:22	Who did no sinne, neither was guile found in his mouth.
1pe.2.23	1 Peter 2:23	Who when hee was reuiled, reuiled not againe; when hee suffered, hee threatned not, but committed himselfe to him that iudgeth righteously.
1pe.2.24	1 Peter 2:24	Who his owne selfe bare our sinnes in his owne body on the tree, that wee being dead to sinnes, should liue vnto righteousnesse, by whose stripes ye were healed.
1pe.2.25	1 Peter 2:25	For yee were as sheepe going astray, but are now returned vnto the shepheard and Bishop of your soules.
1pe.3.1	1 Peter 3:1	Likewise, ye wiues, be in subiection to your owne husbands, that if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be wonne by the conuersation of the wiues:
1pe.3.2	1 Peter 3:2	While they beholde your chaste conuersation coupled with feare:
1pe.3.3	1 Peter 3:3	Whose adorning, let it not bee that outward adorning, of plaiting the haire, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparell.
1pe.3.4	1 Peter 3:4	But let it bee the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, euen the ornament of a meeke and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
1pe.3.5	1 Peter 3:5	For after this manner in the olde time, the holy women also who trusted in God adorned themselues, beeing in subiection vnto their owne husbands.
1pe.3.6	1 Peter 3:6	Euen as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him Lord, whose daughters ye are as long as ye doe well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
1pe.3.7	1 Peter 3:7	Likewise ye husbands, dwel with them according to knowledge, giuing honour vnto the wife as vnto the weaker vessel, and as being heires together of the grace of life, that your prayers be not hindered.
1pe.3.8	1 Peter 3:8	Finally be ye all of one minde, hauing compassion one of another, loue as brethren, be pitifull, be courteous,
1pe.3.9	1 Peter 3:9	Not rendring euill for euill, or railing for railing: but contrarywise blessing, knowing that yee are thereunto called, that ye should inherite a blessing.
1pe.3.10	1 Peter 3:10	For hee that will loue life, and see good dayes, let him refraine his tongue from euil, and his lips that they speake no guile:
1pe.3.11	1 Peter 3:11	Let him eschew euil and do good, let him seeke peace and ensue it.
1pe.3.12	1 Peter 3:12	For the eyes of the Lord are ouer the righteous, and his eares are open vnto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that doe euill.
1pe.3.13	1 Peter 3:13	And who is hee that will harme you, if ye bee followers of that which is good?
1pe.3.14	1 Peter 3:14	But and if ye suffer for righteousnes sake, happy are ye, and be not afraid of their terrour, neither be troubled:
1pe.3.15	1 Peter 3:15	But sanctifie the Lord God in your hearts, & be ready alwayes to giue an answere to euery man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you, with meekenesse and feare:
1pe.3.16	1 Peter 3:16	Hauing a good conscience, that whereas they speake euill of you, as of euill doers, they may bee ashamed that falsly accuse your good conuersation in Christ.
1pe.3.17	1 Peter 3:17	For it is better, if the will of God be so, that yee suffer for well doing, then for euill doing.
1pe.3.18	1 Peter 3:18	For Christ also hath once suffered for sinnes, the iust for the vniust, that he might bring vs to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit.
1pe.3.19	1 Peter 3:19	By which also he went and preached vnto the spirits in prison,
1pe.3.20	1 Peter 3:20	Which sometime were disobedient, when once the long-suffering of God waited in the dayes of Noah, while the Arke was a preparing: wherein few, that is, eight soules were saued by water.
1pe.3.21	1 Peter 3:21	The like figure whereunto, euen Baptisme, doth also now saue vs, (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answere of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Iesus Christ.
1pe.3.22	1 Peter 3:22	Who is gone into heauen, and is on the right hand of God, Angels, and authorities, and powers being made subiect vnto him.
1pe.4.1	1 Peter 4:1	For asmuch then as Christ hath suffered for vs in the flesh, arme your selues likewise with the same minde: for hee that hath suffered in the flesh, hath ceassed from sinne:
1pe.4.2	1 Peter 4:2	That he no longer should liue the rest of his time in the flesh, to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
1pe.4.3	1 Peter 4:3	For the time past of our life may suffice vs to haue wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciuiousnes, lusts, excesse of wine, reuellings, banquetings, and abhominable idolatries.
1pe.4.4	1 Peter 4:4	Wherein they thinke it strange, that you runne not with them to the same excesse of riot, speaking euil of you:
1pe.4.5	1 Peter 4:5	Who shal giue accompt to him that is ready to iudge the quicke & the dead.
1pe.4.6	1 Peter 4:6	For, for this cause was the Gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might bee iudged according to men in the flesh, but liue according to God in the spirit.
1pe.4.7	1 Peter 4:7	But the ende of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober and watch vnto prayer.
1pe.4.8	1 Peter 4:8	And aboue all things haue feruent charitie among your selues: for charity shall couer the multitude of sinnes.
1pe.4.9	1 Peter 4:9	Use hospitalitie one to another without grudging.
1pe.4.10	1 Peter 4:10	As euery man hath receiued the gift, euen so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
1pe.4.11	1 Peter 4:11	If any man speake, let him speake as the oracles of God: if any man minister, let him doe it as of the ability which God giueth, that God in all things may bee glorified through Iesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for euer and euer. Amen.
1pe.4.12	1 Peter 4:12	Beloued, thinke it not strange concerning the fiery triall, which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened vnto you.
1pe.4.13	1 Peter 4:13	But reioyce in as much as yee are partakers of Christes sufferings; that when his glory shalbe reueiled, ye may be glad also with exceeding ioy.
1pe.4.14	1 Peter 4:14	If ye be reproched for the Name of Christ, happie are ye, for the spirit of glory, and of God resteth vpon you: on their part hee is euill spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
1pe.4.15	1 Peter 4:15	But let none of you suffer as a murtherer, or as a theefe, or as an euill doer, or as a busibody in other mens matters.
1pe.4.16	1 Peter 4:16	Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorifie God on this behalfe.
1pe.4.17	1 Peter 4:17	For the time is come that iudgement must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at vs, what shall the ende bee of them that obey not the Gospel of God?
1pe.4.18	1 Peter 4:18	And if the righteous scarcely be saued, where shall the vngodly and the sinner appeare?
1pe.4.19	1 Peter 4:19	Wherfore, let them that suffer according to the will of God, commit the keeping of their soules to him in well doing, as vnto a faithfull Creator.
1pe.5.1	1 Peter 5:1	The Elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an Elder, and a witnesse of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be reuealed.
1pe.5.2	1 Peter 5:2	Feede the flocke of God which is among you, taking the ouersight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly: not for filthy lucre, but of a ready minde:
1pe.5.3	1 Peter 5:3	Neither as being lords ouer Gods heritage: but being ensamples to the flocke.
1pe.5.4	1 Peter 5:4	And when the chiefe shepheard shall appeare, ye shall receiue a crowne of glory that fadeth not away.
1pe.5.5	1 Peter 5:5	Likewise ye yonger, submit your selues vnto the elder: yea, all of you bee subiect one to another, and bee clothed with humilitie: for God resisteth the proud, and giueth grace to the humble.
1pe.5.6	1 Peter 5:6	Humble yourselues therefore vnder the mighty hand of God, that hee may exalt you in due time,
1pe.5.7	1 Peter 5:7	Casting all your care vpon him, for he careth for you.
1pe.5.8	1 Peter 5:8	Be sober, be vigilant: because your aduersary the deuill, as a roaring Lion walketh about, seeking whom he may deuoure.
1pe.5.9	1 Peter 5:9	Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
1pe.5.10	1 Peter 5:10	But the God of all grace who hath called vs into his eternall glory by Christ Iesus, after that ye haue suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
1pe.5.11	1 Peter 5:11	To him bee glory and dominion for euer and euer. Amen.
1pe.5.12	1 Peter 5:12	By Syluanus a faithfull brother vnto you, (as I suppose) I haue written briefly, exhorting, & testifying, that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
1pe.5.13	1 Peter 5:13	The Church that is at Babylon elected, together with you, saluteth you, and so doth Marcus my sonne.
1pe.5.14	1 Peter 5:14	Greete yee one another with a kisse of charity: Peace bee with you all that are in Christ Iesus. Amen.
2pe.1.1	2 Peter 1:1	Simon Peter, a seruant & an Apostle of Iesus Christ, to them that haue obtained like precious Faith with vs, through the righteousnes of God, and our Sauiour Iesus Christ.
2pe.1.2	2 Peter 1:2	Grace and peace be multiplied vnto you through the knowledge of God, and of Iesus our Lord,
2pe.1.3	2 Peter 1:3	According as his diuine power hath giuen vnto vs all things that pertain vnto life and godlines, through the knowledge of him that hath called vs to glory and vertue.
2pe.1.4	2 Peter 1:4	Whereby are giuen vnto vs exceeding great and precious promises, that by these you might bee partakers of the diuine nature, hauing escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
2pe.1.5	2 Peter 1:5	And besides this, giuing all diligence, adde to your faith, vertue; and to vertue knowledge;
2pe.1.6	2 Peter 1:6	And to knowledge, temperance; and to temperance, patience; and to patience, godlinesse;
2pe.1.7	2 Peter 1:7	And to godlinesse, brotherly kindnesse; and to brotherly kindnesse, charitie.
2pe.1.8	2 Peter 1:8	For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that yee shall neither be barren, nor vnfruitfull in the knowledge of our Lord Iesus Christ.
2pe.1.9	2 Peter 1:9	But hee that lacketh these things, is blind, and cannot see farre off, and hath forgotten that hee was purged from his old sinnes.
2pe.1.10	2 Peter 1:10	Wherefore, the rather, brethren, giue diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye doe these things, ye shall neuer fall.
2pe.1.11	2 Peter 1:11	For so an entrance shall be ministred vnto you abundantly, into the euerlasting kingdome of our Lord and Sauiour Iesus Christ.
2pe.1.12	2 Peter 1:12	Wherefore I wil not be negligent to put you alwayes in remembrance of these things, though yee know them, and be stablished in the present trueth.
2pe.1.13	2 Peter 1:13	Yea, I thinke it meete, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stirre you vp, by putting you in remembrance:
2pe.1.14	2 Peter 1:14	Knowing that shortly I must put off this my Tabernacle, euen as our Lord Iesus Christ hath shewed mee.
2pe.1.15	2 Peter 1:15	Moreouer, I will endeuour, that you may bee able after my decease, to haue these things alwayes in remembrance.
2pe.1.16	2 Peter 1:16	For wee haue not followed cunningly deuised fables, when wee made knowen vnto you the power and comming of our Lord Iesus Christ, but were eye witnesses of his Maiestie.
2pe.1.17	2 Peter 1:17	For hee receiued from God the Father, honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloued Sonne in whom I am well pleased.
2pe.1.18	2 Peter 1:18	And this voice which came from heauen wee heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
2pe.1.19	2 Peter 1:19	We haue also a more sure word of prophecie, whereunto yee doe well that ye take heede, as vnto a light that shineth in a darke place, vntill the day dawne, and the day starre arise in your hearts:
2pe.1.20	2 Peter 1:20	Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the Scripture is of any priuate Interpretation:
2pe.1.21	2 Peter 1:21	For the prophecie came not in olde time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moued by the holy Ghost.
2pe.2.1	2 Peter 2:1	But there were false prophets also among the people, euen as there shall bee false teachers among you, who priuily shall bring in damnable heresies, euen denying the Lord that bought them, and bring vpon themselues swift destruction.
2pe.2.2	2 Peter 2:2	And many shall follow their pernicious wayes, by reason of whom the way of trueth shall be euill spoken of:
2pe.2.3	2 Peter 2:3	And through couetousnesse shall they with fained words, make marchandise of you, whose iudgement now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbreth not.
2pe.2.4	2 Peter 2:4	For if God spared not the Angels that sinned, but cast them downe to hell, and deliuered them into chaines of darkenesse, to be reserued vnto iudgment:
2pe.2.5	2 Peter 2:5	And spared not the old world, but saued Noah the eight person a preacher of righteousnesse, bringing in the flood vpon the world of the vngodly:
2pe.2.6	2 Peter 2:6	And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes, condemned them with an ouerthrowe, making them an ensample vnto those that after should liue vngodly:
2pe.2.7	2 Peter 2:7	And deliuered iust Lot, vexed with the filthy conuersation of the wicked:
2pe.2.8	2 Peter 2:8	(For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing & hearing, vexed his righteous soule from day to day, with their vnlawfull deeds.)
2pe.2.9	2 Peter 2:9	The Lord knoweth how to deliuer the godly out of temptations, and to reserue the vniust vnto the day of iudgement to be punished:
2pe.2.10	2 Peter 2:10	But chiefly them that walke after the flesh in the lust of vncleannesse, and despise gouernment. Presumptuous are they; selfe willed: they are not afraid to speake euill of dignities:
2pe.2.11	2 Peter 2:11	Whereas Angels which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
2pe.2.12	2 Peter 2:12	But these, as natural bruit beasts made to bee taken and destroyed speake euill of the things that they vnderstand not, and shall vtterly perish in their owne corruption,
2pe.2.13	2 Peter 2:13	And shall receiue the reward of vnrighteousnesse, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time: Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselues with their owne deceiuings, while they feast with you:
2pe.2.14	2 Peter 2:14	Hauing eyes ful of adulterie and that cannot cease from sinne, beguiling vnstable soules: an heart they haue exercised with couetous practises: cursed children:
2pe.2.15	2 Peter 2:15	Which haue forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the sonne of Bosor, who loued the wages of vnrighteousnesse,
2pe.2.16	2 Peter 2:16	But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumbe asse speaking with mais voice, forbade the madnesse of the Prophet.
2pe.2.17	2 Peter 2:17	These are welles without water, cloudes that are caried with a tempest, to whom the mist of darkenesse is reserued for euer.
2pe.2.18	2 Peter 2:18	For when they speake great svelling words of vanitie, they alure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonnesse, those that were cleane escaped from them who liue in errour.
2pe.2.19	2 Peter 2:19	While they promise them libertie, they themselues are the seruants of corruption: for of whom a man is ouercome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
2pe.2.20	2 Peter 2:20	For if after they haue escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Sauiour Iesus Christ, they are againe intangled therein, and ouercome, the latter end is worse with them then the beginning.
2pe.2.21	2 Peter 2:21	For it had bin better for them not to haue knowen the way of righteousnesse, then after they haue knowen it, to turne from the holy commandement deliuered vnto them.
2pe.2.22	2 Peter 2:22	But it is happened vnto them according to the true prouerbe: The dog is turned to his own vomit againe, and the sowe that was washed, to her wallowing in the mire.
2pe.3.1	2 Peter 3:1	This second Epistle (beloued) I now write vnto you, in both which I stir vp your pure mindes by way of remembrance:
2pe.3.2	2 Peter 3:2	That yee may be mindfull of the wordes which were spoken before by the holy Prophets, and of the Commandement of vs the Apostles of the Lord and Sauiour:
2pe.3.3	2 Peter 3:3	Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last dayes scoffers, walking after their owne lusts,
2pe.3.4	2 Peter 3:4	And saying, Where is the promise of his comming? For since the fathers fell asleepe, all things continue as they were frō the beginning of the creation.
2pe.3.5	2 Peter 3:5	For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heauens were of olde, and the earth standing out of the water, and in the water,
2pe.3.6	2 Peter 3:6	Whereby the world that then was, being ouerflowed with water, perished.
2pe.3.7	2 Peter 3:7	But the heauens and the earth which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserued vnto fire against the day of Iudgement, and perdition of vngodly men.
2pe.3.8	2 Peter 3:8	But (beloued) bee not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand yeeres, and a thousand yeeres as one day.
2pe.3.9	2 Peter 3:9	The Lord is not slacke cōcerning his promise (as some men count slacknesse) but is long-suffring to vs-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
2pe.3.10	2 Peter 3:10	But the day of the Lord wil come as a thiefe in the night, in the which the heauens shall passe away with a great noise, and the Elements shall melt with feruent heate, the earth also and the works that are therin shalbe burnt vp.
2pe.3.11	2 Peter 3:11	Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolued, What maner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conuersation, and godlinesse,
2pe.3.12	2 Peter 3:12	Looking for and hasting vnto the comming of the day of God, wherein the heauens being on fire shalbe dissolued, and the Elements shall melt with feruent heat.
2pe.3.13	2 Peter 3:13	Neuerthelesse wee, according to his promise, looke for new heauens, and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousnesse.
2pe.3.14	2 Peter 3:14	Wherefore (beloued) seeing that ye looke for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blamelesse.
2pe.3.15	2 Peter 3:15	And account that the long suffering of the Lord is saluation, euen as our beloued brother Paul also, according to the wisedome giuen vnto him, hath written vnto you.
2pe.3.16	2 Peter 3:16	As also in all his Epistles, speaking in them of these things, in which are some things hard to be vnderstood, which they that are vnlearned and vnstable wrest, as they doe also the other Scriptures, vnto their owne destruction.
2pe.3.17	2 Peter 3:17	Ye therefore, beloued, seeing yee know these things before, beware lest yee also being led away with the errour of the wicked, fall from your owne stedfastnesse.
2pe.3.18	2 Peter 3:18	But growe in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Sauiour Iesus Christ: to him be glory both now and for euer. Amen.
1jn.1.1	1 John 1:1	That which was from þ beginning, which wee haue heard, which wee haue seene with our eyes, which wee haue looked vpon, and our hands haue handled of the word of life.
1jn.1.2	1 John 1:2	(For the life was manifested, and we haue seene it, and beare witnes, and shew vnto you that eternall life which was with the Father, and was manifested vnto vs.)
1jn.1.3	1 John 1:3	That which wee haue seene and heard, declare we vnto you, that ye also may haue felowship with vs; and truely our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Sonne Iesus Christ.
1jn.1.4	1 John 1:4	And these things write we vnto you, that your ioy may be full.
1jn.1.5	1 John 1:5	This then is the message which we haue heard of him, and declare vnto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkenesse at all.
1jn.1.6	1 John 1:6	If we say that we haue felowship with him, and walke in darkenesse, we lie, and doe not the trueth.
1jn.1.7	1 John 1:7	But if wee walke in the light, as he is in the light, wee haue fellowship one with another, and the blood of Iesus Christ his Sonne clenseth vs from all sinne.
1jn.1.8	1 John 1:8	If we say that we haue no sinne, we deceiue our selues, and the trueth is not in vs.
1jn.1.9	1 John 1:9	If we confesse our sinnes, hee is faithfull, & iust to forgiue vs our sinnes, and to cleanse vs from all vnrighteousnesse.
1jn.1.10	1 John 1:10	If we say that we haue not sinned, wee make him a liar, and his word is not in vs.
1jn.2.1	1 John 2:1	My little children, these things write I vnto you, that ye sinne not. And if any man sinne, we haue an Aduocate with the Father, Iesus Christ the righteous:
1jn.2.2	1 John 2:2	And he is the propitiation for our sinnes: and not for ours onely, but also for the sinnes of the whole world.
1jn.2.3	1 John 2:3	And hereby wee doe knowe that we know him, if we keepe his commandements.
1jn.2.4	1 John 2:4	He that saith, I knowe him, and keepeth not his commandements, is a lyer, and the trueth is not in him.
1jn.2.5	1 John 2:5	But who so keepeth his word, in him verely is the loue of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
1jn.2.6	1 John 2:6	He that sayeth he abideth in him, ought himselfe also so to walke, euen as he walked.
1jn.2.7	1 John 2:7	Brethren, I write no new commandement vnto you, but an olde commandement which ye had from the beginning: the old commandement is the word which ye haue heard from the beginning.
1jn.2.8	1 John 2:8	Againe, a new commandement I write vnto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkenesse is past, and the true light now shineth.
1jn.2.9	1 John 2:9	He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkenesse euen vntill now.
1jn.2.10	1 John 2:10	Hee that loueth his brother, abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
1jn.2.11	1 John 2:11	But he that hateth his brother, is in darknesse, and walketh in darknesse, and knoweth not whither hee goeth, because that darknesse hath blinded his eyes.
1jn.2.12	1 John 2:12	I write vnto you, little children, because your sinnes are forgiuen you for his Names sake.
1jn.2.13	1 John 2:13	I write vnto you, fathers, because yee haue knowen him that is from the beginning. I write vnto you, young men, because you haue ouercome the wicked one. I write vnto you, little children, because yee haue knowen the Father.
1jn.2.14	1 John 2:14	I haue written vnto you, fathers, because ye haue knowen him that is from the beginning. I haue written vnto you, young men, because yee are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and yee haue ouercome the wicked one.
1jn.2.15	1 John 2:15	Loue not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man loue the world, the loue of the Father is not in him.
1jn.2.16	1 John 2:16	For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
1jn.2.17	1 John 2:17	And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof, but hee that doeth the will of God, abideth for euer.
1jn.2.18	1 John 2:18	Little children, it is the last time: and as yee haue heard that Antichrist shall come, euen now are there many Antichrists, whereby wee know that it is the last time.
1jn.2.19	1 John 2:19	They went out from vs, but they were not of vs: for if they had beene of vs, they would no doubt haue continued with vs: but they went out that they might be made manifest, that they were not all of vs.
1jn.2.20	1 John 2:20	But ye haue an vnction from the holy One, and ye know all things.
1jn.2.21	1 John 2:21	I haue not written vnto you, because yee know not the trueth: but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the trueth.
1jn.2.22	1 John 2:22	Who is a lier, but hee that denieth that Iesus is the Christ? hee is Antichrist, that denyeth the Father, and the Sonne.
1jn.2.23	1 John 2:23	Whosoeuer denieth the Sonne, the same hath not the Father: but he that acknowledgeth the Sonne, hath the Father also.
1jn.2.24	1 John 2:24	Let that therefore abide in you which yee haue heard from the beginning: if that which ye haue heard from the beginning shall remaine in you, yee also shall continue in the Sonne, and in the Father.
1jn.2.25	1 John 2:25	And this is the promise that hee hath promised vs, euen eternall life.
1jn.2.26	1 John 2:26	These things haue I written vnto you, concerning them that seduce you.
1jn.2.27	1 John 2:27	But the anointing which ye haue receiued of him, abideth in you: and yee need not that any man teach you: But, as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is trueth, and is no lye: and euen as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
1jn.2.28	1 John 2:28	And now, little children, abide in him, that when hee shall appeare, wee may haue confidence, and not bee ashamed before him at his comming.
1jn.2.29	1 John 2:29	If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that euery one which doeth righteousnesse, is borne of him.
1jn.3.1	1 John 3:1	Beholde, what manner of loue the Father hath bestowed vpon vs, that wee should be called the sonnes of God: therfore the world knoweth vs not, because it knewe him not.
1jn.3.2	1 John 3:2	Beloued, now are we the sonnes of God, and it doeth not yet appeare, what wee shall be: but wee know, that when he shall appeare, we shall bee like him: for we shall see him as he is.
1jn.3.3	1 John 3:3	And euery man that hath this hope in him, purifieth himselfe, euen as he is pure.
1jn.3.4	1 John 3:4	Whosoeuer committeth sinne, transgresseth also the lawe: for sinne is the transgression of the law.
1jn.3.5	1 John 3:5	And ye know that hee was manifested to take away our sinnes, and in him is no sinne.
1jn.3.6	1 John 3:6	Whosoeuer abideth in him, sinneth not: whosoeuer sinneth, hath not seene him, neither knowen him.
1jn.3.7	1 John 3:7	Little children, let no man deceiue you: he that doth righteousnes, is righteous, euen as he is righteous.
1jn.3.8	1 John 3:8	He that committeth sinne, is of the deuill, for the deuill sinneth from the beginning: for this purpose the Sonne of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the deuill.
1jn.3.9	1 John 3:9	Whosoeuer is borne of God, doth not commit sinne: for his seede remaineth in him, and he cannot sinne, because he is borne of God.
1jn.3.10	1 John 3:10	In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the deuill: whosoeuer doeth not righteousnesse, is not of God, neither hee that loueth not his brother.
1jn.3.11	1 John 3:11	For this is the message that yee heard from the beginning, that wee should loue one another.
1jn.3.12	1 John 3:12	Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slewe his brother: and wherefore slewe hee him? because his owne workes were euill, and his brothers righteous.
1jn.3.13	1 John 3:13	Marueile not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
1jn.3.14	1 John 3:14	Wee know that wee haue passed from death vnto life, because wee loue the brethren: he that loueth not his brother, abideth in death.
1jn.3.15	1 John 3:15	Whosoeuer hateth his brother, is a murtherer, and yee knowe that no murtherer hath eternall life abiding in him.
1jn.3.16	1 John 3:16	Hereby perceiue wee the loue of God, because he layd downe his life for vs, and wee ought to lay downe our liues for the brethren.
1jn.3.17	1 John 3:17	But who so hath this worlds good, and seeth his brother hath need, and shutteth vp his bowels of compassion from him; how dwelleth the loue of God in him?
1jn.3.18	1 John 3:18	My little children, let vs not loue in word, neither in tongue, but indeede and in trueth.
1jn.3.19	1 John 3:19	And hereby wee know that wee are of the trueth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
1jn.3.20	1 John 3:20	For if our heart condemne vs, God is greater then our heart, and knoweth all things.
1jn.3.21	1 John 3:21	Beloued, if our heart condemne vs not, then haue wee confidence towards God.
1jn.3.22	1 John 3:22	And whatsoeuer we aske, wee receiue of him, because we keepe his commandement, and doe those things that are pleasing in his sight.
1jn.3.23	1 John 3:23	And this is his commandement, that we should beleeue on the Name of his Sonne Iesus Christ, and loue one another, as hee gaue vs commandement.
1jn.3.24	1 John 3:24	And hee that keepeth his commandements dwelleth in him, and hee in him: and hereby wee know that hee abideth in vs, by the spirit which hee hath giuen vs.
1jn.4.1	1 John 4:1	Beloued, beleeue not euery spirit, but trie the spirits, whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
1jn.4.2	1 John 4:2	Hereby know ye the spirit of God: euery spirit that confesseth that Iesus Christ is come in the flesh, is of God.
1jn.4.3	1 John 4:3	And euery Spirit that confesseth not that Iesus Christ is come in the flesh, is not of God: and this is that spirit of Antichrist, whereof you haue heard, that it should come, and euen now already is it in the world.
1jn.4.4	1 John 4:4	Ye are of God, little children, and haue ouercome them: because greater is he that is in you, then he that is in the world.
1jn.4.5	1 John 4:5	They are of the world: therefore speake they of the world, and the world heareth them.
1jn.4.6	1 John 4:6	We are of God: hee that knoweth God, heareth vs: he that is not of God heareth not vs, hereby know wee the spirit of trueth, and the spirit of errour.
1jn.4.7	1 John 4:7	Beloued, let vs loue one another; for loue is of God: and euery one that loueth, is borne of God and knoweth God.
1jn.4.8	1 John 4:8	Hee that loueth not, knoweth not God: for God is loue.
1jn.4.9	1 John 4:9	In this was manifested the loue of God towards vs, because that God sent his only begotten Sonne into the world, that we might liue through him.
1jn.4.10	1 John 4:10	Herein is loue, not that wee loued God, but that he loued vs, and sent his Sonne to be þ propitiation for our sins.
1jn.4.11	1 John 4:11	Beloued, if God so loued vs, wee ought also to loue one another.
1jn.4.12	1 John 4:12	No man hath seene God at any time. If wee loue one another, God dwelleth in vs, and his loue is perfected in vs.
1jn.4.13	1 John 4:13	Hereby know wee that we dwell in him and he in vs, because hee hath giuen vs of his Spirit.
1jn.4.14	1 John 4:14	And we haue seene, and doe testifie, that the Father sent the Sonne to be the Sauiour of the world.
1jn.4.15	1 John 4:15	Whosoeuer shall confesse that Iesus is the Sonne of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
1jn.4.16	1 John 4:16	And we haue knowen and beleeued the loue that God hath to vs. God is loue, and hee that dwelleth in loue, dwelleth in God, and God in him.
1jn.4.17	1 John 4:17	Herein is our loue made perfect, that wee may haue boldnesse in the day of Iudgement, because as hee is, so are we in this world.
1jn.4.18	1 John 4:18	There is no feare in loue, but perfect loue casteth out feare: because feare hath torment: hee that feareth, is not made perfect in loue.
1jn.4.19	1 John 4:19	We loue him: because hee first loued vs.
1jn.4.20	1 John 4:20	If a man say, I loue God, and hateth his brother, he is a lyar. For hee that loueth not his brother whom hee hath seene, how can he loue God whom he hath not seene?
1jn.4.21	1 John 4:21	And this commandement haue we from him, that he who loueth God, loue his brother also.
1jn.5.1	1 John 5:1	Whosoeuer beleeueth that Iesus is the Christ, is borne of God: and euery one that loueth him that begate, loueth him also that is begotten of him.
1jn.5.2	1 John 5:2	By this wee know that wee loue the children of God, when we loue God and keepe his commandements.
1jn.5.3	1 John 5:3	For this is the loue of God, that we keepe his commandements, and his commandements are not grieuous.
1jn.5.4	1 John 5:4	For whatsoeuer is borne of God, ouercommeth the world, and this is the victorie that ouercommeth the world, euen our faith.
1jn.5.5	1 John 5:5	Who is he that ouercommeth the world, but he that beleeueth that Iesus is the Sonne of God?
1jn.5.6	1 John 5:6	This is hee that came by water and blood, euen Iesus Christ, not by water onely, but by water and blood: and it is the Spirit that beareth witnesse, because the Spirit is trueth.
1jn.5.7	1 John 5:7	For there are three that beare record in heauen, the Father, the Word, and the holy Ghost: and these three are one.
1jn.5.8	1 John 5:8	And there are three that beare witnesse in earth, the Spirit, and the Water, and the Blood, and these three agree in one.
1jn.5.9	1 John 5:9	If we receiue the witnesse of men, the witnesse of God is greater: for this is the witnesse of God, which hee hath testified of his Sonne.
1jn.5.10	1 John 5:10	Hee that beleeueth on the Sonne of God, hath the witnesse in himselfe: he that beleeueth not God, hath made him a liar, because he beleeueth not the record that God gaue of his Sonne.
1jn.5.11	1 John 5:11	And this is the record, that God hath giuen to vs eternall life, and this life is in his Sonne.
1jn.5.12	1 John 5:12	Hee that hath the Sonne, hath life; and hee that hath not the Sonne, hath not life.
1jn.5.13	1 John 5:13	These things haue I written vnto you that beleeue on the Name of the Sonne of God, that ye may know, that ye haue eternall life, and that yee may beleeue on the Name of the Sonne of God.
1jn.5.14	1 John 5:14	And this is the confidence that we haue in him, that if wee aske any thing according to his will, hee heareth vs.
1jn.5.15	1 John 5:15	And if we know that he heare vs, whatsoeuer wee aske, wee know that we haue the petitions that wee desired of him.
1jn.5.16	1 John 5:16	If any man see his brother sinne a sinne which is not vnto death, hee shall aske, and he shall giue him life for them that sinne not vnto death. There is a sinne vnto death: I doe not say that he shall pray for it.
1jn.5.17	1 John 5:17	All vnrighteousnes is sinne, and there is a sinne not vnto death.
1jn.5.18	1 John 5:18	We know that whosoeuer is borne of God, sinneth not: but hee that is begotten of God, keepeth himselfe, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
1jn.5.19	1 John 5:19	And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickednesse.
1jn.5.20	1 John 5:20	And we know that the Sonne of God is come, and hath giuen vs an vnderstanding that wee may know him that is true: and wee are in him that is true, euen in his Sonne Iesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternall life.
1jn.5.21	1 John 5:21	Little children, keepe your selues from Idoles. Amen.
2jn.1.1	2 John 1:1	The Elder vnto the elect Lady, and her children, whome I loue in the trueth: and not I onely, but also all they that haue knowen þ trueth:
2jn.1.2	2 John 1:2	For the trueths sake which dwelleth in vs, and shalbe with vs for euer:
2jn.1.3	2 John 1:3	Grace bee with you, mercie, and peace from God the Father, and from the Lord Iesus Christ, the Sonne of the Father in trueth and loue.
2jn.1.4	2 John 1:4	I reioyced greatly, that I found of thy children walking in trueth, as wee haue receiued a commaundement from the Father.
2jn.1.5	2 John 1:5	And now, I beseech thee Lady, not as though I wrote a new commandement vnto thee: but that which wee had from the beginning, that wee loue one another.
2jn.1.6	2 John 1:6	And this is loue, that wee walke after his Commandements. This is the Commandement, that as yee haue heard from the beginning, yee should walke in it.
2jn.1.7	2 John 1:7	For many deceiuers are entred into the world, who confesse not that Iesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiuer, and an Antichrist.
2jn.1.8	2 John 1:8	Looke to your selues, that wee lose not those things which wee haue wrought, but that we receiue a full reward.
2jn.1.9	2 John 1:9	Whosoeuer transgresseth and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God: hee that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Sonne.
2jn.1.10	2 John 1:10	If there come any vnto you, and bring not this doctrine, receiue him not into your house, neither bid him, God speed.
2jn.1.11	2 John 1:11	For hee that biddeth him God speed, is partaker of his euill deeds.
2jn.1.12	2 John 1:12	Hauing many things to write vnto you, I would not write with paper and inke, but I trust to come vnto you, and speake face to face, that our ioy may be full.
2jn.1.13	2 John 1:13	The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
3jn.1.1	3 John 1:1	The Elder vnto the welbeloued Gaius, whom I loue in the trueth:
3jn.1.2	3 John 1:2	Beloued, I wish aboue all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, euen as thy soule prospereth.
3jn.1.3	3 John 1:3	For I reioyced greatly when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, euen as thou walkest in the trueth.
3jn.1.4	3 John 1:4	I haue no greater ioy, then to heare that my children walke in truth.
3jn.1.5	3 John 1:5	Beloued, thou doest faithfully whatsoeuer thou doest to the Brethren, and to strangers:
3jn.1.6	3 John 1:6	Which haue borne witnesse of thy charitie before the Church: whome if thou bring forward on their iourney after a godly sort, thou shalt doe well:
3jn.1.7	3 John 1:7	Because that for his Names sake they went foorth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
3jn.1.8	3 John 1:8	We therefore ought to receiue such, that we might be fellow helpers to the trueth.
3jn.1.9	3 John 1:9	I wrote vnto the Church, but Diotrephes, who loueth to haue the preeminence among them, receiueth vs not.
3jn.1.10	3 John 1:10	Wherefore if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against vs with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth hee himselfe receiue the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the Church.
3jn.1.11	3 John 1:11	Beloued, follow not that which is euill, but that which is good. He that doth good, is of God: but hee that doth euill, hath not seene God.
3jn.1.12	3 John 1:12	Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the trueth it selfe: yea, and we also beare record, and ye know that our record is true.
3jn.1.13	3 John 1:13	I had many things to write, but I will not with inke and pen write vnto thee.
3jn.1.14	3 John 1:14	But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and wee shall speake face to face. Peace bee to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
jd.1.1	Jude 1:1	Iude the seruant of Iesus Christ, and brother of Iames, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserued in Iesus Christ, & called:
jd.1.2	Jude 1:2	Mercie vnto you, and peace, and loue be multiplied.
jd.1.3	Jude 1:3	Beloued, when I gaue all diligence to write vnto you of the common saluation: it was needfull for mee to write vnto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once deliuered vnto the Saints.
jd.1.4	Jude 1:4	For there are certaine men crept in vnawares, who were before of olde ordained to this condemnation, vngodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciuiousnesse, and denying the onely Lord God, & our Lord Iesus Christ.
jd.1.5	Jude 1:5	I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord hauing saued the people out of the land of Egypt afterward destroied them that beleeued not.
jd.1.6	Jude 1:6	And the Angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserued in euerlasting chaines vnder darkenesse, vnto the iudgement of the great day.
jd.1.7	Jude 1:7	Euen as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them, in like maner giuing themselues ouer to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffring the vengeance of eternall fire.
jd.1.8	Jude 1:8	Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speake euill of dignities.
jd.1.9	Jude 1:9	Yet Michael the Archangel, when contending with the deuill, he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
jd.1.10	Jude 1:10	But these speake euill of those things, which they know not: but what they knowe naturally, as brute beastes, in those things they corrupt themselues.
jd.1.11	Jude 1:11	Wo vnto them, for they haue gone in the way of Kain, and ranne greedily after the errour of Balaam, for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
jd.1.12	Jude 1:12	These are spottes in your feasts of charitie, when they feast with you, feeding themselues without feare: cloudes they are without water, caried about of winds, trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twise dead, plucked vp by the rootes.
jd.1.13	Jude 1:13	Raging waues of the sea, foming out their owne shame, wandring stars, to whom is reserued the blacknesse of darkenesse for euer.
jd.1.14	Jude 1:14	And Enoch also, the seuenth from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord commeth with ten thousands of his Saints,
jd.1.15	Jude 1:15	To execute iudgement vpon all, and to conuince all that are vngodly among them, of all their vngodly deeds which they haue vngodly committed, and of all their heard speaches, which vngodly sinners haue spoken against him.
jd.1.16	Jude 1:16	These are murmurers complainers, walking after their owne lustes, and their mouth speaketh great swelling wordes, hauing mens persons in admiration because of aduantage.
jd.1.17	Jude 1:17	But beloued, remember yee the words, which were spoken before of the Apostles of our Lord Iesus Christ:
jd.1.18	Jude 1:18	How that they tolde you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walke after their own vngodly lustes.
jd.1.19	Jude 1:19	These be they who separate themselues, sensual, hauing not the spirit.
jd.1.20	Jude 1:20	But yee beloued, building vp your selues on your most holy faith, praying in the holy Ghost,
jd.1.21	Jude 1:21	Keepe your selues in the loue of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Iesus Christ vnto eternall life.
jd.1.22	Jude 1:22	And of some haue compassion, making a difference:
jd.1.23	Jude 1:23	And others saue with feare, pulling them out of the fire: hating euen the garment spotted by the flesh.
jd.1.24	Jude 1:24	Now vnto him that is able to keepe you from falling, and to present you faultlesse before the presence of his glory with exceeding ioy,
jd.1.25	Jude 1:25	To the onely wise God our Sauiour, be glory and maiestie, dominion and power, now and euer. Amen.
re.1.1	Revelation 1:1	The Reuelation of Iesus Christ, which God gaue vnto him, to shewe vnto his seruants things which must shortly come to passe; and he sent and signified it by his Angel vnto his seruant Iohn,
re.1.2	Revelation 1:2	Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimonie of Iesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
re.1.3	Revelation 1:3	Blessed is hee that readeth, and they that heare the words of this prophesie, and keepe those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
re.1.4	Revelation 1:4	Iohn to the seuen Churches in Asia, Grace be vnto you, & peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come, and from the seuen spirits which are before his throne:
re.1.5	Revelation 1:5	And from Iesus Christ, who is the faithful witnesse, and the first begotten of the dead, and the Prince of the kings of the earth: vnto him that loued vs, and washed vs from our sinnes in his owne blood,
re.1.6	Revelation 1:6	And hath made vs Kings and Priests vnto God and his Father: to him be glory and dominion for euer and euer, Amen.
re.1.7	Revelation 1:7	Behold he commeth with clouds, and euery eye shal see him, and they also which pearced him: and all kinreds of the earth shall waile because of him: euen so. Amen.
re.1.8	Revelation 1:8	I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
re.1.9	Revelation 1:9	I Iohn, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdome and patience of Iesus Christ, was in the Isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimonie of Iesus Christ.
re.1.10	Revelation 1:10	I was in the spirit on the Lords day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
re.1.11	Revelation 1:11	Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and what thou seest, write in a booke, and send it vnto the seuen Churches which are in Asia, vnto Ephesus, and vnto Smyrna, and vnto Pergamos, and vnto Thyatira, and vnto Sardis, and Philadelphia, and vnto Laodicea.
re.1.12	Revelation 1:12	And I turned to see the voice that spake with mee. And being turned, I saw seuen golden Candlesticks,
re.1.13	Revelation 1:13	And in the midst of the seuen candlestickes, one like vnto the Sonne of man, clothed with a garment downe to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
re.1.14	Revelation 1:14	His head, and his haires were white like wooll as white as snow, and his eyes were as a flame of fire,
re.1.15	Revelation 1:15	And his feet like vnto fine brasse, as if they burned in a furnace: and his voice as the sound of many waters.
re.1.16	Revelation 1:16	And hee had in his right hand seuen starres: and out of his mouth went a sharpe two edged sword: and his countenance was as the Sunne shineth in his strength.
re.1.17	Revelation 1:17	And when I sawe him, I fell at his feete as dead: and hee laid his right hand vpon me, saying vnto mee, Feare not, I am the first, and the last.
re.1.18	Revelation 1:18	I am hee that liueth, and was dead: and behold, I am aliue for euermore, Amen, and haue the keyes of hell and of death.
re.1.19	Revelation 1:19	Write the things which thou hast seene, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter,
re.1.20	Revelation 1:20	The mysterie of the seuen starres which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seuen golden Candlestickes. The seuen Starres are the Angels of the seuen Churches: and the seuen candlestickes which thou sawest, are the seuen Churches.
re.2.1	Revelation 2:1	Vnto the Angel of the church of Ephesus, write, These things saith he that holdeth the seuen starres in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seuen golden Candlesticks:
re.2.2	Revelation 2:2	I know thy workes, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not beare them which are euil, and thou hast tried them which say they are Apostles, and are not, and hast found them lyers:
re.2.3	Revelation 2:3	And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my Names sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
re.2.4	Revelation 2:4	Neuerthelesse, I haue somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first loue.
re.2.5	Revelation 2:5	Remember therfore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and doe the first workes, or else I will come vnto thee quickly, and will remoue thy Candlesticke out of his place, except thou repent.
re.2.6	Revelation 2:6	But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
re.2.7	Revelation 2:7	Hee that hath an eare, let him heare what the Spirit saith vnto the Churches: To him that ouercommeth will I giue to eate of the tree of life, which is in the middest of the Paradise of God.
re.2.8	Revelation 2:8	And vnto the Angel of the Church in Smyrna, write, These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is aliue,
re.2.9	Revelation 2:9	I know thy works, and tribulation, and pouertie, but thou art rich, and I know the blasphemie of them which say they are Iewes and are not, but are the Synagogue of Satan.
re.2.10	Revelation 2:10	Feare none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the deuill shal cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried, and yee shall haue tribulation tenne dayes: bee thou faithfull vnto death, and I will giue thee a crowne of life.
re.2.11	Revelation 2:11	He that hath an eare, let him heare what the spirit saith vnto the churches. He that ouercommeth, shall not be hurt of the second death.
re.2.12	Revelation 2:12	And to the Angel of the Church in Pergamos, write, These things saith hee, which hath the sharpe sword with two edges:
re.2.13	Revelation 2:13	I know thy workes, and where thou dwellest, euen where Satans seat is, and thou holdest fast my Name, and hast not denied my faith, euen in those daies, wherein Antipas was my faithful Martyr, who was slaine among you, where Satan dwelleth.
re.2.14	Revelation 2:14	But I haue a fewe things against thee, because thou hast there them that holde the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumbling blocke before the children of Israel, to eate things sacrificed vnto idoles, and to commit fornication.
re.2.15	Revelation 2:15	So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
re.2.16	Revelation 2:16	Repent, or else I will come vnto thee quickly, and wil fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
re.2.17	Revelation 2:17	Hee that hath an eare, let him heare what the Spirit saith vnto the Churches. To him that ouercommeth will I giue to eate of the hidden Manna, and will giue him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth, sauing hee that receiueth it.
re.2.18	Revelation 2:18	And vnto the Angel of the church in Thyatira, write, These things saith the Sonne of God, who hath his eyes like vnto a flame of fire, and his feete are like fine brasse:
re.2.19	Revelation 2:19	I know thy works, and charitie, and seruice, and faith, and thy patience, and thy workes, and the last to bee more then the first.
re.2.20	Revelation 2:20	Notwithstanding, I haue a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Iezebel, which calleth herselfe a Prophetesse, to teach and to seduce my seruants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed vnto idoles.
re.2.21	Revelation 2:21	And I gaue her space to repent of her fornication, and she repented not.
re.2.22	Revelation 2:22	Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her, into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
re.2.23	Revelation 2:23	And I will kill her children with death, and all the Churches shall know that I am hee which searcheth the reines and hearts: and I will giue vnto euery one of you according to your workes.
re.2.24	Revelation 2:24	But vnto you I say, and vnto the rest in Thyatira, as many as haue not this doctrine, and which haue not knowen the depthes of Satan, as they speake, I will put vpon you none other burden:
re.2.25	Revelation 2:25	But that which ye haue already, hold fast till I come.
re.2.26	Revelation 2:26	And hee that ouercommeth, and keepeth my workes vnto the ende, to him will I giue power ouer the nations:
re.2.27	Revelation 2:27	(And he shall rule them with a rod of yron: as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shiuers:) euen as I receiued of my Father.
re.2.28	Revelation 2:28	And I will giue him the morning starre.

re.3.2	Revelation 3:2	Be watchfull, and strengthen the things which remaine, that are ready to die: for I haue not found thy works perfect before God.
re.3.3	Revelation 3:3	Remember therefore, how thou hast receiued and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thiefe, and thou shalt not know what houre I will come vpon thee.
re.3.4	Revelation 3:4	Thou hast a few names euen in Sardis, which haue not defiled their garments, and they shall walke with me in white: for they are worthy.

re.3.8	Revelation 3:8	I know thy workes: behold, I haue set before thee an open doore, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my Name.

re.3.10	Revelation 3:10	Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keepe thee from the houre of temptation, which shall come vpon all the world, to try them that dwell vpon the earth.
re.3.11	Revelation 3:11	Beholde, I come quickly, hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crowne.
re.3.12	Revelation 3:12	Him that ouercommeth, will I make a pillar in the Temple of my God, and he shall goe no more out: and I wil write vpon him the Name of my God, and the name of the Citie of my God, which is new Hierusalem, which commeth downe out of heauen from my God: And I will write vpon him my New name.

re.3.15	Revelation 3:15	I know thy workes, that thou art neither cold nor hot, I would thou wert cold or hot.
re.3.16	Revelation 3:16	So then because thou art lukewarme, and neither cold nor hot, I wil spew thee out of my mouth:
re.3.17	Revelation 3:17	Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and haue need of nothing: and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poore, and blinde, and naked.
re.3.18	Revelation 3:18	I counsell thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest bee rich, and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakednesse doe not appeare, and anoint thine eyes with eye salue, that thou mayest see.
re.3.19	Revelation 3:19	As many as I loue, I rebuke and chasten, be zealous therefore, and repent.

re.4.1	Revelation 4:1	After this I looked, and beholde, a doore was opened in heauen: and the first voice which I heard, was as it were of a trumpet, talking with me, which said, Come vp hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
re.4.2	Revelation 4:2	And immediatly I was in the spirit: and beholde, a Throne was set in heauen, and one sate on the Throne.
re.4.3	Revelation 4:3	And he that sate was to looke vpon like a Iasper, and a Sardine stone: and there was a rainebow round about the Throne, in sight like vnto an Emeralde.
re.4.4	Revelation 4:4	And round about the Throne were foure and twentie seates, and vpon the seates I saw foure and twentie Elders sitting, clothed in white rayment, and they had on their heades crownes of golde.
re.4.5	Revelation 4:5	And out of the Throne proceeded lightnings, and thundrings, and voyces: and there were seuen lampes of fire burning before the Throne, which are the seuen Spirits of God.
re.4.6	Revelation 4:6	And before the Throne there was a sea of glasse like vnto Chrystall: and in the middest of the throne, and round about the Throne, were foure beastes full of eyes before and behinde.
re.4.7	Revelation 4:7	And the first beast was like a Lion, and the second beast like a Calfe, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying Egle.
re.4.8	Revelation 4:8	And the foure beasts had each of them sixe wings about him, and they were full of eyes within, and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
re.4.9	Revelation 4:9	And when those beasts giue glory, and honour, and thankes to him that sate on the Throne, who liueth for euer and euer,
re.4.10	Revelation 4:10	The foure and twentie Elders fall downe before him that sate on the Throne, and worship him that liueth for euer and euer, and cast their crownes before the Throne, saying,
re.4.11	Revelation 4:11	Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receiue glorie, and honour, and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are, and were created.
re.5.1	Revelation 5:1	And I saw in þ right hand of him that sate on the Throne, a booke written within, & on the backeside, sealed with seuen seales.
re.5.2	Revelation 5:2	And I saw a strong Angel proclaiming with a loude voice; Who is worthy to open the booke, and to loose the seales thereof?
re.5.3	Revelation 5:3	And no man in heauen, nor in earth, neither vnder the earth, was able to open the booke, neither to looke thereon.
re.5.4	Revelation 5:4	And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open, and to reade the booke, neither to looke thereon.
re.5.5	Revelation 5:5	And one of the Elders saith vnto me, Weepe not: beholde, the Lion of the tribe of Iuda, the roote of Dauid, hath preuailed to open the booke, and to loose the seuen seales thereof.
re.5.6	Revelation 5:6	And I beheld, and loe, in the middest of the Throne, and of the foure beastes, and in the midst of the Elders stood a Lambe as it had beene slaine, hauing seuen hornes and seuen eyes, which are the seuen Spirits of God, sent foorth into all the earth.
re.5.7	Revelation 5:7	And he came, and tooke the booke out of the right hand of him that sate vpon the Throne.
re.5.8	Revelation 5:8	And when he had taken the booke, the foure Beasts, and foure and twenty Elders fel down before the Lambe, hauing euery one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of Saints.
re.5.9	Revelation 5:9	And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the Booke, and to open the seales thereof: for thou wast slaine, and hast redeemed vs to God by thy blood, out of euery kinred, and tongue, and people, and nation:
re.5.10	Revelation 5:10	And hast made vs vnto our God Kings and Priests, and we shall reigne on the earth.
re.5.11	Revelation 5:11	And I beheld, and I heard the voyce of many Angels, round about the Throne, and the beasts and the Elders, and the number of them was ten thousand times tenne thousand, and thousands of thousands,
re.5.12	Revelation 5:12	Saying with a lowd voice, Worthy is the Lambe that was slaine, to receiue power, and riches, and wisedome, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
re.5.13	Revelation 5:13	And euery creature which is in heauen, and on the earth, and vnder the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I, saying, Blessing, honour, glory, and power bee vnto him that sitteth vpon the Throne, and vnto the Lambe for euer and euer.

re.6.3	Revelation 6:3	And when hee had opened the second seale, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.

re.6.5	Revelation 6:5	And when hee had opened the third seale, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and loe, a blacke horse: and hee that sate on him had a paire of balances in his hand.

re.6.8	Revelation 6:8	And I looked, and behold, a pale horse, & his name that sate on him was Death, and hell followed with him: and power was giuen vnto them, ouer the fourth part of the earth to kill with sword, & with hunger, and with death, and with the beastes of the earth.
re.6.9	Revelation 6:9	And when hee had opened the fift seale, I saw vnder the altar, the soules of them that were slaine for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held.

re.6.11	Revelation 6:11	And white robes were giuen vnto euery one of them, and it was sayd vnto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, vntill their fellow seruants also, and their brethren that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.

re.6.13	Revelation 6:13	And the starres of heauen fell vnto the earth, euen as a figge tree casteth her vntimely figs when she is shaken of a mighty winde.

re.8.3	Revelation 8:3	And another Angel came & stood at the altar, hauing a golden censer, and there was giuen vnto him much incense, that hee should offer it with the prayers of all Saints vpon the golden altar which was before the throne.

re.9.15	Revelation 9:15	And the foure Angels were loosed, which were prepared for an houre, and a day, and a moneth, and a yeere, for to slay the third part of men.

re.9.17	Revelation 9:17	And thus I sawe the horses in the vision, and them that sate on them, hauing brest-plates of fire and of Iacinct, and brimstone, & the heades of the horses were as the heads of Lions, and out of their mouthes issued fire, and smoke, and brimstone.
re.9.18	Revelation 9:18	By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone which issued out of their mouthes.
re.9.19	Revelation 9:19	For their power is in their mouth, and in their tailes: for their tailes were like vnto serpents, and had heads, and with them they doe hurt.
re.9.20	Revelation 9:20	And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues, yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship deuils, and idoles of golde, and siluer, and brasse, and stone, and of wood, which neither can see, nor heare, nor walke:
re.9.21	Revelation 9:21	Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

re.10.9	Revelation 10:9	And I went vnto the Angel, and said vnto him, Giue me the little booke. And he sayd vnto me, Take it, and eat it vp, and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall bee in thy mouth sweete as hony.

re.11.6	Revelation 11:6	These haue power to shut heauen, that it raine not in the dayes of their prophesie: and haue power ouer waters to turne them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
re.11.7	Revelation 11:7	And when they shall haue finished their testimonie, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomlesse pit, shall make warre against them, and shall ouercome them, and kill them.

re.11.13	Revelation 11:13	And the same houre was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slaine of men seuen thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gaue glory to the God of heauen.
re.11.14	Revelation 11:14	The second woe is past, and behold, the third woe commeth quickly.
re.11.15	Revelation 11:15	And the seuenth Angel sounded, and there were great voyces in heauen, saying, The kingdomes of this world are become the kingdomes of our Lord, and of his Christ, and he shall reigne for euer and euer.

re.13.2	Revelation 13:2	And the beast which I saw, was like vnto a Leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a Beare, and his mouth as the mouth of a Lion: and the dragon gaue him his power, and his seat, and great authoritie.
re.13.3	Revelation 13:3	And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death, and his deadly wound was healed: and al the world wondered after the beast.
